links.title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost

evidence: Abstract: portfolio optimization improves held-out selector accuracy by 3.1, 7.5, and 0.9 points on ABCD, SGD, HotpotQA; dual-guided generation adds 3.5 on ABCD and 24.1 on HotpotQA
Section 8.2 and Table 3: actual selector accuracy rises from 43.625% (singleton) to 46.750% (optimized initial bank) to 50.250% (ADAS-expanded) on 800 held-out ABCD tasks with 95% Wilson intervals
Section 4.2, Theorem 4.4: selector odds-lift bound gives OPT <= max_k [h_Lambda(A_k) - gamma*C_k] and no-cost cap a* <= OPT <= h_Lambda(a*), with screening rule (24)
Section 6, Theorem 6.1: high-probability guarantee vs the full implicit workflow class with polynomially many oracle calls (Eq. 54-58)
Section 8.1: initial bank of 18 workflows (Qwen2.5-3B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Granite-3.3-8B x 6 prompting strategies); selector lambda_hat=2.9848, 95% CI [2.4930,3.5844], task-clustered

Section 3.3: paper states the oracle guarantee requires assumption (15) and that 'mere failure of a search procedure to find a workflow with score above theta does not certify that no such workflow exists'
Appendix G.2, Table 10: HotpotQA held-out accuracy 30.250% singleton to 55.250% (2x G1), a 25.000-point gain, with CI [0.5179,0.5866]
Section 8 Common experimental protocol: L=5 executions per task-workflow cell, temperature one, 16 SAA scenarios, 512 rounding trials, K_max=6; footnote 5 concedes L=5 task-level estimates are noisy
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on the curator's core interests: portfolio design, run-size and compute allocation for agentic LLM workflows, with an LLM-as-judge selector and dual-guided ADAS workflow generation (Sections 1, 3, 8.1). Theory is unusually rigorous: odds-lift selector cap (Theorem 4.4), exact fixed-size IPs with LP duals and rounding certificates (Theorem 5.3, Corollary 5.4), and a high-probability ellipsoid guarantee over an implicit workflow class (Theorem 6.1), with full proofs in Appendix D. Empirics are careful: frozen portfolios, 800 held-out tasks per domain, Wilson CIs, no-repeat ablations, Poisson-binomial evaluation (Tables 3, 6, 10). Weaknesses: the pricing-oracle assumption (15) is not verifiable in practice — the paper itself concedes a failed search does not certify nonexistence (Section 3.3); ABCD gains are modest with touching CIs (0.5025 [0.4679,0.5371] vs singleton 0.4363 [0.4023,0.4708]); only one selector model (Qwen2.5-7B) and small generator models are tested; Plackett-Luce is an acknowledged approximation (Figure 5); and no code/artifact release is stated, so reproducibility rests on documented protocol alone. High preference fit and rigor outweigh these limits.
topics: LLM orchestration and test-time compute allocation
operations research optimization (LP duality, ellipsoid/column generation)

primary_link.title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost

papers.summary: Agentic AI systems often approach the same task through multiple workflows that differ in reasoning strategy, verification structure, and compute cost. A natural deployment policy is to use the workflow with the highest average performance, but this can be suboptimal because different workflows may succeed on different instances. We study a portfolio-and-selector paradigm in which a firm runs multiple workflow executions and selects the final answer after observing their outputs. Additional exec
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討企業部署 agentic AI 的核心營運問題:同一任務可透過多個工作流程執行,最終品質取決於執行次數、流程組合與選擇器(selector)辨識正確答案的能力。作者提出「組合與選擇器」典範:平行執行多個候選流程後,由 selector 觀察輸出並挑選最終答案;關鍵權衡在於多一次執行可能找到正確答案,但也消耗運算成本並引入具迷惑性的錯誤候選。理論上,論文以 odds lift 指數 Λ 概括選擇器強度,證明任何組合相對最佳單一流程的增益存在尖銳上界;Λ 接近 1 時擴充組合幾乎無益。方法上,針對有限流程池發展整數規劃、線性規劃鬆弛、隨機化捨入與最佳性憑證,並以稀疏幾何網格選擇執行規模;針對無法列舉的隱含流程類別,則以對偶價格引導定價 oracle 搜尋高邊際價值的新流程,再以橢球法取得效能保證。實驗在 ABCD、Schema-Guided Dialogue 與 HotpotQA 三個資料集驗證:組合最佳化使 held-out selector 準確率分別提升 3.1、7.5、0.9 個百分點;對偶引導的流程生成在 ABCD 與 HotpotQA 再增加 3.5 與 24.1 個百分點,SGD 則無增益。限制包括 Plackett–Luce 模型僅為近似、生成搜尋受限於預算、共用模組與延遲成本未納入建模。核心訊息:推論階段的流程多樣性並非越多越好,有效部署須將流程生成、執行規模、選擇器強度與運算支出視為聯合決策。

links.title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces

evidence: Abstract: reports 76.67% on MATH-500 (Qwen2.5-7B) and 79.50% (Qwen2.5-Math-7B) optimizing ~100K bias parameters, 76,000× fewer than full-parameter TTRL
§6.1 Table 1: bias-only TTRL beats parameter-matched LoRA (exact-match, 100K) on all six benchmarks and LoRA r=16 on all six; FullFT exceeds it on five of six

§6.2 Table 2: controlled 2×2 ablation — pseudo-label bias-only (76.67±1.57) exceeds labeled bias-only (75.47±1.21) on Qwen2.5-7B, while labeled full FT (87.93±0.99) far exceeds pseudo-label full FT (77.00±0.53)
§6.3: frozen step-200 checkpoints transfer to 4,500 verified-disjoint MATH problems, 46.3%→70.9% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 52.5%→75.4% (Math-7B), with no further training
§6.5 Table 4: accessible gradient energy vs. single-layer accuracy across nine layers, Spearman ρ=0.917, exact permutation test p=0.0013, n=9

Appendix C Table 8: MMAU +3.5pp headline gain traced ~23/35 problems to one phoneme-counting template (153/1000 items); non-template remainder improves only +1.4pp and authors explicitly decline to claim improvement there
Appendix D: paired bootstrap 95% CI [+20.6,+29.8]pp and McNemar p<1e-20 for the label-free vs. baseline delta; Jaccard 0.75 overlap with labeled vector
Appendix A Table 5: full configuration (AdamW, lr 1e-3, 200 steps, G=32–64, last-checkpoint selection) but no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper

§5 Evaluation protocol and Appendix A Table 1 context notes: comparison numbers from prior work (e.g., TTRL rows, Sinii et al. rows) use different context lengths and decoding, acknowledged as following each source's own protocol
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/RL, test-time adaptation, parameter-efficient tuning). It asks a clean, unaddressed question: can TTRL's label-free majority-vote reward still drive adaptation when optimization is restricted to ~100K bias parameters on a frozen backbone? Rigor is strong: 3-seed mean±std everywhere, a 2×2 label-source × parameterization ablation (Table 2), parameter-matched controls (LoRA exact-match and a 100K ReFT variant, Table 1/6), a self-consistency baseline separating free voting gains from learned gains, held-out transfer to 4,500 verified-disjoint MATH problems (§6.3), and statistical tests (McNemar p<1e-20, Spearman ρ=0.917 p=0.0013). Confound auditing is unusually honest (MMAU gain traced ~2/3 to one phoneme template, Appendix C). Novelty is moderate: it is a combination of TTRL and Sinii et al.'s bias-only steering, and the theory (Hoeffding bound; projected-gradient descent lemma) is standard though honestly framed as qualitative and tested empirically. Weaknesses: single model family (Qwen2.5), training on the evaluation set per the TTRL paradigm (mitigated by held-out transfer but inherently test-set-coupled), comparison numbers from prior work under non-matched protocols (acknowledged in Appendix A), no code release stated. Extensive hyperparameter detail (Appendix A Table 5, Algorithm 1) aids reproducibility but no artifact availability is claimed.

primary_link.title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces

papers.summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudo-labels as rewards and optimizes only approximatel
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討測試時強化學習(TTRL)能否在獎勵訊號與最佳化空間同時嚴格受限下仍然有效。作者提出 label-free bias-only TTRL:以模型自身 rollout 的多數決偽標籤為獎勵,用 GRPO 僅訓練約 10 萬個 bias 參數(28 層 MLP 的 down_proj.bias),主幹模型全程凍結。在 MATH-500 上,Qwen2.5-Math-7B 達 79.50%、Qwen2.5-7B 達 76.67%,略勝同預算且有標籤的 bias-steering 重現結果,可訓練參數比全參數 TTRL 少約 76,000 倍;學得的 steering 向量還能遷移至 4,500 道未見過的 MATH 題目。同一流程亦改善 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista 與 MMAU 等視覺語言與音訊推理任務。相同預算下,bias-only 於六項基準全面優於 exact-match LoRA,並勝過多數較大的 LoRA;無 bias 的 ReFT 變體則常低於基線,顯示子空間的選擇比其大小更關鍵。理論上,多數決可靠性隨 rollout 數指數提升,而可及梯度能量決定子空間可訓練性,後者獲 Spearman ρ=0.917 的實證支持。限制方面,作者審計發現 MMAU 增益集中於單一音素計數題型(佔 15.3%),MathVista 有年齡差答題異常案例,AI2D 部分改善來自輸出格式解析,顯示無標籤獎勵可能強化模型既有偏誤。整體而言,本研究證明不需真值標籤與全模型更新,僅憑極小參數子空間即可有效調適凍結的多模態模型,是簡單且省參數的測試時調適途徑。

links.title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR) restoring execution to a selected prior state while carrying forward distilled reusable knowledge; claims up to 6.57 percentage points average success-rate improvement
Section 5.2, Table 1: RIR reaches 47.00% avg SR with Qwen3-14B (+3.09 over Reflexion 43.91) and 69.43% with DeepSeek-V3 (+6.57 over ReAct 62.86), best on all three benchmarks and both backbones

Section 4.5, Proposition 1 and Corollary 1: recovery-space inclusion argument showing restricted mechanisms induce policy classes contained in RIR's; Section 5.2 concedes this is 'a capacity statement rather than a performance guarantee'

Section 5.3, Table 3: ablations on ScienceWorld with DeepSeek-V3 only; full RIR 76.75% SR vs Reflection-only 70.48% and Rollback-only 69.37%; hybrid fixed review (69.00%) underperforms adaptive hybrid, supporting timing as a control decision
Section 5.2, Table 2: RIR executes 0.978 (Qwen3-14B) and 0.920 (DeepSeek-V3) rollbacks per task vs ~2.9 for GA-Rollback, supporting selective rather than frequent recovery

Section 5.1: acting agent and all RIR components use the same LLM to prevent attributing gains to a stronger auxiliary model; GAIA final-answer judged by an independent 'Qwen3.8-Max' judge not involved in trajectory generation
Section 5.1 and 5.3: reviewer/selector prompts, dataset details, and complete efficiency results deferred to an Appendix not included in the supplied document; no code or artifact release is stated
Title/author block: author names, affiliations, and email addresses are visibly misaligned/garbled, indicating metadata integrity problems in the source document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning/Reflection, memory). It proposes RIR, a training-free test-time recovery framework for long-horizon agents that jointly controls when to review (hybrid agent-initiated + adaptive scheduled review, Eq. 3-5), where to restore (coarse-to-fine checkpoint localization, Eq. 6-8), and what knowledge survives rollback (structured Reflection Memory, Eq. 9-10). Novelty is moderate: the when/where/what synthesis, adaptive review horizon, and validity-aware memory are sensible increments over GA-Rollback/WebRollback and the acknowledged concurrent AgentRewind (Section 2), and the formal theory (Proposition 1, Corollary 1) is a near-trivial subset-inclusion capacity statement, which the authors themselves concede is 'a capacity statement rather than a performance guarantee' (Section 5.2). Rigor is decent: three diverse benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, GAIA), two backbones (Qwen3-14B, DeepSeek-V3), five budget-matched baselines, ablations across all three design axes (Table 3, Figure 4), rollback-frequency efficiency analysis (Table 2), and same-LLM components to avoid auxiliary-model confounds (Section 5.1); but ablations cover only ScienceWorld, no variance/significance reporting, and single-run results are implied. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (Table 1: 69.43% vs 62.86% avg SR supports the claimed +6.57 points; 47.00 vs 43.91 supports +3.09), yet figures/appendix details are deferred and unverifiable. Reproducibility is weakened by an absent appendix (prompts and dataset details 'provided in Appendix'), no code release, and an ambiguous judge model name ('Qwen3.8-Max', Section 5.1); the title block also shows garbled author-affiliation-email alignment, a metadata integrity concern. Not a pure domain application, so it clears the scope floor comfortably.

primary_link.title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks through multi-step environment interaction, yet a single erroneous action can alter subsequent states and observations, causing errors to compound over time. Existing methods either correct the context without repairing altered environment states or restore earlier states while discarding useful experience, making it difficult to both eliminate failure conditions and avoid repeating past mistakes. We argue that reliable rec
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 代理人在長程任務中的錯誤復原問題：單一錯誤動作會改變後續環境狀態，使誤差隨時間累積。資訊層級的自我修正無法復原已造成的環境改變，狀態層級的回滾又會丟棄失敗軌跡中的有用經驗。作者將復原視為「回滾邊界」控制問題，須同時決定何時介入、回溯到何處、以及哪些資訊可跨越邊界保留，並提出 Rollback-Induced Reflection（RIR）框架：以混合自適應審查決定介入時機、以粗到細的還原定位選取檢查點、並以結構化反思記憶保留任務目標、環境知識、嘗試歷史與失敗分析，同時排除已失效的狀態主張。理論上，常見修正與回滾機制皆為其統一復原算子的受限特例，RIR 的最佳值單調性保證其可達成效不低於受限機制。實驗涵蓋 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 與 GAIA 三項基準及 Qwen3-14B、DeepSeek-V3 兩種骨幹，平均成功率最高提升 6.57 個百分點，且每項任務平均回滾次數低於一次，效率優於 GA-Rollback。限制方面，理論結果屬能力範圍陳述而非效能保證，錯誤診斷可能導致重訪無效分支，成效也取決於審查區間等超參數設定。此研究顯示可靠的長程代理人需要能將失敗互動轉化為後續決策基礎的復原機制。
papers.title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 回滾世界、保留反思：長程 LLM 代理人的回滾誘導反思

links.title: CERA-MoA: Co-Evolving Routing Mechanisms with Continually Learning LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'iterative reinforcement learning framework where the dynamic router and independent agent policies co-evolve'; §1 contributions list co-evolutionary MoA, predictive familiarity estimator, and cumulative-threshold routing.
§3.2, Eq. 2-4: familiarity score f_i(q)=exp(-λd_i(q)) from concatenated mid-layer hidden states (⌊L/2⌋, ⌊3L/4⌋) via trainable predictor head and frozen target head.
Table 1 (§4.2): Qwen3-4B ID avg 63.2 vs best baselines AT-GRPO 61.0, RouteMoA 53.1; Llama-3.2-3B avg 47.9 vs RouteMoA 43.3; but Llama MBPP 44.7 trails RouteMoA 49.0.
Table 2 (§4.2): OOD avg 72.8 (Qwen3-4B), 53.9 (Llama), 62.5 (Phi), 71.8 (heterogeneous) vs next best AT-GRPO 71.5/52.9/60.0/69.1.
Table 3 (§4.5): adaptive threshold 63.2 ID / 367.77 avg tokens vs fixed Top-2 63.3 ID / 666.37 tokens — token reduction rather than accuracy gain; §4.5 claims '~45%' reduction.
Table 9 (App. E.4): removing UCB/entropy exploration drops ID avg to 57.1 and OOD to 63.9 with t-SNE mode collapse (Fig. 12); Table 10: mid-layer features 63.2 ID vs final-layer 61.1.
App. E.3 Tables 7-8: threshold sensitivity sweep (τ=0.5-0.9) and re-training with τ=0.8 degrades peak ID to 61.2, supporting τ=0.7 choice.

Appendix B.2 Table 5: full hyperparameter schedule (seed 42, LoRA r=16/α=32, λ=2.0, τ=0.7, m=1.0, β=1e-4); Appendix B.1: 4×H200, vLLM, ~1 H200 GPU-day per 1,000 steps; Appendix C/D: reward formulas, prompt templates (Fig. 4), exact dataset splits; no code release URL stated.
Appendix F: limitations—routing is single-turn prompt-based and open-ended tasks default to single most-familiar agent output.
§4.1: baselines ICL-Router, LinUCB, RouteMoA (orchestration) and GSPO, MAPoRL, AT-GRPO (fine-tuning); identical generation hyperparameters and rewards enforced across baselines.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-relevant: a multi-agent LLM framework (Mixture-of-Agents routing co-evolved with continually RL-trained LoRA agents on Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B/Phi-4-mini) squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, and RL preferences. Core contribution—closed-loop co-evolution of a predictive familiarity router (mid-layer hidden states, BYOL-style push-pull heads) with agent policies, plus cumulative-threshold adaptive subset activation—is a sensible, moderately novel synthesis of routing and post-training. Experiments are broad (9 ID + 6 OOD benchmarks, homogeneous/heterogeneous pools, six baselines) with unusually thorough ablations (routing metric, threshold, temperature λ, margin m, exploration bonuses, hidden-state depth). Weaknesses: single seed (42) with no significance testing, narrow margins on some averages (e.g., OOD 72.8 vs 71.5), mixed per-benchmark results (Llama MBPP 44.7 vs RouteMoA 49.0), and the adaptive router is not strictly better than fixed Top-2 on ID avg (63.2 vs 63.3)—its benefit is framed honestly as a ~45% token reduction. No public code release is claimed despite extensive hyperparameter documentation.

primary_link.title: CERA-MoA: Co-Evolving Routing Mechanisms with Continually Learning LLM Agents

papers.summary: Current Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) paradigms generally treat query routing and agent fine-tuning as separate processes, limiting their ability to respond to evolving agent capabilities. This disconnect prevents routing strategies from adapting to evolving agent capabilities during post-training and prevents agents from achieving synergistic data-driven specialization. To resolve this, we introduce CERA-MoA (Co-Evolving Router with continually learning Agents for Mixture-of-Agents), an iterative rei
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對混合代理(MoA)架構中查詢路由與代理訓練彼此脫鉤的問題:現有方法多將路由視為靜態機制,無法因應代理在後訓練階段的能力演變,也缺乏動態分配訓練樣本的機制,使代理難以形成互補的專業分工。作者提出 CERA-MoA,一個讓動態路由器與多個持續學習代理共同演化的迭代強化學習框架。核心為預測式熟悉度估計器:從路由器凍結骨幹的中間層隱藏狀態萃取語意特徵,以可訓練預測頭與凍結目標頭之間的投影距離換算為指數型熟悉度分數,避免完整生成的高昂運算成本。路由採累積門檻自適應機制,僅啟用熟悉度總和達門檻的最小代理子集;訓練時加入 UCB 與熵項促進探索,代理端以 DAPO 結合 GSPO 序列級重要性取樣最佳化策略,路由器則依跨代理相對優勢以幾何推拉損失同步更新。實驗涵蓋數學、程式碼、指令遵循與一般推理,於 Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B、Phi-4-mini 及異質代理池上,分布內與分布外平均成績皆超越 ICL-Router、RouteMoA 等靜態路由,以及 GSPO、MAPoRL、AT-GRPO 等固定流程基準;自適應路由較固定 Top-2 減少約 45% 生成 token,路由延遲僅約 12 毫秒,代理亦自發分化為數學、程式等領域專家。限制在於目前僅針對單輪提示路由,開放式任務只輸出最熟悉代理的回覆。此工作證明路由與持續學習的閉環整合可在無人工角色指派下催生專業分工,對多代理系統設計深具參考價值。

links.title: Flag Game: A Toy Model for Mechanistic Swarm Interpretability

evidence: Sec. 4: broadcast social-awareness sweep shows 'terminal truth mass rises from 0.54 to 0.81' under unchanged peer reports
Sec. 5.1 / Fig. 7d: patching improvement 'decreases from 40% at N=8 to approximately 17% at N=128' averaged across ten runs
Sec. 5.2: model parameters 'a_T + a_R = 0.45 and h_0 = 0.3... chosen for qualitative agreement with the empirical population trends'
Appendix D, Table 2-3: 'All reported runs use temperature 0.2, top-p 1.0'; threshold robustness over consensus 0.75-1.00 and polarization 0.15-0.35
Appendix F, Table 5: attribution verified by patching, but Delta-A_i computed 'from one game per patch' on a single communication schedule
Appendix A (Limitations): 'We release only synthetic task and evaluation code'; compute 'approximately $25,000 total hosted API cost'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: multi-agent LLM swarms (GPT-4o, GPT-5.4, Claude models) studied through a mechanistic-interpretability lens with an AI-safety motivation (collective belief collapse/polarization). The 'mechanistic swarm interpretability' framing—social circuit attribution, agent patching, and a complementary statistical-mechanics model—is genuinely novel relative to multi-agent debate literature, and the authors honestly delineate limitations of the toy model. Rigor is solid for a model-organism paper: defined controls/observables, threshold-robustness sweeps, documented seeds and prompt ladders, and theory matched to an empirical phase diagram. Deductions: several results rest on small samples (one game per patch in Table 5; ten runs for the N=8-128 scaling claim), theory parameters are 'chosen for qualitative agreement' (Sec. 5.2), the task is a simple 28-flag identification problem limiting external validity, and the motivating 2026 incident/model references are unverifiable from the document, weakening the evidentiary grounding of the motivation though not the internal experiments. Code release, demo site, prompts, and full run settings support reasonable reproducibility despite proprietary models.

primary_link.title: Flag Game: A Toy Model for Mechanistic Swarm Interpretability

papers.summary_zh: AI代理群體湧現的協調行為已成重大安全風險,關鍵在於信念如何在個體間快速形成與散播。本文提出「Flag Game」玩具模型:隱藏國旗作為可驗證的真相,每個受限(bounded)代理僅能觀察私有裁切影像,再透過成對、廣播或管理者三種通訊協定交換信念。實驗操控群體規模、訊息頻寬、社會證據接受度、團隊組成與組織結構五項變數,發現集體準確率隨群體規模呈非單調變化:小群體易發生集體信念崩塌,大群體則轉為真相與對手信念對峙的極化而拉低效能;社會覺察提示與混合模型團隊能提升準確率,組織結構亦扮演關鍵角色。為剖析機制,作者提出社會線路歸因技術,預測哪個代理及其所見最能影響集體動態,並以代理修補(patch)進行因果驗證;但此介入效果隨規模增大而遞減,故另以證據狂熱者與偏誤複製建立統計力學理論,其理論相圖與實驗結果吻合。限制在於此為玩具模型,結論不應直接外推至真實部署的群體系統,結果亦受提示詞、資料集與協定細節左右。本研究開啟機制性群體可解釋性的道路,主張對齊AI群體可能需要新的集體描述變數,並指出就安全而言,更該警惕的或許不是分歧本身,而是社會壓力下形成的錯誤共識。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research: controlled factorial audit of LLM-as-a-judge oversight behavior, treating procedural traces (CoT-like narratives) and agentic verification claims as experimental treatments, analyzed via signal detection theory. Highly relevant to high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, agents, evaluation, interpretability). The SDT separation of sensitivity from decision criterion, and the counterintuitive finding that detailed traces induce over-skepticism rather than gullibility, is a genuinely novel framing beyond known judge biases. Rigor is strong: 5x19x2x4x2x3 fully crossed design (4,551/4,560 parsed), item-clustered logistic regression, log-linear SDT correction, human-validated reason coding (judge-human kappa 0.71-0.76), and multiple robustness checks (Section 5.7). Evidence supports the claims within the stated regime, though the ceiling hit rate limits the no-gullibility claim to visible evidence, and the reason-code decomposition rests partly on LLM self-reports. Generalizability is constrained: 19 restaurant-compliance items in one domain, single-criterion violations, five models with the two robust controls sharing a developer, and no human arm. Reproducibility is promising but unverified: stimuli, prompts, and scripts are only promised for release (Section 4.3), and three of five models are closed-weight with one run at an unpublished provider default.

primary_link.title: Beyond Accuracy: How Procedural Traces Shift the Decision Criterion of LLM Overseers

papers.summary: Organizations increasingly use oversight loops where one large language model (LLM) audits another's outputs alongside procedural traces of claimed steps. A common concern about such LLM-as-a-judge pipelines is that detailed traces make overseers gullible. Using signal detection theory, we audit five LLM overseers on 19 compliance tasks (4,551 analyzed judgments), varying only trace detail and evidence labeling. With disconfirming evidence always visible, error detection remains near ceiling. In
papers.summary_zh: 「讓 AI 檢查 AI」已成常見的監管做法,但實務上擔心詳盡的流程軌跡會讓 LLM 監督者過於輕信而放行錯誤。本文以訊號偵測理論切入,將監督者的「敏感度」(區分正確與錯誤答案的能力)與「決策準則」(需要多少疑慮才否決)分開衡量。研究採完全交叉的控制實驗:五位 LLM 監督者審查 19 個合規式推薦任務,在答案與證據不變下,只變動流程軌跡的詳細程度(從無軌跡到虛假驗證)與證據是否標註所屬選項,共分析 4,551 則判斷。結果與輕信假設相反:反證始終可見時,錯誤偵測率近乎上限;真正發生的是決策準則滑向否決——最易受影響的 qwen3-next-80b 誤拒正確答案的比例由 58% 升至 96%,軌跡每升一級,誤拒勝算比約增加 44%,且誤報時信心未見下降,難以用信心門檻攔截。人工驗證的理由分類顯示約六成誤報源於監督者無法將證據對應到選項,加上歸因標籤後該理由歸零,但殘餘的「過度懷疑」仍隨軌跡增加;兩個 frontier 模型則幾乎不受影響。限制包括僅 19 個單一準則任務、反證全然可見而無法檢驗隱藏錯誤情境,監督者樣本亦僅五個模型。作者主張 AI 稽核者應以決策準則與誤報行為、而非單一準確率來治理,並建議為證據加註歸因標籤等低成本修復。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent safety work: studies adversarial context manipulation (prompt sensitivity, injection-adjacent) of LLM pricing agents, defense evaluation, and activation probing. Novel angle in formulating presentation-only manipulation (no explicit instructions) in a multi-agent market and tracing propagation through strategic complementarity, though it assembles known pieces (framing/ordering sensitivity, indirect prompt injection, linear probing). Rigor is comparatively strong: formal threat model, matched neutral-text controls, a rule-based benchmark, per-condition Welch tests and CIs, and episode-held-out probes with seed-grouped folds and train-only layer selection (Section 4.5, Appendix G). Main weaknesses: stylized fixed-demand Bertrand setting limits external validity (Limitations), small n=5 seeds, one n=1 cell (Haiku aggressive), unadjusted p-values, DBA conflates prompt and projection components, and probes test only seen attack variants. Code is promised, not confirmed available; seeds are not propagated to sampling calls, limiting exact reproducibility (Appendix I.2).

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) pricing agents may respond to how market data is presented, even when its numerical values remain unchanged. We introduce market signal injection (MSI), an attack that manipulates numerical formatting, competitor ordering, or qualitative market commentary without issuing explicit instructions. We evaluate nine open-weight models in simulated Bertrand duopoly and triopoly markets and three proprietary models in duopoly markets. Sentiment-based attacks produce the larges
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出「市場訊號注入」（Market Signal Injection, MSI）攻擊：對手在無法存取目標系統提示或權重的情況下，僅透過改變 LLM 定價代理所見市場資料的呈現方式——數值格式（NFA）、廠商排序（COA）或定性市場評論（SCA）——且不下達任何明確指令，即可左右其定價決策。作者在模擬 Bertrand 雙占與三占市場評估九個開源權重模型，另以三個專有模型補充雙占實驗。結果顯示情緒評論造成最大偏移：「市場停滯」語句使 Gemma-9B 的合謀指數由 −0.15 降至 −3.84（衝擊量 3.69），且效果經由策略互補傳播至其他廠商，改變利潤與消費者剩餘；易感性因模型家族而異，較大模型並未一致地更穩健，格式與排序攻擊甚至可能反向上推高利潤。中立文字對照與規則式基準支持框架效應的解釋。在殘差流激活上訓練的線性與 MLP 探針，於十一個模型—條件配對均能區分基線與受攻擊狀態（線性 AUC 達 1.00），但可偵測性不等於能判定有害定價。防禦方面，輸入正規化（IC）可完全移除所測情緒攻擊，結合提示約束與輸出投影的決策邊界錨定（DBA）則僅提供部分緩解。限制包括市場為固定需求的對稱 logit 設定、探針未驗證對未知攻擊的泛化，且部分結果樣本有限。此研究指出資料呈現本身就是 LLM 定價代理的攻擊面，對演算法定價防護與競爭政策具重要意涵。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agent work: builds an automated benchmark for coding agents using an LLM-orchestrated mine-craft-patch pipeline and evaluates nine frontier LLMs (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5, Gemini, Grok). The factorization of web apps into replay-verified behaviors with prerequisite lineages and a controllable restoration-depth axis is a genuine contribution beyond SWE-bench/ProgramBench/WebArena, though it extends rather than replaces existing verifiable-SWE paradigms (gold patches, F2P/P2P from SWE-bench). Rigor is solid: counterfactual mask validation (Build=1, prerequisites pass, target fails, §2.3), gold-patch positive controls, isolation safeguards (App. C.1), and a context-length confound analysis (App. H.3) showing depth decline persists within matched prompt-size bands. We introduce ProgramDistill, a benchmark evaluating coding agents on features discovered through interaction with fully functional reference applications. papers.summary_zh: 編碼代理（coding agents）慣於在以 issue 或指令明確描述目標行為的基準上受評估，但實務網頁開發常須從可運作的參考應用程式推斷行為，再於不完整的實作中重建。本文提出 ProgramDistill 基準，以全自動 mine–craft–patch 管線：挖掘可重播的瀏覽器互動軌跡並依前置依賴組成譜系、遮罩原始碼以製作修復任務與 gold patch，再要求代理僅憑參考應用的可觀察行為進行修復或重建。全程無需人工介入，在 26 個應用上挖掘出 1,975 個經重播驗證的行為、建構 4,063 個任務，並以修復深度控制難度。實驗顯示：部分應用重建中 GPT-6 Astra 平均 binary 分數為 84.3%，Claude Opus 5 為 68.7%；完整應用重建中 Astra 累積恢復率僅 49.2%，Opus 5 為 28.8%。當修復深度由 1 增至 8，成功率從 100% 降至 64.0%、96% 降至 32%，且代理對每個目標行為的觀察與編輯投入不成比例地縮減；失敗分析指出 59.2% 的完整重建失敗源於從未觀察到的參考行為，深度效應亦無法僅以較長上下文解釋。限制包括僅採結構化瀏覽器觀察而無截圖輸入、限於自足式網頁應用、基準品質繫於建構模型（GPT-5.6 Sol）的能力，並有被誤用於克隆專有軟體的風險。此工作證明可執行軟體能成為可驗證規格、任務與學習訊號的可擴充來源，為編碼代理的評估、診斷與未來課程式訓練奠定基礎。

papers.summary: Lindsey et al. (2025) report that Claude 3.5 Haiku plans rhymes: features for candidate rhyme words are active on the newline before a line is written, and a suppress-and-inject intervention redirects the line only when applied there (their Figure 13). We test how far this generalizes on seven cells crossing four open models (0.6B to 2.6B parameters) with six open cross-layer transcoders (CLTs), on one consumer GPU, decomposing the claim into position specificity (C1), newline site identity (C2)
papers.summary_zh: Lindsey 等人(2025)報告 Claude 3.5 Haiku 寫押韻詩時會預先規劃韻腳:候選韻詞特徵在換行詞元處激活,抑制並注入的引導干預也只在該處生效(其 Figure 13)。本文在單張消費級 GPU 上,以四個開放基礎模型(Gemma 2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B、Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B)搭配六個開放跨層轉碼器(CLT)組成七個實驗格,將該結果拆解為位置專一性(C1)、換行位置身分(C2)與換行上的規劃表徵(C3)三項可檢驗主張;因歸因圖工具不可得,特徵改採自解碼器向量的自下而上挖掘。結果:C1 在 7/7 格與 247/247 個可偵測配對皆成立,但有效位置是緊鄰輸出的最終提示詞元,且隨機方向亦集中於該處,僅量級可區分真特徵;只有兩個 mntss 格達行為級機率(0.48、0.85)。C2 與 C3 皆未復現:普查未見換行處有押韻預期特徵的富集;組合視界實驗(36 次執行、8,640 行)顯示換行引導只捕獲下一個詞元(注入詞成為行首 1,540/1,545 行),六詞之後的韻腳不受影響;最後,無需轉碼器的激活修補在 1,260 行中僅 11 行改變韻腳(基線 4 行,解析度 1.4%)。限制:模型規模(0.6B 至 2.6B)遠小於原受試模型、自下而上特徵發現偏向輸出端、提示組合有限、修補實驗僅涵蓋單一模型。作者將此詮釋為邊界條件而非反駁:在此規模與這些轉碼器下,因果位置緊鄰輸出,傾向即興選韻的解釋,並示範再現研究應回報絕對機率、基線與可偵測的最小效應。

Appendix D (Figs. 7-9): full Theory/Action scoring rubrics and router prompt templates are printed, supporting reproduction of the LLM-judge pipeline.
Section 5.5/Appendix E: largest gains on lowest-resource languages (+12.9pp Hindi, +5.6pp Swahili, Fig. 3); leakage protocol separates test-set isolation from source-included pool design.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference work: an LLM-based post-retrieval quality-estimation layer for multilingual agent skill selection sits squarely in Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG/reranking, and multilingual NLP. Method is a sensible but conceptually simple combination of known ingredients (LLM rubric scoring à la DEITA/M-DaQ, reranking à la ToolRerank/SkillFlow, hand-designed domain-routed fusion), so novelty is moderate. Rigor is above average: 9 domain-retriever settings, six external baselines, view ablation, budget/router/backbone robustness sweeps, hyperparameter stability analysis, and paired bootstrap significance tests; main deductions are small evaluation sets (94/265/52 tasks), author-constructed pools, hand-set fusion constants, and Gemini-3-Flash serving as scorer, router, and solver in main runs (self-preference risk only partially mitigated by Fig. 6). Evidence is solid and checker-based but the headline gains (+3.5pp avg) come from modest-scale self-built benchmarks. Generalizability is decent across three domains, seven languages, six regions, and six backbone configurations, though limited to three instantiated skill domains. Reproducibility is strong: code, pools, tasks, rubric prompt templates, and hyperparameters are released.

primary_link.title: M-SQE: Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation for Enhancing Language Equality in Agentic Skill Use

papers.summary: Agent skills, reusable procedural documents that extend LLM agents beyond their parametric memory, have become an important interface for deploying agents on real-world tasks. Community-maintained skill libraries built around this interface are growing rapidly. However, this ecosystem remains deeply English-centric: our audit finds that low-resource languages such as Swahili and Hindi have no in-language skill content, so retrieval often returns a skill written in a different language than the q
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 AI 代理技能生態系統嚴重偏向英語的問題：作者稽核約 84,700 筆社群技能條目，發現斯瓦希里語與印地語等低資源語言完全沒有母語技能內容，代理只能檢索跨語言且品質不穩定的候選文件，導致任務成功率下降。作者提出 M-SQE，一個檢索後的多語言技能品質估計框架，從兩個互補視角為候選技能評分：Theory 視角評估內在品質（正確性、完整性、可執行性、跨語言忠實度、在地化、上下文效率），Action 視角評估對特定查詢的任務適配效用與誤導風險；再由準確率 98.5% 的領域路由器依任務類型融合分數——一般任務採凸組合、工具使用採 Theory≥65 門檻保護、文化任務採三視角 z 分數等權融合。實驗涵蓋一般技能、工具使用與文化技能三領域，搭配三層技能池與三種檢索器：M-SQE 在九種設定皆居首或並列第一，平均成功率 69.1%，較最強基線 SkillFlow 高 3.5 個百分點；印地語提升 +12.9pp、斯瓦希里語 +5.6pp，六個文化區域均有穩定增益。限制為框架只能在檢索候選內挑選、無法自行創作技能，評估亦僅涵蓋三個領域。此研究的意義在於讓低資源語言與非西方文化社群的使用者也能信任代理的技能選擇，縮小代理時代的語言與文化不平等。
papers.title: M-SQE: Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation for Enhancing Language Equality in Agentic Skill Use
papers.title_zh: M-SQE：多語言技能品質估計，促進代理技能使用中的語言平等

links.title: M$^3$P-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Guided Multi-Modal Motion Planning via MIP Code Generation

evidence: Abstract: claims 91.7%/80.9% single-/multi-modal success, +26.4/+40.6 pp over GPT-5.2, and 87.5% real-world transfer
Section 4, Table 1: mean±std over three runs; Ours 91.7±0.6 / 80.9±2.3 SR vs GPT-5.2 65.3±6.5 / 40.3±4.0
Section 4, Table 3 and surrounding text: matched-budget reward ablations; removing R_corr at 800 GRPO steps drops SR 84.8%→50.3%
Appendix C.4-C.5, Tables 5-11: held-out composition/grasp/UAV splits and Obstacle/Agent/Spatial-OOD with disclosed degradation (e.g., held-out composition SR 60.2%)
Section 4, Table 4: Expert-MIP control shows fixed expert modules reach 100.0% single-modal but only 55.6%/63.2% multi-modal vs 80.9% for M3P-R1
Section 2: authors state jointly coupling task-level choices with continuous feasibility is not their novelty
Section 5 Limitation: pipeline limited to static environments and to MIP problems already formulated by human experts
Section 3: 'We will release the LLMM3P Bench dataset, training code, and model checkpoints upon acceptance' (conditional availability)
Appendix H.1, Tables 13-14: LoRA rank 16, KL coefficient 0.0, reward weights λ=(1,2,1,1), 1x H100 ~30h training, vLLM inference at ~4.5s/task
Appendix E, Table 12: 40 real trials, 35/40 success, five failures individually attributed (3 sim-to-real mesh, 2 Tello sensing)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper, not pure robotics: the core contribution is reinforcement fine-tuning (SFT + GRPO with solver-verifiable rewards, LoRA on Qwen3-8B) teaching an LLM to generate executable MIP code with chain-of-thought and tool/API use, plus a new benchmark. This strongly matches LLM, reasoning, agents/tool-use, code, and RL preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental: the paper itself concedes in Section 2 that joint discrete-continuous coupling 'is not itself our novelty'; the delta over LLM+P, RLVR, and LLM-for-optimization work is applying solver-grounded RFT to approximate robotics MIP with cross-modal coupling synthesis. Rigor is high: many prompt/symbolic/sampling baselines, an Expert-MIP control isolating cross-modal gains (80.9% vs 63.2% GPT-5.2, Table 4), matched-budget reward ablations (Table 3), three held-out structural splits and three OOD difficulty splits with honestly reported degradation (Appendix C.4-C.5), variance over three runs, and a run-to-run reconciliation note. Evidence is verifiable: Table 1 supports the headline 26.4/40.6 pp gains; Table 12 sums to the claimed 35/40 hardware trials with a per-failure breakdown. Generalizability is limited by 23 hand-crafted modality APIs and the stated limitation that only human-formulated MIP problems are covered (Section 5); environments are static. Reproducibility is good on paper (full hyperparameters in Appendix H, 1xH100/30h, vLLM inference) but release is only promised 'upon acceptance' (Section 3) and the headline GPT-5.2 baseline depends on a proprietary pinned API.

primary_link.title: M$^3$P-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Guided Multi-Modal Motion Planning via MIP Code Generation

papers.summary: Multi-Modal Motion Planning (M$^3$P) requires joint reasoning over continuous motions and discrete mode transitions, making it difficult to solve efficiently. For instance, a bipedal robot may walk to a target location and then use its arms to grasp an object. This scenario captures both mode transitions and continuous dynamics, yielding feasible paths that neither purely discrete nor continuous planners can handle. While Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) offers a principled framework, constructin
papers.summary_zh: 多模態運動規劃（M³P）要求機器人同時對連續運動與離散模式切換進行聯合推理，例如雙足機器人先行走至目標處再伸手抓取物件，傳統純離散或純連續規劃器難以兼顧此類混合決策空間。本文提出 M³P-R1，以強化學習微調大型語言模型（基礎模型為 Qwen3-8B），將自然語言描述的任務分解為混合整數規劃（MIP）的決策變數、約束與目標函數，並生成可執行的 Python 程式碼，交由 CVXPY 與 Gurobi 求解器執行驗證，避免 LLM 直接輸出答案常見的幻覺問題。訓練採兩階段：先以監督式 fine-tuning 學習單模態範例的程式結構，再以 GRPO 搭配求解器可驗證的獎勵（格式、API 涵蓋率、執行成功與任務正確性）進行最佳化。作者並建立 LLMM³P Bench 基準，含 1,316 道題目，涵蓋 5 種單模態任務與 8 種多模態組合。實驗顯示 M³P-R1 在單模態與多模態任務分別達到 91.7% 與 80.9% 成功率，較最強的純提示基線 GPT-5.2 提升 26.4 與 40.6 個百分點，消融實驗確認任務正確性獎勵貢獻最大，模型亦能泛化至未見過的模態組合與更難的障礙、代理數量與空間關係設定。方法進一步轉移至 Franka Panda 機械臂與 DJI Tello 無人機等真實硬體，40 個情境中獲得 87.5% 成功率，失敗主要源自模擬到真實的落差。限制包括僅支援靜態環境、仰賴人類專家已建立的 MIP 形式化與問題特定的離散化近似。此研究示範求解器在迴圈內的強化微調能讓 LLM 產生可驗證、可靠的機器人規劃程式，對 Task and Motion Planning 與可信 AI 助理的發展具重要參考價值。
papers.title: M$^3$P-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Guided Multi-Modal Motion Planning via MIP Code Generation
papers.title_zh: M³P-R1：透過 MIP 程式碼生成之強化學習引導大型語言模型的多模態運動規劃

links.title: Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models

evidence: Abstract: 'At 50% pruning, HOPE outperforms all baselines and achieves an average rank of 1.58 out of 5 methods (versus 2.42 for the next-best method, REAP), with gains of up to +6.1% on agentic coding.'

Section 4.1: 'Models: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B ... Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ... GLM-4.5-Air'; 'Baselines: REAP, EAN, MAN, Frequency'; 'This gives 54 total configurations (3 models x 2 calibration sets x 6 pruning rates for Tulu, or 3 pruning rates for SWE-Bench Pro).'
Section 4.2: 'top-1 in 39% of conditions, top-2 in 67% of conditions' and 'HOPE is robust: it finished last in only 1/54 conditions ... In contrast, REAP had 5 last-place finishes.'
Section 3.5: 'HOPE with zeroed off-diagonals empirically recovers the same prune-set as REAP (Figure S4)'; Figure S4 reports Spearman rho = 0.988 between diagonal of F and REAP scores.
Appendix A.6-A.7: full Cauchy-Schwarz upper-bound derivation of Theorem 1 and binary QP formulation of Theorem 2 with F-matrix definition (Eq. 3).
Table S6 (GLM-4.5-Air SWE-Bench Pro, SB-verif 50%): REAP 40.21 vs HOPE 40.78, but at Evol-CA 25% REAP 34.06 > HOPE 32.80, showing mixed head-to-head outcomes in places.
Section 4.5 / Figure 6: SFT for 1B tokens on pruned Qwen3.5-122B-A10B; 'fine-tuning narrows the gap but does not close it.'
Appendix C.7, Tables S8-S9: CHOPE 'performed reasonably well, although not as well as per-layer HOPE' and 'occasionally experienced performance collapse' (e.g., 25% SWE-Bench Pro 27.29 +/- 17.51).
Limitations: 'HOPE's calibration step takes about 6-7% longer than REAP on the same-size calibration set (Table S7)' and 'HOPE prunes experts in each layer independently.'

Appendix D: 'Code for HOPE is available at https://github.com/awslabs/hybrid-model-factory/tree/main/examples/research/HOPE/' with solver settings (SciPy SLSQP, tolerance 1e-12, 1000 iterations) and evaluation configs; Reproducibility statement says code 'will be released upon publication.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-LLM methodology paper (MoE expert pruning for memory-efficient deployment), highly aligned with LLM, MoE/Transformer, efficiency, coding, and agentic preferences. Genuine methodological novelty: first second-order (pairwise interaction) pruning objective with a proven upper bound (Theorem 1), a QP formulation (Theorem 2), and a proof that REAP is the zero-interaction special case (Sec 3.5, Fig S4 Spearman 0.988). Rigor is strong: 3 models up to 122B, 2 calibration sets, 6 pruning rates, 54 conditions, 3 calibration trials with reported std devs, full derivation in Appendix A, and honest reporting of losses (e.g., REAP beats HOPE on GLM-4.5-Air 50% SB-verif mean, Table S6; HOPE last in 1/54 conditions, Sec 4.2). Evidence is credible but lacks statistical significance testing, and gains at low pruning rates are marginal; claims like +6.1% agentic coding and best rank 1.58 at 50% are traceable to Tables S4-S6 and Sec 4.2. Generalizability supported by 3 architectures and 2 calibration domains, though only Qwen3.5/GLM families; the cross-layer CHOPE extension shows unstable, mixed results (Tables S8-S9), which the authors candidly flag. Reproducibility is good: public models/datasets, a concrete GitHub link (Appendix D), solver details (SLSQP, tolerance, iterations), and stated code release. Minor inconsistency between 'available at' (App D) and 'released upon publication' (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models

papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models suffer from large parameter counts, which create a significant memory bottleneck. Expert pruning is the most direct approach for reducing this parameter count, yet existing methods make pruning decisions for each expert independently, and assume experts' contributions are purely additive. In reality, expert usage in MoEs is inherently cooperative. We derive HOPE (Higher-Order Pruning of Experts), a second-order pruning objective which provably minimizes a
papers.summary_zh: 混合專家(MoE)語言模型雖能以較少的每 token 運算量提供高容量,但全部專家必須常駐 GPU 記憶體,與 KV cache 競爭空間,形成部署瓶頸。永久移除整個專家的專家剪枝是縮減參數量最直接的途徑,但現有方法皆屬一階方法,獨立為每個專家計算重要性分數,忽略專家間的協同互動;在高剪枝率下,同時拆散多組合作專家,會造成一階分數無法預測的效能傷害。本文提出 HOPE,一個二階剪枝目標:在校準時記錄專家的成對共同貢獻,建立每層互動矩陣 F,並將剪枝決策表述為二次規劃,可證明最小化剪枝誤差之上界;先進的 REAP 正是 HOPE 忽略互動項的特例。實驗涵蓋三個前沿 MoE 模型(最大 122B 參數)、兩組校準資料、六種剪枝率及多項基準。在 50% 剪枝率下,HOPE 於五種方法中平均排名第一(1.58,次佳的 REAP 為 2.42),在代理式軟體工程任務最多領先 6.1%,且與理論預測一致:剪枝率越高優勢越大,分析也證實其優勢源自保留具較強合作結構的專家。限制包括二次統計量使校準時間增加約 6-7%,需稍多校準資料,且目前僅處理層內互動;跨層版本 CHOPE 的初步結果仍不穩定。HOPE 讓 MoE 得以在幾乎不損失效能的前提下大幅壓縮,對實際部署與記憶體節省意義重大。
papers.title: Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models
papers.title_zh: 混合專家語言模型中的高階專家剪枝(HOPE)

links.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening

evidence: Abstract: identifies Value Flattening as critic predictions remaining 'comparatively flat' while MC state values 'change sharply', and proposes SP3O with 'only three states supervised per response'.

Section 4.2, Eq. (5): MSE decomposition (v_bar - R)^2 + (1/T)sum(v_t - v_bar)^2 showing dense terminal-only supervision imposes an 'implicit variance penalty' on within-response predictions; Figure 3b reports gradient similarity decreasing with token-position separation.

Section 5.1: experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k against PPO and GRPO baselines; evaluation on AIME24/25/26, AMC23, MATH500, Minerva, OlympiadBench plus OOD suite (ARC-C, MMLU-Pro, GPQA, AGIEval, BBH, ZebraLogic) with avg@32 and avg@4 protocols.
Table 1: SP3O average 45.57 vs PPO 37.60 and GRPO 39.26 on Qwen3-4B-Base math (avg@32); Table 2 shows OOD average 59.28 vs PPO 51.95 for 4B.

Section 5.3: ablation over supervised anchors K in {3,4,8,16,64} shows sparse K=3 best and dense K=16/64 'approaching the dense PPO baseline'; Table 3 shows random placement (36.59) underperforms fixed 0.3/0.6/0.9 placement (45.57).
Appendix Table 5: adding tail anchor improves accuracy 44.10 to 45.57 and reduces repetition 18.33% to 1.12%.

Appendix A.1 Table 4: full hyperparameters (actor lr 1e-6, critic lr 4e-6, Adam betas (0.9,0.98), clip 0.2, KL coefficient 0, rollout batch 512); Appendix A.1 details adaptive MC continuation sampling with 95% Wilson CI half-width <= 0.04.

Section 3.1: 'the KL coefficient is zero and the task reward is terminal... binary in our experiments', and Section 5.3 concedes 'the variance across runs is non-negligible', indicating limits to generalization and statistical support; code claimed at https://github.com/Dodojordi/SP3O.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic: analyzes and improves PPO critic learning for LLM reasoning (Qwen3-4B/8B post-trained on DAPO-Math-17k), squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, RL/RLHF methodology, and reasoning. Core contribution is a newly named failure mode ('Value Flattening'), a mechanistic analysis (implicit variance penalty from Eq. 5 decomposition plus redundant temporally-correlated updates), and a simple sparse-supervision fix (SP3O, 3 anchors at 0.3/0.6/0.9) with consistent gains (Table 1: 45.57 vs PPO 37.60 on 4B math; Table 2 gains on OOD; both model sizes). Rigor is good: PPO/GRPO baselines, controlled FrozenLake scaling experiment, anchor-count (K=3..64) and placement ablations, formal error/gradient decomposition in Appendix A.2, and carefully specified diagnostics (Wilson-interval MC estimation, response AUC, effective rank). Weaknesses temper the score: no seeds/significance tests and authors concede 'variance across runs is non-negligible' (Section 5.3); analysis confined to terminal binary rewards with KL=0 (Section 3.1), so applicability to standard RLHF with dense/process rewards or KL penalties is untested; single model family (Qwen3) and single training dataset; several key claims rest on qualitative figures rather than reported statistics. Reproducibility is decent: public code URL, models, data, and full hyperparameters (Appendix Table 4). Novelty is solid but the variance-penalty identity is elementary and the intervention is a simple supervision-subset change, so not exceptional.

primary_link.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening

papers.summary: In reinforcement learning for large language models, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) commonly uses a critic to estimate state values and reduce the variance of policy updates. However, we uncover a systematic failure mode in PPO critics, which we call Value Flattening: state values, estimated from multiple Monte Carlo continuations, change sharply across intermediate states while critic predictions remain comparatively flat. We further observe this phenomenon in a controlled FrozenLake enviro
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究強化學習訓練大型語言模型時,PPO中critic的一個系統性失敗模式。作者發現並命名Value Flattening(價值平坦化)現象:以多條Monte Carlo延續估計的狀態價值,在回應的中間狀態間會劇烈變化,但critic預測卻相對平坦;在受控制的FrozenLake環境中亦觀察到此現象,且隨狀態空間擴大而更為明顯。理論分析指出兩個成因:其一,在終端獎勵設定下對每個token位置套用MSE損失,會隱含懲罰回應內的預測變異,推使預測趨於平坦;其二,相鄰狀態僅差一個token、高度時間相關,其表示與梯度相似,密集監督因此產生大量冗餘更新。據此,作者提出SP³O(SParse Proximal Policy Optimization),僅在每條回應中少數幾個彼此充分分離的狀態(如相對位置0.3、0.6、0.9)施加價值損失。在Qwen3-4B-Base與Qwen3-8B-Base上的實驗顯示,僅監督三個狀態即可緩解Value Flattening,於AIME、MATH500等數學推理以及ARC-C、MMLU-Pro等分布外評測均優於標準PPO與GRPO,數學推理較PPO提升約7.97個百分點,訓練動態也更穩定。消融實驗顯示監督點增至16或64個時效能反而下滑,執行間變異不可忽略,且驗證主要限於數學與推理類任務,為其限制。本研究的價值在於揭露critic學習中長期被忽略的失敗模式,並示範極簡的稀疏監督策略即可顯著改善LLM強化學習訓練成效。
papers.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
papers.title_zh: 重新思考PPO中的Critic學習:理解與緩解Value Flattening現象

links.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch

evidence: Abstract: 13 language-model workers over ~12 days published 1,703 contributions and drove the evaluator from 3.39 to 1.899 bits per byte, closing 62% of the gap to a trained GPT-2 124M; 165 independent reproductions posted, none failed.
Section 4.8: 'We did not rerun the winning method; the primary result is the archived evaluator output, corroborated by the agents' cross-hardware reproductions.'

Section 5 (Conclusion): 'we did not run the same models and compute without Agora or with a plain leaderboard, and the community left its first basin only after we showed it a map' - causal benefit deferred to Appendix C matched evaluation.
Section 4.7: single mid-run human intervention on May 2 deployed clustering/diversity views; first sub-1.90 result appeared the next morning, an acknowledged confound.
Section 4.5 Table 4 note: milestones 'are stages of a search, not a controlled ablation'; final 9e-6 bpb change is below cross-hardware variation.
Section 3.4: Go service prototype with 26 HTTP routes, 15 CLI command groups, Docker image described, but no public code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core multi-agent/LLM-agent infrastructure paper: 13 coding-agent sessions (Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5) coordinate through a Git-backed contribution DAG to solve an LM weight-transfer task, strongly matching Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences. The durable cross-session shared memory, verification-weighted DAG scoring, and diversity-aware UCB attention allocation are a genuinely fresh combination relative to episode-scoped frameworks (AutoGen, MetaGPT), though built from standard components (Git, SQLite, bandit ranking). Descriptive methodology is careful and honestly scoped (Section 4.8 triple-level audit, recompute of all statistics, algebraic score check, code-chain reading), and limitations are candidly stated: no control arm without Agora, all steps selected on one development evaluator, and a confounding mid-run human deployment of diversity views. However, the causal claim that shared memory improves discovery per compute is explicitly deferred (Appendix C), verifications are agent-performed with zero failures raising self-selection concerns, and the authors did not rerun the winning method. Single task, single run, and no stated public release of code or run artifacts limit generalizability and reproducibility despite strong internal determinism and provenance design.

primary_link.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch

papers.summary: Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended. Run several of them and each session starts from scratch, so more agents tend to mean more duplicated search rather than more discovery. Agora is a shared memory for such agents: research is recorded as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) stored in Git, so that every claim is a commit anyone can check out and rerun. Each result, insight, hypothesis, verification, and report
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 Agora，一個以 Git 作為共享記憶體的集體自動研究協調層。作者觀察到，自動研究代理若各自為政，每次 session 皆從零開始，增加代理只會帶來重複搜尋而非更多發現。Agora 將研究過程記錄為僅能附加的有向非循環圖：每項貢獻都是不可變的 Git commit，父邊代表「建立在何者之上」，並以衍生索引呈現研究前沿、被忽略的分支與驗證狀態，再以兼顧品質與多樣性的 UCB 規則分配注意力，防止社群塌縮為單一主流。論文報告首次長期實測：13 個語言模型代理在近 12 天、無中央規劃者的情況下，於權重轉移任務發表 1,703 項貢獻。任務要求在無訓練資料、無梯度更新的限制下，僅利用 141 個預訓練 donor 模型，初始化一個維度與任何 donor 都不匹配的 119.6M 參數注意力—SSM 混合模型。最佳結果將評估指標由隨機初始化的 3.39 降至 1.899 bits per byte，縮小 62% 與訓練過的 GPT-2 124M 之差距；勝出方法把 donor 的下個 token 統計壓縮進嵌入層與輸出頭，再對注意力、前饋與狀態空間區塊施加稀疏修改，其血統含 145 個 commit、橫跨 15 個帳號，並有 165 次獨立重現且無一失敗。限制包括：所有分數皆在同一開發評估器上挑選，缺乏與無 Agora 或純排行榜的對照組，因果效果未經檢驗；社群走出單一解的局部盆地有賴一次人為介入，作者亦未親自重跑勝出方法。本文的意義在於指出協調層而非個別代理才是擴展自動研究的瓶頸，並提出對照評估矩陣供後續量測。
papers.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
papers.title_zh: Agora：以 Git 作為集體自動研究的共享記憶體

links.title: DualSQL: Text-to-SQL with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: DualSQL-4B reaches 68.0% execution accuracy on BIRD dev matching prior 7B models; DualSQL-8B reaches 71.1%, claimed SOTA for single-model solutions vs a 32B baseline (Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, Table 1).

Section 5.2.3 (Ablation Studies): under identical data/reward/hyperparameters, multi-turn agentic RL gains 2.3% EX and 5.4% REX over single-turn, and multi-agent RL adds a further 1.5% EX and 1.9% REX on BIRD-Dev.
Section 4.3 & Table 5: replacing EX with the proposed REX metric as reward raises single-agent 8B REX from 63.7 to 66.7 while EX moves 69.2 to 69.6, supporting the cleaner-reward claim.
Appendix D (Table 8): removing the SQL Execution tool drops SQL-generation EX by 2.5 points and REX by 6.8 points; every tool removal hurts, confirming the toolset ablation.
Section 5.1 (RL Setup): GRPO implemented on VeRL, lr 2e-6, batch 256, group 16, 32K token trajectory limit, Qwen3-4B/8B bases; Appendix B reports 4.5 days on 32 H100s for the 8B run.
Limitations section: restricted to read-only DB access, Qwen3 backbones only, REX acknowledged as an imperfect proxy reward; no code or checkpoint release is stated anywhere in the paper.
Section 5.2.2 (Table 4): out-of-domain Spider results (83.1 EX for DualSQL-8B vs 82.7 single-agent) show the recipe generalizes within SQLite text-to-SQL but only across these two benchmarks.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit paper: multi-agent agentic RL (GRPO/VeRL) with a shared Qwen3 backbone and three DB tools for Text-to-SQL, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, Code, and RL preferences. Contribution is a sensible but incremental composition (joint schema-linking+SQL agents, rollout guardrails, new REX reward/metric) over existing RLVR text-to-SQL work it cites (e.g., MARS-SQL, Arctic-Text2SQL-R1). Rigor is above average: controlled single-turn vs single-agent vs multi-agent comparison on identical data/hyperparameters (Table 4), REX-vs-EX reward ablation (Table 5), guardrail ablation (Fig 2), per-tool ablation (Table 8), oracle-schema headroom analysis (Table 3), 8-run means with std. Caveats: headline baselines use different base models (Qwen2.5-Coder) than the paper's Qwen3, guardrail ablation rests on a single training-curve figure, manual error analysis is small-scale. Generalizability limited to SQLite/BIRD/Spider and Qwen3; no explicit code or checkpoint release statement, only hyperparameters, prompts, and REX pseudocode in appendices, so reproducibility is middling.

primary_link.title: DualSQL: Text-to-SQL with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: State-of-the-art Text-to-SQL systems are typically multi-agent pipelines centered around two fundamental tasks: schema linking and SQL generation. However, existing work trains separate models for each task, failing to leverage the synergy between these interrelated tasks. In this work, we propose DualSQL, a new Text-to-SQL system consisting of two agents powered by a single model backbone. The agents share the same model weights and agentic scaffold, enabling joint optimization through a robust
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 Text-to-SQL（文字轉 SQL）系統中結構連結（schema linking）與 SQL 生成兩大核心任務長期被分開訓練、無法發揮協同效應的問題，提出 DualSQL 系統。該系統以單一共用參數的 Qwen3 開源模型為骨幹，同時驅動結構連結器與 SQL 生成器兩個代理，並配備 SQL 執行、全文檢索與資料庫剖析三種資料庫存取工具，使代理能透過多輪互動進行以資料庫為據的推理與驗證。訓練上採用多代理強化學習框架，並設計 rollout 護欄機制——嚴格格式檢查、rollout 中斷與損失遮罩——以穩定訓練、避免模式崩潰；另提出更嚴謹的 SQL 正確性指標 REX（robust execution match），修正傳統執行準確度 EX 對重複列與欄位順序的誤判。僅以 3755 筆 BIRD 訓練範例，DualSQL-4B 在 BIRD 開發集達 68.0% EX，媲美先前 7B 模型；DualSQL-8B 更達 71.1% EX，超越先前以 32B 參數建構的單一模型最佳方案，並在 Spider 測試集展現跨資料集泛化能力。消融實驗證實多代理聯合最佳化、REX 獎勵訊號與 rollout 護欄皆帶來顯著增益，工具消融則顯示 SQL 執行工具最為關鍵。限制方面，REX 仍屬 SQL 等價性的代理指標，可能產生誤判，獎勵設計亦缺乏細粒度的過程級訊號，且代理僅限唯讀資料庫存取。此研究證明聯合多代理強化學習是打造高效能 Text-to-SQL 系統的有效途徑，對以小型開源模型建構自然語言資料分析應用具重要意義。
papers.title: DualSQL: Text-to-SQL with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: DualSQL：以多代理強化學習進行文字轉 SQL

links.title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts

evidence: Abstract: framework 'matches state-of-the-art LLM-judge and rule-based guardrail baselines while producing deterministic, reproducible verdicts and, in the online mode, orders-of-magnitude lower per-call latency.'
Section 6.1, Table 2: ContrAgent mean success/safety 90/98 vs base 91/32, prompt 64/94, LLM-guard 24/98; median extra runtime +0.135 s vs +0.905 s (prompt) and +1.34 s (LLM-guard).

Section 6.2, Table 3: on gpt-4o AgentDojo, ASR falls 47.7%->11.1% (no-detector) and ->0.79% (trace-learned) at 0.16 ms/call vs ~50-500 ms for classifier/LLM-filter baselines; utility from published runs (replay-based).

Section 6.3: R-Judge average F1 91.8% (97.0% precision, 87.0% recall) vs GPT-4o 74.4% and human ~89%; AgentAuditor outperforms 'at the cost of a Gemini-2 judge with retrieval over an experiential memory.'
Section 6.4 and Appendix F, Table 9: Claude 3.7 achieves pass_4 of 25-60% but joint_4 of 0% in all three tau2-bench domains (procedural violations on every reliable run).

Section 6.1/6.3 contract provenance caveat: 'We build each domain's agent contracts from its public SOP' and 'Contracts come from R-Judge's risk taxonomy'; Section 6.2 trace-learned contracts 'mined from the recorded traces of the attacks themselves' — benchmark-aware authoring may inflate safety/F1.

Limitations: 'enforces only what the tool-call structure exposes'; 'the library is inspected by humans before use; autoformalization of natural-language policies is out of the scope'; counters 'trust the framework to report events faithfully.'

Reproducibility: Section 6 footnote 1 gives https://github.com/yfxiao16/ContrAgent; implementation in Python 3.12 with Z3 and mus2muc; latency measured on Apple M4 Pro (24 GB); Appendix C reports per-model recall/FPR across 23 backbones (FPR <1% for 19/23).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope: a deterministic formal-methods framework (A/G contracts, ALTLf, DFA monitors) supervising tool-calling LLM agents, aligning strongly with Agents & Tool Use (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8), and LLMs (2.5). Novelty is moderate-good: the dual-role single artifact (online gating + offline grading) and model-agnostic contract library are genuine advances over per-action guards (AgentSpec) and probabilistic shields, but build on established runtime-verification and LTLf techniques. Rigor is solid with clear formal definitions and four benchmarks, yet contracts are co-authored from benchmark policies (SOPs, R-Judge taxonomy), and AgentDojo baselines use published numbers with replay-based utility. Evidence is quantitatively detailed (Table 2 SOPBench 90/98 vs base 91/32; Table 3 ASR 47.7%->0.79% at 0.16 ms; Appendix C 23-model study; Table 9 Claude 3.7 joint_4=0%), including an honest grounding-oracle ablation and limitations section, though some cited works (2026 venues) are unverifiable from the text. Generalizability is demonstrated across models within domains but requires per-domain contract authoring and covers only tool-call-structural properties. Reproducibility is aided by a public GitHub link, deterministic verdicts, and stated stack/hardware.

primary_link.title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented by tools can automate complex, multi-step tasks, such as web navigation, code generation, and workflow orchestration, by acting on external systems through tool calls. However, hallucinations, distributional instability, and adversarial manipulations in LLMs, and the irreversible consequences of certain tool calls can lead to harmful outcomes. Existing safeguards either grade recorded trajectories post hoc with stochastic LLM judges or block unsafe act
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 ContrAgent,一套以合約為基礎的符號化時序監督框架,旨在解決 LLM 代理於工具呼叫時的安全風險。問題:LLM 的幻覺、分佈不穩定與對抗性操縱,加上部分工具呼叫具有不可逆後果,可能造成傷害;現有防護不是以隨機性的 LLM 評審做事後軌跡評分,就是逐次阻擋單一動作,缺乏單一確定性機制同時支援線上防護與離線評估。方法:ContrAgent 將代理行為形式化為工具呼叫軌跡,以有限軌跡線性時序邏輯(LTLf 與其算術擴充 ALTLf)撰寫假設—保證合約,並編譯為確定性有限自動機(DFA);同一檢查器可在線上閘控呼叫、離線評估軌跡,合約庫與模型無關、可跨代理重複使用。結果:在 SOPBench 將安全性由 32% 提升至 98%,成功率維持 90% 且額外運行時間遠低於提示法或 LLM 防護;在 AgentDojo 將提示注入攻擊成功率自 47.7% 降至最低 0.79%,每次呼叫僅增加 0.16 毫秒;在 R-Judge 達 F1 91.8%,超越 GPT-4o 與人類基線;在 τ²-bench 以聯合指標揭露 Claude 3.7 雖有 25–60% 成功率卻持續違反程序規則。限制:僅能監督工具呼叫結構可見的行為,語意性危害需另做內容層級檢查,合約庫目前仰賴人工審查。價值:為 LLM 代理提供確定性、可重現且低延遲的監督基礎。
papers.title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts
papers.title_zh: 運用合約對 LLM 代理進行符號化時序監督

links.title: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making

evidence: Abstract: 'when historical statistical patterns are disrupted, the benefits of longer context largely vanish, degrading decision quality to the no-context baseline in a way sharply amplified by stronger strategic interdependence'
Section 3.4: 'Experiments are run on GPT-5 and Qwen3-Plus... The main text reports representative results from GPT-5. Cross-model comparisons are provided in Appendix F.'
Section 4.2: 'for β=0.25, ED drops from 6.18 to 0.84; for β=0.75, from 11.14 to 5.60' under monotonic sequences with k=3
Section 4.3: 'for β=0.25, ED remains above 6.5... for β=0.75, ED exceeds 13.88, R²eq becomes negative at k=0, and slopes stay far below −10 (e.g., γ=−3.03 at k=6)'
Table 1 (Section 4.4): full ED/R²eq grid across five trajectories, two β values, and k∈{0,3,6} showing trend-dependent improvement
Appendix B.2: 'The estimation sample contains 7,800 observations from the full-factorial experimental design' with price-path fixed effects and HC3 robust SEs (Table 4)
Appendix A.1-A.3: existence/uniqueness proof of the REE fixed point and β-independent normalized benchmark N_eq(p~)=−10p~+n
Section 7 Limitations: 'we evaluated only two model families... the analysis is purely behavioral... we employed a fixed prompt format, and sensitivity to linguistic framing was not assessed'
Appendix E: decoding parameters given (GPT-5: temperature=0.7, top_p=1.0, top_k=20) with temperature=0.35 robustness reruns, but no code/data availability statement and no prompt template shown
Appendix F.1: Qwen3-Plus replication 'show[s] high consistency in qualitative trends with the GPT-5 agent' though 'generally less sensitive to changes in price trends'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical match: a controlled study of LLM agents' in-context learning mechanisms (GPT-5, Qwen3-Plus) in multi-agent games, directly probing whether ICL reflects recursive reasoning or statistical extrapolation. The diagnostic is genuinely novel: exploiting the history-independence of rational expectations equilibrium (Section 2.2) to disentangle mechanisms by reordering identical price sets (Section 3.2). Rigor is solid - hypotheses H0/H1 are falsifiable, the game has a proven unique equilibrium (Appendix A), and full-sample analysis uses 7,800 observations with fixed effects, Yeo-Johnson transformation, and HC3 robust SEs (Appendix B.2). Evidence is quantitatively consistent: monotonic sequences cut ED from 6.18 to 0.84 (β=0.25) while jump sequences leave ED above 6.5/13.88 with near-zero or negative R²eq at high β (Section 4.3, Table 1), replicated qualitatively on a second model family (Appendix F.1) and across temperatures (F.2). Capped by: only two proprietary models, one game structure, short contexts (T=6, k≤6), purely behavioral analysis (Section 7), number of independent repetitions per condition unclear, no code/data release, and a minor inconsistency where Appendix B.2 labels c∈{1,7,13} messages as 'rounds of history'.

primary_link.title: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making

papers.summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve decisions using interaction history, yet it remains unclear whether such improvement reflects refined internal reasoning or mere extrapolation of statistical patterns. To disentangle these mechanisms, we study LLM agents in multi-agent incomplete-information games that require recursive belief reasoning. By constructing a public goods game and manipulating the statistical structure of historical feedback, we evaluate
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探究大型語言模型（LLM）代理在多代理相互依賴決策中的 in-context learning（ICL），究竟源自內部遞迴信念推理，或僅是對歷史統計模式的外推。作者以重複的 n 人公共財賽局為實驗平台，並引入理性預期均衡（REE）作為與歷史無關的理性基準：理論上最適門檻策略僅取決於當期公開成本與賽局基本結構，與歷史序列排列無關。實驗系統性操弄兩個面向——策略相互依賴強度 β（0.25 與 0.75）與回饋序列的統計結構（單調 vs. 跳躍式），並改變上下文長度（k=0、3、6 輪），以 GPT-5 與 Qwen3-Plus 驗證。主要證據顯示：當價格序列呈清晰單調趨勢時，加入歷史能大幅降低均衡偏離指標 ED，並使迴歸斜率趨近理論值 −10；一旦趨勢被跳躍序列破壞，較長上下文的效益幾乎消失，決策品質退化至無歷史基準，且高 β 會顯著放大此失敗。此結果支持 ICL 在此類策略環境中主要運作為統計外推，而非朝均衡方向的遞迴信念更新。限制包括僅測試兩個模型家族、單一賽局結構、較短上下文、純行為面分析與固定提示格式。本研究的價值在於將 REE 的歷史無關性轉化為區分推理與外推的診斷工具，並提供可重複調整參數的實驗框架，有助於刻劃 LLM 遞迴推理能力的邊界。
papers.title: Recursive Reasoning or Statistical Extrapolation? In-Context Learning in Multi-Agent Interdependent Decision-Making
papers.title_zh: 遞迴推理或統計外推？多代理相互依賴決策中的 in-context learning（ICL）

links.title: AutoTuneBench: Trustworthy Measurement for Agent Auto-Tuning of LLM Serving Engines

evidence: Abstract: best gelu kernel reads 10.6x against a naive baseline but 2.03x against the honest one; KernelBench Level-1 admits 51% of tasks with median speedup 1.0001x over PyTorch eager
Section 2.3: four failure modes documented from a four-day pilot corpus of 619 model calls, including 97.3% of 148 calls truncated at a max_tokens=4096 default
Section 4.1/5: protocol frozen in config/protocol.yaml with test-enforced provenance and database-level ingest rejection; regression suite of more than 290 tests
Section 6.1, Table 2: external anchoring against Astra's published SGLang speedups yields 1 of 5 cells in-band (parity 1.047) with mechanistic explanations for the rest
Section 6.2, Table 3: pre-registered on/off A/B nulls at a shared wall (2.4840 vs 2.4957 ms); both arms fail the pre-registered 15-usable-iteration bar (11 and 14)
Section 6.4, Table 5: seeded random-proposer control sustains 3 of 20 usable iterations vs 11 and 14 for the LLM arms at $0 API cost
Section 6.5, Table 6: SGLang ngram speculative decoding sustains 1.2561x (run 1) and 1.2753x (extension) over its own frozen default across 18 ngram measurements
Section 6.7: graduated 11.03x gelu variant reads 0.79x against a re-derived Apple MLX baseline, reported as held-out non-transfer
Section 6: all GPU measurements on a single DGX Spark GB10 box; cross-architecture evidence limited to anchoring and one sanctioned MLX retest
Footnote 1 / Section 7: code and measurement corpus released at github.com/li-ch/autotunebench (tag v1.0.0) with audit trail
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic: a measurement-integrity benchmark for LLM-agent auto-tuning of serving engines (vLLM/SGLang), touching agents, LLM inference/serving, evaluation methodology, reward hacking, and kernel code generation. Novelty is solid: making trust 'architectural' (protocol-as-code with test-enforced provenance, DB-level ingest rejection, anti-cheat gates outside the agent's modification surface, pre-registered readouts, external anchoring) is a fresh framing versus generator-centric systems (KernelBench, Astra, Sakana), though it inherits classical autotuning norms (OpenTuner/Ansor) and benchmark-integrity practice. Rigor is high for a systems benchmark: pre-registered A/B with treatment-delivery checkpoints, a seeded random-proposer control (Table 5), 53/53 re-measurement reproduction with 0.60% median deviation, digest-pinned engines, and ~290 regression tests; honest reporting of a required-n failure (11/14 usable vs bar of 15, §6.2) and a failed 1.2x median-speedup bar strengthens credibility. Evidence strength is tempered: all GPU results come from one box (DGX Spark GB10, §6), external anchoring lands in-band on only 1 of 5 cells with the rest explained post hoc (§6.1, Table 2), and the headline positive (SGLang 1.2561x/1.2753x, Table 6) is from one 7B model on a small flag space. Generalizability is limited by single-box scope, and the paper's own held-out device retest (§6.7: 11.03x certified on GB10 reads 0.79x on Apple MLX) demonstrates non-transfer, which it honestly frames as a protocol feature. Reproducibility is strong: released code/corpus at a tagged repo (footnote 1), frozen protocol file, pinned engine digests, paired seeds, ledgered costs (~$4.35 total), and audit trail.

primary_link.title: AutoTuneBench: Trustworthy Measurement for Agent Auto-Tuning of LLM Serving Engines

papers.summary: Large language model agents tune GPU kernels and serving engines through a closed loop of propose, measure, and keep, but the measurements behind this loop are not trustworthy. We characterize four failure modes from a four-day pilot corpus of 619 model calls: strawman baselines manufacture speedups, absolute times do not transfer across machines, saturated tasks nullify comparisons, and infrastructure defects impersonate science. We present AutoTuneBench, a benchmark and measurement protocol th
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型(LLM)代理自動調校 GPU kernel 與推論服務引擎時,背後測量不可信的問題。作者從四天試驗語料庫歸納四種失敗模式:稻草人基準誇大加速、絕對時間無法跨機器比較、任務飽和使比較失效,以及基礎設施缺陷偽裝成科學發現。為此提出 AutoTuneBench,主張信任必須是架構性的:測量協定以程式碼凍結並經測試強制溯源,資料庫層級驗證器在寫入前拒絕違反協定的結果,反作弊檢查置於代理無法修改的範圍之外(含 10 倍異常斷路器與執行時期回退計數),A/B 比較遵循預註冊讀數與處理遞送檢查點,並以外部公開結果錨定,搭配配對種子統計與 5% 跨執行變異係數上限。誠實測量改寫了結論:最佳 gelu kernel 相對稻草人基準為 10.6 倍,相對誠實基準僅 2.03 倍;KernelBench Level-1 有 51% 任務正確,但對 PyTorch eager 的中位加速僅 1.0001 倍,未達 1.2 倍門檻;預註冊 A/B 在共同效能牆上得到真實的 null;SGLang 的 ngram speculative decoding 則持續貢獻 1.256 倍吞吐量。限制包括所有 GPU 測量皆來自單一 DGX Spark(GB10 晶片)機器,跨裝置只能以比率與錨定驗證,且部分 A/B 臂未達預註冊的 15 次可用迭代門檻;畢業變體在保留裝置上重測僅 0.79 倍,顯示加速不可跨裝置宣稱。本研究的價值在於證明審計軌跡與架構化防護能揭露代理無法自行寫入的缺陷,為自主調校系統樹立可信度量的典範。
papers.title: AutoTuneBench: Trustworthy Measurement for Agent Auto-Tuning of LLM Serving Engines

links.title: Ask the Tool, Don't Guess: Agent Tool Calls Hold Their Progress, and the Serving System Should Read It

evidence: Abstract: end-to-end result 'cuts the p90 time to first token (TTFT) after a tool call by 20.7% (HBM only) and 20.8% (HBM + DRAM) against LRU, close to an oracle'.
Section 2.1 / Figure 2: motivation quantified — 'fewer than three percent of tool calls hold almost two thirds of all tool time' in mini-SWE-agent leaderboard runs.

Section 2.1 / Figure 3: replay experiments show same command 'finished an order of magnitude faster' on an idle sandbox and rank correlation collapses under contention, supporting the no-pre-call-estimate claim.

Section 4.2 / Figure 7: at 50% of each call progress-stream median error is 'about a fifth of the call's duration' vs 'a third for the best history predictor'; at 90%, 'under 10%, against 80% for the best history predictor'.

Section 4.3 / Table 4: agent-cost measurement with 95% bootstrap intervals across stock/side-channel/prompt/de-suppressed configurations; 'neither changes the agent's score significantly' (100 SWE-bench Verified tasks).
Section 4.3: strong signal covers 38%/51%/48% of tool time and weak signal raises this to 66%/59%/72% across the three corpora (Figure 4a, Table 2).
Section 5.3: adversarial analysis is 'a preliminary simulation' where 'lying raised the memory the liars held by 6%, and the two ledgers took 5% of it back' — no full adversarial evaluation.
Section 5.1: end-to-end replay on 'a 4x H100 SXM instance in two configurations' — single hardware setup, replay rather than live serving.

Section 5.2 / Figure 10: gain decomposition by call length, 'reaching 34.2% and 35.3% at ten seconds or more'; per-phase ablation attributes remaining oracle gap mostly to uncovered channels (63% vs 17% recovery).
Limitations: paper itself bounds scope — remote APIs that 'answer only at the end', human-in-the-loop waits, and unparsable outputs are outside the census; 'coverage' is named as the limiting factor.
Appendix D: vLLM patch described as 'a few hundred added lines' with three hint operations (refresh/release/query); no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit agentic serving paper: tool-call progress reporting for KV cache management squarely matches the top-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Inference & Serving, Long Context & Memory), with coding-agent workloads and MCP hooks as secondary fits. Novelty is solid but bounded: the central insight is an acknowledged transfer of database progress-indicator lessons (Chaudhuri et al. 2004/2005) to LLM serving, with the first serving-side consumer and first tool-call progress census as genuine additions. Rigor is strong in structure — four reimplemented published baselines (Continuum, CacheWise, TokenCake, InferCept), oracle bound, controlled load-condition replays, per-phase ablation, cross-model checks, and bootstrap intervals for agent cost (Table 4) — but evaluation is replay-based on one 4xH100 setup, headline TTFT gains lack variance/repetition reporting, and controller thresholds are under-specified. Evidence is concrete and multi-point (median error ~1/5 vs ~1/3 of duration at 50%, <10% vs 80% at 90%; 20.7%/20.8% p90 TTFT cut vs 23% oracle), though the adversarial-lying analysis is self-described as preliminary. Generalizability is limited by the paper's own census: remote-API and human-wait calls are unreadable, coverage rather than precision is the binding constraint, and validation is coding-agent-centric despite a model-agnostic harness. Reproducibility is middling: methods, instruments, corpora, and the vLLM patch (Appendix D) are described in detail, but no artifact or code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Ask the Tool, Don't Guess: Agent Tool Calls Hold Their Progress, and the Serving System Should Read It

papers.summary: An agentic request spends substantial wall-clock time waiting for tools, and its KV cache holds GPU memory the whole time. Serving systems decide whether that cache stays, leaves, or comes back by guessing how long the tool will run, from the tool's name, its history, a duration declared before the call, or the engine's own occupancy. We show that no estimate fixed before a call starts can know its duration, and such estimates may not even rank the calls. Meanwhile, the running tool already hold
papers.summary_zh: 代理式（agentic）請求在等待工具呼叫（安裝、編譯、測試等）時，其 KV 快取持續占用 GPU 記憶體，而現有服務系統只能依工具名稱、歷史時長、呼叫前宣告或引擎佔用率猜測時長。本文論證：呼叫前估計無法得知實際時長，因為時長由機器負載、沙箱鄰居與遠端 API 狀態決定，歷史紀錄也與產生它的環境綁定；且極少數長呼叫即占去約三分之二的工具時間。作者主張讓執行中的工具回報自身進度，並建置一套不改變代理所見輸出的擷取機制：透過側通道重新啟用進度條、以 dry run 取得總數、監看磁碟上出現的目標檔案，並在代理自寫腳本中加入進度輸出。對四個公開代理語料庫的普查顯示，強訊號（剩餘工作比例）涵蓋約 38%–51% 的工具時間，加上弱訊號（僅知接近結束）可達 59%–72%。在 KV 決策的關鍵時點，進度串流的中位數誤差約為呼叫時長的五分之一（中點）、低於 10%（90% 處），遠優於已發表的歷史型預測器，且環境變動時仍保持準確；代理在 SWE-bench Verified 上的分數無可測量損失。以數個小型提示（hint）整合進 vLLM 後，工具呼叫後的 p90 TTFT 較 LRU 降低 20.7%（僅 HBM）與 20.8%（含 DRAM 分層），接近 oracle。作者另以額度機制將進度回報視為不受信任輸入，初步模擬顯示謊報影響有限。限制包括部分呼叫本身不含可讀資訊、陌生輸出格式需要新解析器，以及擷取手段可能改變工具行為。此工作是首個在伺服器端消費即時、可修正進度回報的系統，並呼籲工具主動暴露自身狀態。

links.title: Beyond Truncation: Rethinking LLM Decoding as Ensemble Pruning

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: frames candidate token selection as ensemble pruning with a Mahalanobis distance-driven objective and adaptive-bandwidth kernel over token embeddings

Section 4.1: evaluation on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, Phi-4-mini-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct at T in {1.0,1.5,2.0} with N=512 candidate pool and lambda=0.9; official code at https://github.com/sapphirexdy/ME_decoding
Table 2 (Section 4.2): GSM8K average accuracy 72.66 (Ours) vs 70.62 (Top-W) and 66.97 (p-less); Table 3: GPQA 32.96 vs 31.56 (Top-W)
Section 3.4, Theorem 3.1/3.2: greedy unimodality under condition kappa_N(K) <= 1 + lambda*H2^T(p), and approximation bound (1 - exp{-lambda_min(K,N)}) via submodularity ratio (Appendix A proofs)
Appendix B.2, Table 8: true kernel 62.32 vs permuted kernel 61.15 vs identity kernel 60.85 on GSM8K (Qwen2.5-1.5B), supporting the geometry contribution
Table 5 (Section 4.3): ME-Decoding beats size-, entropy-, and cosine-matched probability-only controls on both GSM8K and GPQA over three seeds
Appendix B.7, Tables 15-16: best results under both DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GLM-5.2 judges with positive paired-bootstrap 95% CIs against Top-W, p-less, Top-H
Appendix B.4, Table 11: end-to-end GPU latency increase ~5.8% (Qwen2.5-1.5B) and ~1.5% (Qwen3-4B); Table 4 reports 2.7x-7.4x lower CPU sampling overhead than Top-W
Limitations: static (non-contextual) token embeddings, diversity not always highest among decoders, and subset-size rule may not be optimal for all distributions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference methodology: a plug-and-play decoding scheme (ME-Decoding) recasting token selection as Mahalanobis-distance ensemble pruning, evaluated on LLMs (Qwen3-4B, Phi-4-mini, Mistral-7B) for reasoning (GSM8K, GPQA) and open-ended generation (MT-Bench, AlpacaEval) - strongly aligned with LLM, reasoning, and inference/serving preferences. Novelty is moderate: geometry-aware and entropy-adaptive decoders (Top-W, CraEG, Top-H, Min-p, p-less) already exist; the ensemble-pruning lens and adaptive-bandwidth kernel are a fresh but incremental framing, and the greedy algorithm is acknowledged as OMP-related. Rigor is above average: Theorems 3.1-3.2 give unimodality and spectral approximation guarantees with full proofs (Appendix A), kernel ablations (identity/permuted, Table 8), component ablations (Table 9), matched probability-only controls (Table 5), lambda sweep (Table 12), 512/512 empirical unimodality (Table 10), and two-judge evaluation with paired bootstrap CIs (Appendix B.7). Gains are consistent but modest (GSM8K avg 72.66 vs 70.62 for Top-W, Table 2; GPQA 32.96 vs 31.56, Table 3) and baselines win several individual settings, tempering evidence strength. Theory rests on an unverified sufficient condition (kappa_N(K) <= 1 + lambda*H). Generalizability limited to <=7B models and short-form generation; authors flag contextualized kernels and long-form/multi-sample settings as future work. Reproducibility is good: public code link, specified hyperparameters (lambda=0.9, N=512), seeds, and hardware (Appendix B).

primary_link.title: Beyond Truncation: Rethinking LLM Decoding as Ensemble Pruning

papers.summary: We introduce Mahalanobis-Ensemble Decoding (ME-Decoding), a novel Large Language Model (LLM) decoding framework that frames candidate token selection as ensemble pruning. Existing selection strategies rely predominantly on scalar probabilities, ignoring geometric semantic relationships and causing candidate redundancy. Meanwhile, current geometry-aware methods often require complex optimization or directly reweighting the original token probabilities, leading to significant computational overhea
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 解碼策略的核心限制：Top-k、Top-p、Min-p 等方法僅依賴純量機率截斷，將候選 token 視為獨立結果，忽略嵌入空間的語意幾何結構，造成候選冗餘；現有幾何感知方法則需複雜最佳化或重加權，帶來運算負擔或不穩定。作者提出 Mahalanobis-Ensemble Decoding（ME-Decoding），把逐步 token 選擇類比為集成學習的剪枝問題：機率對應個別準確度，嵌入相似度對應冗餘度。方法定義 Mahalanobis 距離驅動的 MEE 能量，結合依據 Tsallis 熵調整的規模懲罰構成 MES 目標；相似度矩陣以自適應頻寬的高斯核於正規化嵌入上建構。針對此 NP-hard 問題，作者設計貪婪前向選擇演算法，增量維護反 Cholesky 因子，提前停止下複雜度近似線性於候選數，並證明路徑單峰性與近似保證。實驗於 Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini 與 Mistral-7B 上，ME-Decoding 在 GSM8K、GPQA 平均準確度與 MT-Bench、AlpacaEval 皆取得最佳平均表現；CPU 抽樣開銷比 Top-W 快約 2.7 至 7.4 倍，GPU 端到端延遲僅增約 1.5% 至 5.8%。限制包括相似度矩陣採靜態嵌入、難以捕捉上下文語意，多樣性未必最高，最佳子集大小仍不易決定。整體而言，此研究提供免訓練、即插即用的推論時解碼新典範。
