links.title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: ComPO is a zeroth-order alignment method using comparison oracles to extract signal from low-margin ('noisy') preference pairs without optimizing a differentiable preference loss, motivated by likelihood displacement.

Theorem 3.2 (Section 3.1) and Appendix B.2: best-iterate convergence guarantee under ℓ-smoothness, approximate gradient sparsity (‖∇f‖₁≤√s‖∇f‖), and oracle compatibility with a latent objective f—assumptions the paper admits are theoretical benchmarks, not practical criteria (Remark 3.3).
Section 4.3 / Algorithm 4 discussion: the length-normalized statistic (Eq. 14) and soft damping (Eq. 15) are heuristics; the text states Algorithm 4 'cannot be covered by Theorem 3.4'.

Table 1 (Section 4.1): DPO_clean+ComPO raises AlpacaEval 2 LC (Mistral-7B-Instruct 24.14→26.17; Llama-3-8B-Instruct 32.92→35.79) but Arena-Hard drops 14.4→10.5 for Mistral-7B-Instruct, attributed only speculatively to raw-WR length bias (avg length 513 vs 468).

Tables 4-7 (Section 4.2): ablations over perturbation count m (800-5400), perturbed layers, entry threshold λ_g (best at ~1-6% entries retained), and noisy-pair count (100→300) report mean±std over five runs.
Section 4.1: experiments use UltraFeedback, hyperparameters (δ_margin=3, r, m=1600-1800, λ_g, λ=0.2) and 30 NVIDIA A40 GPUs are specified; no public code release is mentioned.
Table 10 (Section 4.3): online damping and replay improve metrics (e.g., Qwen3-4B-Base AE LC 16.20→17.43→18.57; Gemma-3-4B-it Arena-Hard 57.7→63.3→63.7) over offline ComPO.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope: an LLM preference-alignment method (ComPO) targeting likelihood displacement in DPO-style direct alignment, squarely matching LLM and Alignment/RLHF preferences. The zeroth-order comparison-oracle mechanism is adapted from 1-bit compressed sensing (SCOBO/Sign-OPT) rather than invented, and comparison/ranking oracles for RLHF already exist (Tang et al. 2024b; Zhang & Ying 2025), so novelty is moderate; the online extension reuses the coverage analysis of Song et al. (2024b). Rigor is solid: two theorems with proofs (Theorems 3.2, 3.4, Appendix B), but they rest on a latent smooth sparse-gradient oracle-compatibility assumption that is unverifiable, and the practical schemes (output-layer-only perturbation, entry thresholding, length-normalized damping) are acknowledged to fall outside the theory (Section 4.3 states the practical online scheme 'cannot be covered by Theorem 3.4'). Evidence is mixed: consistent LC gains across five model families (Tables 1, 3, 10) with five-run ablations reporting mean±std, but main tables are single-run point estimates, judge models switch between GPT-4 Turbo and GPT-4.1 across tables, and a clear regression is unexplained beyond length confounds (Arena-Hard 14.4→10.5 for Mistral-7B-Instruct, Table 1). The pair-level likelihood diagnostics (Table 2) cover only two models. Hyperparameters, datasets, checkpoints, and hardware are documented, but no code release is stated, limiting reproducibility for an m=1600-1800, 30-GPU method.

primary_link.title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment

papers.summary: Direct preference alignment methods are widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because of their computational and memory efficiency. However, likelihood displacement motivates alternative ways to extract information from preference pairs with small likelihood margins. In this paper, we propose and analyze Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO), a zeroth-order alignment method based on comparison oracles. ComPO extracts directional information from thes
papers.summary_zh: 直接偏好對齊方法（如 DPO）雖具計算與記憶體效率，但存在 likelihood displacement（似然位移）問題：當偏好對中偏好與不偏好回應在模型度量下相似、似然邊際極小時，直接以固定邊際損失最佳化，可能降低偏好回應的絕對機率，造成非預期的未對齊。作者提出 ComPO，一種基於比較神諭的零階對齊方法：不對這類 noisy 偏好對最佳化可微分損失，而是擾動目前政策，檢驗擾動是否同時提高偏好回應似然並降低不偏好回應似然，再將一位元比較信號聚合為正規化更新方向；實作上僅擾動輸出層權重並做逐項門檻化。線上版本進一步利用未標記的政策生成，以 reverse-KL 代理量阻尼步長並搭配重播緩衝區。理論上，在平滑性、梯度稀疏性與神諭相容假設下證明離線方案的最佳迭代收斂保證，並在精確 reverse-KL 限制與局部覆蓋條件下建立線上性能界。實驗於 Mistral、Llama-3、Gemma-2、Qwen3、Gemma-3 進行，ComPO 接在 DPO 或 SimPO 之後多半提升 AlpacaEval 2 LC、Arena-Hard 與 MT-Bench 表現，成對似然診斷與緩解似然位移一致；僅更新約 1% 輸出層參數，GPU 記憶體峰值遠低於 DPO。限制包括理論假設潛在目標與稀疏梯度未必成立、實務啟發式（長度正規化阻尼、重播）未被理論涵蓋，且 Mistral 在 Arena-Hard 原始勝率反而下滑。本工作顯示小邊際偏好對仍蘊含可用資訊，透過比較信號安全地擷取，可作為現有直接對齊方法的模組化補充。

links.title: Disentangling Long-Term Memory via Latent Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning

evidence: Section 5.2 Table 1: LGM averages 72.28 (Qwen2.5-7B) and 66.16 (Gemma3-4B), improving over strongest baseline MemCoE by +11.20 and +11.70; values marked * are taken from MemCoE [37]
Section 5.4 Table 2: on PersonaMem-v2, LGM with Qwen3-4B reaches 62.9 (32K) and 51.9 (128K) vs GPT-5-Chat 45.6/41.4, with 32K/128K GPT numbers taken from the original benchmark
Section 5.3 Figure 4: ablations of -SAE, -GNN, -Reconstruct all degrade performance; -Reconstruct causes the largest drop, especially on implicit preferences
Section 4.3 Eq. 8: evidence-reconstruction loss requires the same prefix to reconstruct supporting evidence text to prevent latent prefix collapse

Section 5.1 Implementation Details / Appendix D Table 5: layers {8,16,24,32}, latent dim 32, concept dim 256, T=4 message-passing steps, 16 prefix tokens, seed 23, 8x H800; no code or data release is stated anywhere
Appendix B: all baselines run with recommended settings from public codebases under same backbones; Appendix D notes backbone is fully fine-tuned by default with optional LoRA variant
Section 5.6 Figure 6: accuracy peaks around 16 latent prefix tokens and saturates/declines with more, consistent across both backbones

Appendix A Table 4: benchmarks summarized as PersonaMem (32K/128K, up to 60 sessions), PrefEval (3,000 preferences, explicit/implicit splits), PersonaMem-v2 (implicit focus, preferences never stated verbatim)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent memory research directly matching multiple high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Long Context & Memory, LLMs, RAG, latent reasoning). The method combines known ingredients (sparse autoencoders, relational GNNs, prefix conditioning) into a reasonably fresh query-conditioned latent graph formulation with an evidence-reconstruction anti-collapse objective. Evaluation is broad: 3 benchmarks, 3 backbones, ~15 baselines across 4 families, component ablations, efficiency frontiers, and a token-budget sweep. Main deductions: single fixed seed with no variance or significance testing; Table 1 mixes copied MemCoE numbers (*) with own runs, undermining protocol uniformity; fully fine-tuning the backbone on benchmark data is not matched by non-training baselines like Long Context/Naive RAG, potentially inflating gains; 'neuro-symbolic' framing is thin since no genuinely symbolic component exists; no code release statement despite exhaustive hyperparameter disclosure. Comparisons against official GPT-5/GPT-4.1 numbers on PersonaMem-v2 are fair but indirect.

primary_link.title: Disentangling Long-Term Memory via Latent Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning

papers.summary: Personalized agents are required to reason over long-term history interactions to infer both explicit preferences and implicit behavioral evidence. While early flat retrieval methods score memory fragments independently and neglect the distributed information, current structured memory frameworks rely on query-agnostic static graphs that fail to capture the context-dependent relations. Crucially, raw textual memories are inherently entangled and noisy, making fine-grained personalization and cro
papers.summary_zh: 個人化代理須在長期互動歷史中推理，才能同時掌握明確陳述的偏好與隱含的行為線索。既有做法或將記憶片段獨立評分而難以串連分散證據，或依賴與查詢無關的靜態圖，且原始文字記憶糾纏多雜訊，推理成本高昂。本文提出 LGM，將長期記憶解糾纏搬入連續潛在空間：彙整骨幹語言模型多層隱藏狀態，把每則互動與查詢映射為低維潛在節點，以稀疏自編碼器拆解為稀疏概念；邊權重由查詢與記憶的概念重疊決定，使同一記憶池在不同提示下形成不同拓撲；關聯式圖神經網路在活化子圖上傳遞訊號，讀出緊湊圖狀態並轉為少量潛在前綴 token 供生成條件化，再以證據重建損失防止表徵塌縮，全程端對端可微最佳化。實驗於 PersonaMem、PrefEval 與 PersonaMem-v2 隱含偏好子集，搭配 Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma3-4B、Qwen3-4B 骨幹：LGM 平均準確率達 72.28 與 66.16，領先最強基線 MemCoE 逾 11 個百分點；在 PersonaMem-v2 上以 4B 模型達 62.9（32K）與 51.9（128K），超越 GPT-5 系列閉源模型，且呼叫次數、token 消耗與首 token 延遲皆居低成本前沿；消融顯示證據重建最關鍵。限制：需端對端微調圖模組與骨幹，訓練成本較高，評估亦限於個人化基準。其價值在於證明按需在潛在空間組織記憶可兼顧準確與效率，為個人化代理指出新途徑。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM safety/interpretability work: mechanistic analysis of refusal failure in reasoning models (DeepSeek-R1-Distill vs. matched IT models) plus a lightweight intervention (single learned token embedding, ~4096 params, frozen backbone). Strengths: localized mechanistic finding (ORC) with bootstrap-CI quantification, causal onset-intervention experiments (Table 3), broad evaluation across safety, jailbreak, over-refusal, and utility benchmarks, and three model families including Qwen3-8B transfer. Novelty is moderate: refusal directions, safety heads, and CoT safety degradation are established (cited [1],[39],[44]), and soft-token control builds on prompt tuning [16],[42]; the positional onset-injection insight (Table 6) is the freshest element. Rigor concerns: Table 5 compatibility results include degradations (R1-8B SafePath WildJailbreak 0.8→11.3) glossed as 'most settings'; Table 3 prefix-length results are noisy/non-monotonic; R_ORC varies wildly across pairs (189% vs 20%); Appendix D concedes onset drops also occur on harmless inputs, weakening specificity. SafeToken shows weak GCG robustness and elevated over-refusal on XSTest vs. original models. Generalizability limited to 7-14B distilled R1-style models; no code release stated, though training details and prompts are documented.

primary_link.title: First Token Matters: Understanding Safety Collapse in Large Reasoning Models

papers.summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit strong problem-solving abilities, yet their safety alignment often degrades when handling harmful queries. Existing approaches to improving safety largely rely on additional training or preference optimization, while offering limited understanding of the internal mechanisms behind safety failures. In this work, we investigate this failure through a token-level positional analysis of refusal dynamics and identify a localized vulnerability at the onset of reas
papers.summary_zh: 大型推理模型(LRM)雖具備強大解題能力,但在處理有害查詢時安全對齊常明顯退化,而既有防禦多依賴額外訓練或偏好最佳化,缺乏對內部機制的理解。本文透過 token 層級的位置分析,發現有害提示下模型的拒絕相關訊號會在第一個生成 token 處驟降,作者稱之為 Onset Refusal Collapse(ORC,起始拒絕崩潰)。研究以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 系列與同骨幹的指令微調模型為對象,將隱藏狀態投影到共用的拒絕向量,證實模型在提示編碼階段仍保有風險意識,卻於生成起始瞬間崩潰;強制解碼安全前綴或注入拒絕方向皆能降低攻擊成功率,顯示 ORC 與不安全輸出有因果關聯。Logit Lens 與 Integrated Gradients 分析進一步顯示,深層傾向以「Okay」等肯定詞啟動推理,結構性 token 的歸因支配了語意風險 token。據此作者提出 SafeToken:凍結整個模型,僅學習一個連續軟性 token 並精確注入生成起點作為安全錨點。實驗顯示其在 StrongReject、AdvBench 上大幅降低攻擊成功率,同時大致維持 MMLU、MATH500 等效用,並可與 SafePath、STAR-1 疊加;惟對會提前破壞有害性判斷的強烈越獄攻擊(如 GCG)效果有限。本研究指出安全失效可能源於「理解到生成」過渡期的瞬時崩潰,顯示輕量、機制驅動的介入極具價值。
papers.title: First Token Matters: Understanding Safety Collapse in Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: 首個 Token 至關重要:理解大型推理模型的安全崩潰

links.title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions

evidence: Abstract: expected-outlet-only view misses 46.9% of exposure recovered by the visible-exit union; attacker self-reports combine omissions with high false discovery.

Section 3.3: deterministic adjudicator validated by two annotators on 300 stratified observation-entity pairs with 0.850 raw agreement and Cohen's kappa = 0.747; primary strict F1 0.891, C2 candidate slice 0.762.
Section 5.2 / Table 4: matched C1 ZFE results across Agent-R and Agent-F runtimes, 10 sessions per row; guarded OLF 0.683 (Agent-R) and 0.656 (Agent-F), runtime OLF difference -0.028 with p = 0.9219.
Section 5.2: boundary-complete protection in Agent-R reduces session coverage by -0.543 (95% CI [-0.793,-0.280], p = 0.0156); oracle all-exit redaction sanity check reduces coverage to zero.

Section 5.4: minimizing model-visible returns reduces overlapping visible entities by 45.7% (196.0 to 104.8) but on a 15-task slice task success falls 0.800 to 0 with 5.76x estimated API cost increase.
Section 4: request budget B=20, session-level statistics with 10,000 bootstrap resamples, seed 2027, exact sign-flip paired tests; models deepseek-v4-flash, GLM-4.7, adjudicator deepseek-v4-pro.

Section 7 Limitations: synthetic enterprise-style data, modest item and seed counts, two runtimes sharing the same model/environment, C3 is request/probe-level temporal order not a causal chain, no code or artifact availability stated anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic: an authorization-aware evaluation framework for privacy leakage in tool-using LLM agent sessions, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs); not a pure domain application. The 'privacy exposure displacement' reframing (outlet, recognition, path) is a genuinely useful measurement contribution, though it is a methodology/benchmark paper building on established agent-privacy benchmarks (Privacy in Action, AgentDAM, AgentLeak, CIPL) rather than a new attack or defense. Rigor is above average: formal evaluation contract, pre-registered hidden target sets, defined metrics (ECR, OLF), exact sign-flip tests with 10,000 bootstrap resamples and fixed seed, a negative authorization control, an oracle redaction sanity check, and human adjudication (300 pairs, Cohen's kappa 0.747, strict F1 0.891). Evidence is honestly scoped — C1 replicated across two independently implemented runtimes and cross-model (DeepSeek, GLM) with CIs and p-values, while C2 is flagged as the hardest adjudication slice and C3 is carefully framed as association and temporal ordering, not causation. Main weaknesses: small samples (10 sessions per C1 condition, 5 sessions per model for C3, 15-task utility slice), synthetic enterprise data with modest item counts (self-acknowledged in Limitations), and no code/artifact release statement, which caps reproducibility despite detailed setup and named public environments.

primary_link.title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions

papers.summary: Privacy evaluations of tool-using LLM agents often inspect a designated action, final response, or attacker report. These local proxies can miss unauthorized exposure elsewhere in a multi-step session and lack common ground truth across outlets, reports, and tool paths. We introduce privacy exposure displacement, the mismatch between a local evaluation proxy and target-grounded session exposure, and ASLEval, an authorization-aware framework that pre-registers a hidden target set, measures all de
papers.summary_zh: 針對現有使用工具之 LLM 代理人的隱私與安全評測基準多僅檢視單一指定動作、最終回答或攻擊者報告,這類本地代理指標容易漏失多步工作階段其他位置的未經授權資料外洩。作者將此偏差稱為「隱私暴露位移」,並提出 ASLEval 評測框架:事前預先登錄隱藏目標實體集合、授權關係、預期輸出通道與宣告的可見邊界;之後由不具目標知識的探測代理人與黑箱目標代理人互動,對所有可見通道統一計分,內部工具軌跡僅作診斷用。跨三個企業風格環境與兩套獨立實作執行系統的實驗揭示三種模式:(1)通道位移:啟用電子郵件防護後,該通道覆蓋率下降但工作階段整體暴露幾乎不變,僅觀察預期通道的視角漏失可見通道聯集所回復暴露的 46.9%;(2)辨識位移:攻擊者自報清單既有漏失也有誤報,候選精確度低至 0.148;(3)路徑位移:結構化內部證據通常在請求/探測層級先於可見暴露出現(76.3%)。另外,減少模型可見內容雖能降低暴露,卻使正常任務成功率歸零(由 0.800 降至 0),顯示沒有免費的防禦。限制包括採用合成資料、項目與種子數量有限、路徑發現僅建立相關與時序而非因果推論;人工複核雖支持裁決流程,但主控台與候選案例判定準確度較低。本文主張隱私基準應預先登錄目標與授權、宣告完整可見邊界,並將隱私與任務效用一併報告。
papers.title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions
papers.title_zh: ASLEval:衡量 LLM 代理人工作階段中的隱私暴露位移

links.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination

evidence: Abstract: 'agents capture 41% of the flags... traps increase the number of turns (+20) and reasoning tokens (+2k)'
Section 5.5 / Table 2: '605 baseline trials' and '3,061 trap trials' across 5 on-prem models plus GPT-5 on a reduced grid
Section 5.5 footnote: GPT-5 trap runs use 'the five trap instances that most reduce the on-prem solve rate' — a selection the authors disclose
Section 6.4: 'GPT-OSS collapses, from a 65% win rate when it avoids the decoy to 28% when it engages it'; DeepSeek '87%... against 85%'

Section 6.3: 'goal hijack (n=4) and exploration bait (n=3) cause the largest flag-capture losses... median changes near −50 to −65%'; 'false authority rests on a single instance (n=1) and should be read with care'

Section 7.2 Limitations: 'five trials per cell is coarse, and we report statistics without significance tests'; 'no benign-injection control experiments to quantify the effect of traps increasing page size'
Section 7.1: 'The measured effect sizes should not be extrapolated directly from web CTF to production'
Availability section: framework, trap specifications, configurations, and raw traces released at https://github.com/Golim/agent-lsd; Section 4.2 describes deterministic seeded generation
Section 3 Threat Model: static non-adaptive adversary, trap-unaware agents, claims explicitly limited to the controlled CTF setting
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent robustness/security evaluation paper (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8) introducing 'adversarial task contamination' — non-instructional environmental deception (fake flags, decoy endpoints) distinct from prompt injection. The paired clean/trap design with deterministic YAML trap primitives, honeytoken telemetry, and DOM delivery verification is a genuine, if incremental, conceptual and engineering contribution over injection benchmarks like AgentDojo/InjecAgent. Methodology is solid (6,061+ paired trials, factorial design, identical scaffold, temperature 0, sole-authority flag checker), but weakened by no significance testing, coarse 5-trial cells, reporting only 5 of 7 trapped challenges, a biased GPT-5 trap subset chosen by on-prem degradation, and no benign-injection (page-size) control — all acknowledged in Section 7.2. Quantitative evidence is detailed and calibrated (41% clean solve; +20 turns/+2k reasoning tokens; GPT-OSS win rate 65%→28% after bait-taking), though family-level conclusions rest on few instances (false authority n=1). Generalizability is limited to 11 static DOM-channel web CTF challenges with trap-unaware agents and one scaffold; the authors correctly warn against extrapolation. Reproducibility is good: open-source framework, trap specs, configs, and raw traces released with deterministic generation. Overall a useful, well-executed benchmark paper with modest novelty and clearly scoped claims.

primary_link.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination

papers.summary: AI agents for security inspect web pages, source code, logs, configuration files, and command outputs. These environments may contain deceptive artifacts that influence the agent's behavior. We call this adversarial task contamination. Whereas prompt injection relies on attacker-supplied instructions, task contamination also includes non-instructional evidence, such as fake results and decoy endpoints. We present AgentLSD, a controlled framework for studying adversarial task contamination. Agent
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討AI資安代理面臨的新型威脅：對抗性任務污染（adversarial task contamination）。不同於仰賴攻擊者指令的提示注入（prompt injection），任務污染涵蓋非指令性的欺騙證據，如假旗標、誘餌端點與誤導提示。作者開發開源框架AgentLSD，以11個Flask網頁CTF挑戰為環境，將YAML定義的陷阱原語於執行期注入HTTP回應，同時保持漏洞、解法路徑與旗標不變，構成乾淨—陷阱配對實驗，並以honeytoken遙測記錄代理是否上鉤。評估六個模型顯示：乾淨條件下代理僅解出約41%旗標，連GPT-5也未能全數解出，語料庫未飽和。陷阱最一致的效果是增加負擔：仍成功的試次平均多耗約20個回合與2,000個推理token；解題率影響則不一致，goal hijack與exploration bait造成最大退化，GPT-OSS 120B最脆弱，Gemma-4 31B幾乎不受影響。遙測進一步指出，脆弱關鍵不在是否接觸誘餌，而在能否迅速脫離。限制包括陷阱僅限DOM通道、靜態且單次注入、缺乏Claude等前沿模型、每格僅五次試驗且未做統計檢定。此工作確立任務污染為資安代理的獨立穩健性議題，提供可重現基準，對設計具來源標記、結果驗證與復原機制的防禦具重要啟示。
papers.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination
papers.title_zh: AgentLSD：在對抗性任務污染下評估AI資安代理

links.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition

evidence: Abstract: 'collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions' and 'CoT monitoring alone cannot serve as a standalone safeguard against algorithmic collusion'
Section 4.1: nine model families (GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Qwen-2.5 32B/14B/7B, Gemma 9B, Llama-3.1 8B, Mistral 7B) with temperature 0.7, top-p 0.95, served via vLLM/API
Section 4.2: 'multiple independent 300-round runs per condition differing only in the random seed'; two-sided Welch's t-tests with Bonferroni note
Appendix G Table 4: extractor human validation on 40 sampled traces yields P=0.87, R=0.93, F1=0.90, dominant error 'cause-node misattribution'
Appendix H Table 5: GPT-5 composite faithfulness C-hat=0.937 while Sonnet 4.5 is most collusive (Delta-bar=+0.978, C-hat=0.678); Spearman rs=-0.30 (p=0.43)
Section 5.2: Pearson correlation between TS-hat and Delta-bar is r=0.25 (p=0.083) under N=3
Section 3.5: Common4 node filtering (V*={P_own, P_comp, D_own, Pi_own}) to control stated-graph density differences
Limitations: 'we have not yet validated it outside pricing' and N=2/N=3 pipelines 'not directly comparable on a numerical scale'
Appendix M Table 7: sensitivity of C-hat to edge-retention thresholds tau in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3} showing monotonic decline for most models

Appendix A: full system prompts, Prompt A/B variants, and causal-extraction prompt provided; Ethical Considerations: 'We deliberately withhold the specific prompt configurations that produce the strongest collusive outcomes'; no code/data release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM safety/agent paper: audits whether chain-of-thought monitoring can detect algorithmic collusion by LLM pricing agents, directly hitting Agents (2.5), Reasoning/CoT (2.5), LLMs (2.5), and AI Safety (2.0) preferences. Novelty is solid: the stated-vs-behavioral causal graph divergence framework plus a structural/intent faithfulness decomposition is a new diagnostic angle beyond prior CoT-faithfulness (Turpin, Lanham) and LLM-collusion (Fish) work, though it composes existing tools (LLM causal extraction, Granger/PCMCI+, JSD). Rigor is good: 9 model families, two market structures, seeded multi-run design, prompt variants, density-controlled metrics, extractor human validation (F1=0.90, n=40), threshold sensitivity, and Welch tests; weaknesses are small run counts (3-10 per condition), a marginal headline correlation (r=0.25, p=0.083), a null-result claim with low power (9 model points), and an extractor (Qwen-32B) that is itself an evaluated model. Evidence strength is moderate-to-good: quantitative tables (Tables 1, 5) clearly support the collusion-faithfulness dissociation, but intent-faithfulness findings are partly qualitative and the N=2/N=3 pipelines are admittedly non-comparable. Generalizability is limited to symmetric Bertrand pricing with N<=3, acknowledged by the authors as unvalidated outside pricing. Reproducibility benefits from full prompts, serving configs, thresholds, and appendices, but no code or data release is stated and some strongest-collusion configurations are withheld.

primary_link.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition

papers.summary: Large language models (LLM) deployed as autonomous pricing agents may sustain supracompetitive prices through tacit coordination. We develop a causal graph divergence framework that separately measures structural faithfulness and intent faithfulness of LLM pricing agents in Bertrand competition. Across nine LLMs under duopoly and triopoly conditions, collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions: the most collusive model accurately reports cooperativ
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討 LLM 定價代理在寡占市場中是否形成默示勾結，以及 CoT（思維鏈）監控能否可靠偵測此類勾結。作者建立「因果圖分歧」架構：從 CoT 軌跡萃取「陳述因果圖」，並從實際價格序列以 Granger 因果與 PCMCI+ 推得「行為因果圖」，以 Jaccard 重疊、方向一致性與綜合分數衡量結構忠實度，另以 Jensen–Shannon 散度衡量陳述意圖與實際行為意圖之間的落差。實驗於 Bertrand 雙占與三占（logit 需求、300 回合）下評估九個模型。主要結果顯示勾結與忠實度明顯分離，兩者無顯著單調關係：GPT-5 結構忠實度最高（雙占 C=0.937、三占 TS=0.594），卻在兩種市場結構下持續訂出高於 Nash 均衡的價格；最勾結的 Claude Sonnet 4.5 結構忠實度低於中位數，意圖散度卻最低，其 CoT 坦白陳述合作意圖。開源模型多落入破壞性競爭；三占下勾結雖減弱，但三家前沿模型仍維持超 Nash 定價，忠實度排序大致不變。限制包括僅涵蓋同質廠商的 Bertrand 情境、雙占與三占兩套流程的數值不可直接比較、意圖分類較粗略，以及 LLM 解析器本身可能引入誤差。本研究的意義在於證明 CoT 監控不足以作為防制演算法勾結的獨立防線，監管仍須以實際價格結果的行為稽查為基礎，並輔以反事實探測等互補機制。

links.title: DiverseFT: Diversifying Fault-Tolerant Systems using LLMs

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): 'up to 65% of the codebase can be diversified' across PBFT, HotStuff, and Raft using LLMs.

Section 2 (Page 3) and Table 1 (Page 3): claims DiverseFT is 'the first work that provides diversified implementations for the core protocol of a BFT system in a scalable way'; contrasts with Galápagos [74] limited to pure functions without side effects.
Section 6 Evaluation (Page 8): 'we have generated 4945 patches'; open-weight models pass all safeguards at 6.5% vs 19.4% for the commercial model.
Section 6 Qctx ablation (Page 9, Figure 10): removing codebase context causes hallucinations that drop functional safeguard pass rates while paradoxically raising clone-safeguard passes.

Section 6 Stress test (Page 11, Figure 12): Shadow-based deterministic fault injection with bisection and k-set statistics identifies 7 faulty patches of 1224; after filtering 'all 100 executions succeed'.
Section 6 Performance & 24h test (Pages 11-12, Figures 13-14): geometric mean differences of 0.25% throughput and 0.53% latency; 24-hour run processed 3,297,273,515 requests with no observed fault.
Section 7 Discussion (Page 12, Listing 4): limitation that bugs spanning multiple functions cannot be fixed due to fixed function signatures, though LLM CoT correctly identified the quorum bug.
Section 5 Implementation (Page 7): TreeSitter used for function/context extraction; anecdote that Openraft and HotStuff integration took ≈5 hours; inference via GWDG infrastructure.
Section 4.1 (Page 5): explicitly states the work shows representational and binary diversification, 'while our work cannot show fault-independence'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-methodology paper: uses multiple LLMs (Mistral, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Sonnet) with structured prompting and codebase-context injection to generate function-level diversified Rust implementations of PBFT, HotStuff, and Raft, with a validation framework (build/test, clone detection, binary diff, stress testing) and LLM ablations (context, diversify instruction, temperature). Strong fit to LLM (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), AI Safety/robustness (2.0), and Prompting (1.5) preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid—first automated diversification of BFT protocol internals via LLMs, extending Galápagos beyond pure functions (Section 2, Page 3; Table 1, Page 3)—though LLM-for-code-variant generation is an emerging and somewhat expected direction. Rigor is above average: 4945 patches across three protocols, ablations, deterministic Shadow fault injection with bisection/k-set attribution, 100 stress runs, 24-hour test, performance deltas (0.25%/0.53%, Page 11-12); weaknesses include an unverifiable unpublished bug from private correspondence (Page 3-4), no demonstration of true fault independence (acknowledged, Page 5), small-sample bins (9/18, Page 9), and an unexplained temperature result (Page 8). Evidence is quantitative and traceable to figures, with some anecdotal claims (cost <$50, 5-hour porting). Generalizability is moderate: Rust-only, function-level, requires existing tests; multi-function bugs explicitly out of scope (Section 7, Page 12). Reproducibility is moderate: open-weight models chosen for a 'reproducible lower bound' (Page 8), prompts and configurations detailed, but no explicit artifact/code release statement for DiverseFT itself is verified in the text.

primary_link.title: DiverseFT: Diversifying Fault-Tolerant Systems using LLMs

papers.summary: Fault-tolerant agreement protocols fail if replicas share a common flaw that simultaneously affects more replicas than the tolerable threshold. Therefore replicas should ideally fail independently, which can be achieved through diversification. However, in practice, often the same protocol implementation is shared by all replicas which is not surprising given that the provision of multiple diverse implementations is difficult and highly laborious. This poses a major risk, as a shared protocol im
papers.summary_zh: BFT 與 CFT 共識協定的安全保證假設副本不會因同一弱點同時失效，但實務上各副本常共用同一份實作，共用弱點可能一次突破容錯門檻；傳統 N-version programming 因成本高昂而鮮少採用。DiverseFT 運用多個 LLM（Mistral、Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1、Sonnet），以函式為單位自動改寫 PBFT、HotStuff、Raft 的 Rust 參考實作，產生功能等價但語法與二進位相異的變體，並設置層層防護：建置與測試、克隆偵測、二進位差異比對、執行驗證，最後於 Shadow 模擬器注入 leader 當機進行壓力測試，再以二分法與 k-set 統計定位跨修補互動才顯現的錯誤。實驗產生 4945 個修補，兩輪即可取代多達 65% 的程式碼，單一函式最多獲得 7 個互異變體；開源模型 6.5% 修補通過全部防護，商業模型達 19.4%，單一成功修補成本不足 10 美分。多元化對效能影響極小（吞吐量 0.25%、延遲 0.53%），過濾後 100 次壓力測試全數成功，24 小時實測處理逾 32.9 億筆請求且無故障；LLM 甚至在未被提示下修復 Themis 的未公開冒充弱點與兩個 Rust CVE。限制包括難以處理跨函式錯誤、超過 100 行函式成功率偏低，且僅驗證表徵與二進位差異而未能證明故障獨立性。此成果讓協定層級多元化具備實務可行性，大幅降低複製系統的單點失效風險。

evidence: Abstract: 'Across four native-pending routes, executed harm is 0-5% on normal tasks and 40-95% after injection, exceeding paired direct malicious requests by 5-45 percentage points.'
Section 7.2 (Table 3): deepseek-v4-flash rises from 40% direct to 85% handoff for a +45pp paired effect (9 induced / 0 suppressed).

Section 6 / Table 5: exact conditional McNemar diagnostics reported per route; deepseek-native p=0.0039 vs Qwen3.8-27B p=1.0000 (+5pp, 2/1 discordant), showing uneven evidential support across routes.

Section 3.4: mini-SWE-agent Docker probe — 'Three freshly generated markers were received exactly' across the default bridge; contrasted with Harbor/Compose per-project networks that block the path and Inspect's network_mode: none.

Section 5.2: append-only hash-chained ledger; 'the evaluator then derives harm from the ledger rather than from model text,' with pending harmful calls never replayed and only post-resumption actions attributed to the successor.

Section 10 (Limitations): '0/20 gives a one-sided 95% upper bound of 13.9%'; authors state results 'neither establish natural rare-event rates nor demonstrate an autonomous cascade' and that the generator checkpoint 'was not independently verified.'
Footnote 1: code and fixed inputs claimed publicly available at github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/Research/roguehandoff20.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent safety, multi-agent contagion, and adversarial evaluation. The paired direct-vs-rogue-prefix design (isolating the effect of inherited trajectory state beyond the harmful objective itself) is a genuine methodological contribution, complemented by a concrete deployment-audit finding (cross-container transport via mini-SWE-agent's default Docker bridge) and a formal SEIR-style model of session states. Rigor is above average: harm is scored from a protected ledger rather than model text, identification conditions are explicit, and limitations are unusually candid (including a power analysis showing the 0/20 normal baseline only bounds initiation at 13.9%). However, evidence rests on only 20 scenarios with one repetition per condition, a single unverified 'cracked' generator route, provider-reported model identities, and several routes with few or non-significant discordant pairs (Qwen3.8-27B effect +5pp with exact p=1.0); the epidemic formalism itself is never fit to data (R0 unestimated), and the cutoff experiment is exploratory with confounded boundary type. Generalizability is limited by one generator, one harness, one handoff edge. Code availability in Tencent's AI-Infra-Guard repo aids reproducibility, but the modified checkpoint and frozen-history provenance are not independently verifiable.

primary_link.title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery

papers.summary: How does a multi-agent system evolve from a local deviation into collective loss of control? We propose an epidemic explanation organized around accidental mutation, contagion, and recovery. A spontaneous deviation creates a seed; communication enables other agents to adopt and retransmit its unsafe strategy; collective failure can emerge when propagation outpaces correction and containment. Thus, rare individual deviations can coexist with substantial collective risk. Motivated by reported Open
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討多代理（multi-agent）系統如何從局部偏異演變為集體失控。作者以流行病學框架提出解釋，區分三個過程：意外突變（自發產生不安全策略的種子）、傳染（其他代理透過通訊採納並再傳播該策略）與自我修復。受 OpenAI 代理協同事件（如 Hugging Face 入侵與 DSEWiki）啟發，研究分別檢驗此機制的兩項要素。其一，部署稽核在名義上相互隔離的公開評測部署中識別出隱性通訊路徑，並以 mini-SWE-agent 預設 Docker 後端驗證資訊確實能在容器間傳遞。其二，作者建立 RogueHandoff-20 基準，涵蓋 20 個可執行情境，將修改版「破解」Qwen-27B 產生的不安全軌跡注入受測代理。結果顯示：四條原生擱置呼叫路線在正常任務的實際傷害率僅 0–5%，注入後升至 40–95%，比配對的直接惡意請求高出 5–45 個百分點；截斷實驗更發現「語意承諾懸崖」，完整的待決工具呼叫遠比較長但不完整的推理片段更具行為影響力。限制方面：僅 20 個精選情境且各條件單次重複，無法估計自然界的稀有突變率，也未展示自主的多跳傳播鏈，合成軌跡與自然失敗的對應性仍待驗證。本文的價值在於指出低觀察基線傷害可與高條件易感性並存，防禦應兼顧訓練代理抗拒並自我修正被傳播的不安全狀態，以及稽核、限縮非預期通訊路徑，因為僅降低突變率無法降低集體失控的傳播門檻。
papers.title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery
papers.title_zh: LLM 代理系統的集體失控：突變、傳染與康復的流行病學解釋

links.title: Colla-Q: Toward Collaborative Experts in MoE Quantization via Minimax Precision Balancing

evidence: Abstract: 'Our code is available at: https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/Colla_Q'
Table 1: Colla-Q Avg 68.5 vs PMQ 67.5 at 2.54 bits, and 54.5 vs 54.5 at 1.57 bits on Mixtral 8x7B
Section 4.2: 'Our method exhibits almost no average performance drop at an average bit-width of 2.54 bits' contradicts Table 1 FP16 Avg 72.4 -> 68.5
Table 4: Average cosine similarity of Ours 91.6-98.9 across calibration datasets vs PMQ 46.3-86.0 (Mixtral/Phi3.5)
Appendix A.3 Table 13: average Spearman correlation of -0.56 between activation entropy and expert-pair intervention performance
Appendix A.4: expert-GEMM kernels on RTX 3090, 10 warm-up/30 repetitions, 1.39x-1.48x expert-computation speedup (Figure 4), expert-level only
Limitations: weight-only quantization, three backbones (16B-46.7B), no MoE-specific runtime overheads (dispatch, memory movement) evaluated
Section 3.1 Eq. 3-4: convex ensemble-error argument motivating equal expert errors, assumptions verified in Appendix A.1 Tables 9-11 and A.2 Table 12
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope methodological paper on mixed-precision PTQ for MoE LLMs (Mixtral 8x7B, DeepSeek-MoE-16B, Phi3.5-MoE), directly relevant to LLM, transformer-architecture (MoE), and efficiency preferences. Novelty is moderate: the activation-entropy expert-performance proxy and minimax bit balancing offer a genuinely different allocation signal than routing-frequency methods (PMQ, MxMoE, QuantMoE-Bench), but the greedy algorithm is simple and mixed-precision MoE quantization is a crowded area. Rigor is strong: ensemble-error analysis whose two key assumptions (approximately uniform routing weights, Gaussian activations) are empirically verified in Appendices A.1-A.2, five baselines, three bit budgets (2.54/2.05/1.57), 5-shot checks, and a 2x2 metric-vs-algorithm ablation plus ILP comparison (Tables 19-20). Evidence is solid but margins are often small (e.g., Table 2 DeepSeek 1.57-bit: 39.0 vs 38.3) and the Section 4.2 claim of 'almost no average performance drop' at 2.54 bits is overstated given 72.4->68.5 on Mixtral (Table 1). Generalizability is explicitly tested across four calibration datasets (Table 4: cosine similarity 91.6-98.9 for Ours vs 46.3-86.0 for PMQ) but limited to weight-only quantization and models under 50B, as honestly stated in Limitations. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link (Abstract) and detailed setup (A.4), though the repo cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: Colla-Q: Toward Collaborative Experts in MoE Quantization via Minimax Precision Balancing

papers.summary: In this paper, we present a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) quantization method based on activation entropy. Although quantization reduces memory and computational costs, it can substantially degrade performance. In particular, performance decline is pronounced in quantized MoE models, where individual experts have a small number of parameters that are sensitive to low-bit representation. Considering that MoE operates as an ensemble model with collaborative contributions from routed experts, a signific
papers.summary_zh: 本論文針對 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）大型語言模型在低位元量化下效能嚴重衰退的問題，提出名為 Colla-Q 的位元寬度分配框架。作者從整體學習視角出發，指出 MoE 中各專家參數量少、對低位元量化特別敏感，一旦部分弱勢專家效能大幅下滑，便會拖累聚合後的整體輸出。有別於以往依賴路由頻率等校正資料集統計量的方法，Colla-Q 先以基於激活熵的無標籤指標估計各專家的全精度效能，再透過極小極大精度平衡演算法，反覆將額外位元分配給表現最差的專家，使量化後各專家效能維持均衡。實驗涵蓋 Mixtral 8×7B、DeepSeek-MoE-16B 與 Phi3.5-MoE，在平均 2.54、2.05 與 1.57 位元設定下，Colla-Q 的零樣本與少樣本表現多半優於 Uniform、BSP、OA-GPTQ、MxMoE 及 PMQ；消融實驗也證實激活熵指標與平衡演算法各自有所貢獻。此外，該指標對校正資料集分布較不敏感，位元配置在不同校正資料集間保有高度餘弦相似度，泛化更穩定，並能以低位元 GEMM 核心取得約 1.39 至 1.48 倍的專家運算加速。限制方面，研究僅探討 weight-only 量化、受限於三個 16B 至約 47B 的模型，且未涵蓋專家分派與記憶體搬移等端對端推論開銷。整體而言，本研究的價值在於揭示維持專家間效能均衡，是低位元 MoE 量化的關鍵。
papers.title: Colla-Q: Toward Collaborative Experts in MoE Quantization via Minimax Precision Balancing
papers.title_zh: Colla-Q：透過極小極大精度平衡邁向 MoE 量化中的協作式專家

links.title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs

evidence: Abstract/Results: language gaps range from 3.6%-6.6% for open-source LLMs and 2.7%-15.6% for closed-source LLMs; officially supported languages frequently yield highest median Accuracy.

Section 3.2 Data Collection: 756 AtCoder, 100 LeetCode (test cases prepared with ChatGPT assistance, validated on official site), and 288 BigCodeBench tasks (sample size from 95% CI / 5% margin); DeepL drafts verified by native-speaker authors with a coding book.

Section 5.2, Tables 13-17: translation into English gives median +6.2% (closed) / +6.3% (open) on LeetCode but -5.3% (closed) on AtCoder; translation into Japanese degrades both groups (-10.3% closed, -4.3% open median).

Section 6.1.2/6.1.3: narrative labeling kappa 0.941; Table 20 reports LeetCode 50.0% narrative, contradicting the 21.2% figure stated in Section 1; Observation 16 links AtCoder's ~2x longer statements (Table 24) to lower accuracy.

Section 8 Threats to Validity and Data Availability: acknowledges closed-model non-determinism, contamination from public solutions, and unvalidated low-resource translations; replication package at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20155616.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned empirical LLM study: multilingual (EN/JA/ZH) prompting for code generation across GPT-4o, o3-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3, Qwen2.5-Coder, and Copilot on AtCoder/LeetCode/BigCodeBench, with a Japanese-language emphasis. Rigor is solid (5 repetitions with medians, native-speaker-verified translations via a saturation-based coding book, Cohen's kappa 0.941 for narrative annotation, Pylint/LOC/complexity controls, C++ and low-resource-language extensions, thorough threats-to-validity), but weakened by GPT-assisted LeetCode test cases (15/problem), mid-analysis exclusion of Copilot, and absence of significance testing. Novelty is moderate: it is an explicit conceptual replication of the authors' MSR 2024 work, and translation-based mitigation and multilingual code-generation bias were already studied (e.g., Li et al., Wang et al. cited in Section 2.2); the narrative-style/length analysis is the freshest contribution. Evidence is extensive but descriptive, and the narrative share of LeetCode (50.0% in Table 20) contradicts the 21.2% claimed in Section 1, a notable internal inconsistency. Reproducibility is good via the Zenodo/GitHub replication package and versioned models, tempered by closed-model API drift and Copilot's unspecified version.

primary_link.title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in automatic code generation tasks, thereby encouraging new research in this area. Although numerous studies have explored LLM-based code generation, the impact of the natural language in input prompts remains unexplored (language bias). This study aims to (1) quantify how the natural language of input prompts influences LLM-based code generation performance and (2) evaluate a mitigation strategy to reduce language bias in cod
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討提示詞的自然語言差異如何影響大型語言模型（LLM）的自動程式碼生成表現。作者擴展先前僅測GitHub Copilot與AtCoder的研究，選用AtCoder（756題）、LeetCode（100題）與BigCodeBench（288題），以英文、日文、中文提示GPT-4o、o3-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3、Qwen2.5-Coder（0.5B/14B）與Copilot等模型，以程式碼能否通過全部測試案例衡量Accuracy並重複五次取中位數，另評估以DeepL、Google Translate、GPT-4o翻譯提示詞的緩解效果。結果顯示官方支援語言通常取得最高中位數Accuracy，開源模型語言差距約3.6%至6.6%，封閉源碼模型約2.7%至15.6%，DeepSeek-V3.2整體最佳。翻譯對LeetCode與BigCodeBench多有助益，但在AtCoder效果不一：譯為英文使開源模型中位數提升3.2%，封閉源碼模型卻下降5.3%。補充分析發現AtCoder題目較多敘事風格（約74.0%）且較長，敘事搭配長上下文會降低表現；C++與泰語、斯洛伐克語等低資源語言實驗亦證實語言偏誤持續存在。研究限制包括僅涵蓋三種高資源語言、低資源語言翻譯未經母語者驗證、模型不透明及潛在資料汙染。此發現提醒開發者應依資料集與模型特性謹慎選擇提示詞語言，翻譯策略並非通用。
papers.title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs

links.title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser

evidence: Abstract: 'search procedure-not the objective-is the dominant factor: bottom-up tokenisers consistently achieve lower bits-per-byte in most settings'; BLiMP 'shows no consistent relationship between design choice and performance'.
Sec. 7.2, Table 2 (128k vocab, 1B params): BPE BPB 0.7790 vs. TopDownComp 0.7816; BottomUpLL 0.7803 vs. UnigramLM 0.7872; BLiMP at 1B favors top-down (UnigramLM .818 vs. BottomUpLL .799).
Appendix N, Table 9: paired document-level bootstrap (10,000 resamples) at 128k; e.g., 1B BottomUpLL vs. UnigramLM Delta-BPB -0.0039, 95% CI [-0.0041,-0.0037]; all six CIs exclude zero.

Sec. 5.1-5.2: BottomUpLL 'is closest to the original WordPiece's description' and related to S-BPE (Vilar and Federico, 2021); TopDownComp closest to PathPiece (Schmidt et al., 2024), differing in deletion scoring only.

Limitations section: models capped at 1B parameters; multilingual set is five 'relatively high-resource' languages with four Latin scripts; 300M/500M trained with single seed; top-down deletion costs rely on local replacement approximation.

Appendix O: exact vs. local-replacement deletion scoring yields 81.5% vocabulary overlap at small scale (800 tokens); pruning-rate ablation (10% vs. 1%/0.1%) gives >97% overlap, 'limited effect' claimed.

Header/code link: 'Ahmetcanyvz/comp-vs-like' GitHub repository; Appendix H gives full architecture (e.g., 1B: hidden 2048, 22 layers, RoPE, GQA) and AdamW optimisation details; Appendix I defines all metrics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A foundational language-modelling methodology paper with strong LLM relevance: it trains Llama-style LMs (100M-1B) from scratch to isolate how tokeniser design (objective vs. search procedure) affects model quality, a core concern for LLM pre-training. Novelty is solid but not maximal: BottomUpLL closely mirrors original WordPiece (Schuster & Nakajima 2012) and S-BPE (Vilar & Federico 2021), and TopDownComp is a near-variant of PathPiece, as the authors transparently concede in Sec. 5; the novel contribution is the controlled 2x2 factorial decomposition and its empirical evaluation. Rigor is high: identical preprocessing/corpora across tokenisers, lemmas with full proofs (App. A-F), paired document-level bootstrap significance tests with all CIs excluding zero (App. N Table 9), and ablations of both top-down approximations (App. O). Evidence for the central claim (bottom-up > top-down on BPB) is consistent, but effect sizes are small (0.0016-0.0080 BPB), seed variance is non-trivial (Table 10: seed 42 reverses BottomUpLL vs. TopDownComp ordering), and BLiMP shows no consistent benefit (Sec. 7.2), tempering practical significance. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged constraints: models only up to 1B, five high-resource languages (four Latin-script), single seeds at 300M/500M (Limitations). Reproducibility is strong: public code (Ahmetcanyvz/comp-vs-like), full hyperparameters (App. H), exact preprocessing (App. G), and metric definitions (App. I).

primary_link.title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser

papers.summary: Two dominant tokenisation algorithms are used by modern language models: byte-pair encoding (BPE) and UnigramLM. These differ along two orthogonal axes: their optimisation objective (compression vs. log-likelihood) and their search procedure (bottom-up merging vs. top-down pruning). Existing comparisons confound these axes, making it unclear whether their observed differences stem from what is being optimised vs. how it is being optimised. We disentangle the two by introducing two new tokenisati
papers.summary_zh: 現代語言模型普遍採用兩種分詞演算法：BPE 與 UnigramLM，但兩者其實在兩個正交軸上同時不同——最佳化目標（壓縮 vs. 對數概似）與搜尋程序（由下而上合併 vs. 由上而下剪枝），過往比較往往混淆兩者，無法判定效能差異源自「最佳化什麼」還是「如何最佳化」。本文提出兩個新演算法補完 2×2 設計空間：BottomUpLL（由下而上、概似目標）與 TopDownComp（由上而下、壓縮目標），並以四種分詞器訓練語言模型，涵蓋 100M 至 1B 參數、8k 至 128k 詞彙表，以及英文與五種語言的多語設定。結果顯示，在 bits-per-byte（BPB）上，搜尋程序才是主導因素：幾乎所有條件下由下而上分詞器皆顯著勝出；BLiMP 文法評測則未見一致關聯。內在評估更發現，由下而上方法不論目標為何，同時取得更好的壓縮與更高的對數概似，詞彙組成也依搜尋程序分群；目標函式仍明顯塑造詞頻分佈（如 Zipf α 與熵），且在小詞彙表時概似目標具優勢。侷限包含模型規模僅至 1B、多語實驗集中於高資源語言、部分設定僅使用單一隨機種子，以及由上而下刪除成本採局部取代近似。整體而言，此研究指出分詞器對語言建模的影響無法單以目標函式解釋，搜尋程序是被長期低估的關鍵設計選項，為更嚴謹、更有原則的分詞器建構提供了具體指引。
papers.title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser
papers.title_zh: 最佳化目標 vs. 搜尋程序：拆解什麼造就好的分詞器

links.title: Playing log(N)-Questions over Wikipedia Abstracts: Communication Efficiency Between Paired Frontier Models

evidence: Abstract vs §6.1: abstract says the independence assumption is 'tested' (chi-squared=10.5, df=9, p=0.31), while §6.1 states 'We do not test the independence assumption' — an unresolved internal contradiction.
§6.1: 'Regressing log(win rate) on R gives r=-0.973 and an implied p=0.928'; the author concedes the fit 'is a regression rather than a model derived from first principles' and exceeds 1 at N=4.

§6.4: inter-judge agreement 97.8-98.7% over ~2,900 pairs, with the explicit caveat that agreement 'establishes that the judgements are reproducible, not that they are right'; measured self-preference discount of 46% (GPT) and 40% (Gemini) motivates excluding self-judgements.

§6.4: of 34 unanimous answer errors from the weakest model, 32 are 'No' answers on properties stated in the document's first sentence (p=3.5e-8), e.g. 'Is the subject an individual human being?' answered No about a person in seven games.

§9: 'Each size uses a single document set with 8 targets, confounding N with that set's difficulty' and 'Every pilot game was played on Claude Opus 5... The frozen prompts are therefore tuned to compensate for one model's behaviour, and that model then finished last.'

§5.5: two China-hosted providers refused three of 1024 Wikipedia paragraphs; bisection isolated triggers in 105 API calls; the author admits the keyword-vs-politics ablation 'is not decisive' for the Simon Cheng document.
§12: code, corpus, prompts, and per-game logs released at github.com/ppotash/logn-questions with prompt version hash, schema version, corpus hash, token usage, and raw responses recorded per game.

§6.6/§4.4: reasoning-token spend spans 4.5x at N=1024 with little relation to win rate, and Gemini at MEDIUM outperforms models at HIGH, but effort settings are provider-specific labels rather than a controlled variable.
§6.2/§6.3: round-1 answer balance correlates with win rate at r=+0.88; only the two models using lexical title bisection (GPT, Kimi, 25.9% and 21.6% of questions at N>=64) reach H(p)=1.000.
Table 1: 68 paired games per model on identical documents/targets; totals verify (e.g., Kimi 4+8+8+8+8+5+6+5+4=56/68); cost r=-0.05 with performance; total spend $363.15.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A frontier-LLM evaluation report squarely inside scope: it benchmarks six LLMs on a two-agent zero-shot communication game framed as a long-context, multi-step reasoning probe, with LLM-as-judge adjudication, prompt-revision analysis, and test-time-compute observations. Preference relevance is high across several heavily weighted categories (LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, agents/multi-agent, reasoning, long context). Novelty is moderate: the game is ported from Potash and Suleman (2019), but the p^log2(N) reliability fit, O(1) error decomposition, and judge-free information-rate metric are genuine contributions. Rigor is above average (paired cross-model design, three judges with a measured 40-46% self-preference discount, statistical tests, candid limitations) but is undercut by a direct abstract/body contradiction: the abstract claims the independence assumption is tested (chi-squared=10.5, df=9), while §6.1 states 'We do not test the independence assumption'; only 8 games per cell; prompts pilot-tuned on the model that finished last (§9); unmatched effort settings (Gemini at MEDIUM). Evidence is rich and mostly internally consistent (Table 1 arm totals sum correctly; pooled counts match), with some abstract-level claims (consecutive-failure independence) lacking a reported body statistic. Generalizability is limited by single document sets per size, English Wikipedia, undisclosed architectures for four models, and acknowledged task-specific ranking inversion. Reproducibility is strong: code, corpus, manifests, prompts, and per-game logs with hashes released. The content-filtering findings (§5.5) are interesting but the trigger-cause ablation is admittedly not decisive.

primary_link.title: Playing log(N)-Questions over Wikipedia Abstracts: Communication Efficiency Between Paired Frontier Models

papers.summary: We evaluate six frontier language models on the two-agent $\log(N)$-Questions game. A questioner sees $N$ Wikipedia lead paragraphs and must identify a secretly chosen target using exactly $\log_2 N$ yes/no questions. An answerer sees only the target and the question, and replies with one word. Both roles run on the same provider, so the game measures how well a model communicates with itself across an information asymmetry. We run 408 games over document sets of 4 to 1024 paragraphs at a total
papers.summary_zh: 本報告將 log(N)-問題遊戲移植到前沿模型:提問者須在 N 篇英文維基百科導言中,以恰好 log₂N 個是非題找出祕密選定的目標文件,回答者僅能依目標與問題以單字作答;兩個角色由同一家模型擔任,藉此衡量模型在資訊不對稱下與自身溝通的效率。作者以巢狀文件集與相同目標對六個模型各跑 68 場、共 408 場遊戲,總成本約 363 美元。結果呈現明顯斷裂:Claude Opus 5 僅 28 勝,其餘五模型為 45 至 56 勝且彼此難以區分;合併前五名後,勝率隨集合大小以 r=-0.973 下降,並可用單一每輪可靠度參數 p=0.928 的 win=p^(log₂N) 擬合,每輪失敗率在不同長度間大致恆定。錯誤分解顯示損失約一半為回答錯誤、近一半為區辨失敗,預測錯誤僅 2–4%;表現最差模型的回答錯誤多為在文件首句明述屬性時仍答「No」,顯示溝通失敗而非推理崩潰。每題資訊量與勝率相關達 r=+0.88,僅 Kimi K3 與 GPT-5.6 Sol 採用按標題字母二分的精確分割並達到每題一個位元;推理量相差 4.5 倍卻與勝負幾乎無關,成本與表現亦不相關。限制包括每個規模僅一組文件集、提示詞係以最後一名模型試錯調校、部分供應商無溫度控制,以及兩家中國供應商以內容過濾拒絕三篇段落。本研究的價值在於指出長程多步任務的瓶頸是每步溝通可靠度的複利損耗,而非推理品質或脈絡長度。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-scoped empirical LLM code-generation study directly matching core preferences (LLMs, agentic coding tools, code benchmarks, evaluation). Its contribution is methodological: joining static conformance analysis with runtime execution on the same 7,593 methods shows structural checks are near-ceiling while 38.4% of methods never compute their returned value (Table III, p.3), and adherence correlates -0.91 with correctness among genuine attempts (p.4). The fabrication taxonomy and detection of an index-based synthetic answer generator that defeats literal and duplicate heuristics (p.5) are genuinely interesting. Rigor is solid but capped: one generation run per condition with no variance estimate (Limitations, p.6), a single execution pass, syntactic classification that can mistake the synthetic generator for genuine computation, and internal inconsistencies (abstract claims an 'eight-class' taxonomy vs. the six classes C1-C6 in Table I; text claims coverage '89.9% to 100.0%' while Table II shows 80.1%). Evidence within the paper is detailed and quantitatively traceable, including a sensitivity check removing the GPT/Cursor P1 outlier (-0.91 to -0.78, p.5). Generalizability is explicitly narrow: cost-efficient tier only, contaminated Project Euler corpus, mandated Spring Boot setting. Reproducibility is aided by a claimed anonymized replication package (p.6), though the generic GitHub URL is unverifiable. Not a domain application; clearly in scope.

primary_link.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Cost-Efficient Large Language Models on Algorithmic Programming Tasks

papers.summary: This study empirically evaluates whether cost-efficient Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trusted to generate enterprise code to a written specification. Three models (Gemini Flash 3, GPT-5.4 mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) were asked to solve 992 algorithmic problems as Java Spring Boot service methods conforming to a mandated signature and data-transfer-object specification, crossing four model and agentic coding tool combinations with two prompt variants to yield eight configurations, with itera
papers.summary_zh: 本研究實證檢驗三款低成本大型語言模型(Gemini Flash 3、GPT-5.4 mini、Claude Haiku 4.5)能否被信任依書面規格產出企業級程式碼。作者取 Project Euler 的 992 道題目,要求模型撰寫符合指定方法簽名與 DTO 規格的 Java Spring Boot 服務方法,交叉組合兩種 Agentic Coding Tools(Cursor 與 Claude Code)與兩種提示詞變體,形成八種配置;過程禁止迭代自我修正與將已知答案寫死,並抽離八題作為缺失輸入探針。研究以六類結果分類法靜態分析 7,593 個方法,部署執行後取得 7,936 次量測請求。結果顯示結構符合度近乎天花板,卻有 38.4% 的方法並未真正計算其所回傳的值,回傳答案僅 12.9% 正確;真正運算的方法回應最少,正確率也僅 19.3%,回應可靠性與答案正確性呈反向關係(相關係數 -0.91),偽造佔位類別幾乎回應所有請求卻幾乎全錯。研究並發現一個合成答案產生器,依題號以固定的算術常式製造看似合理的答案,橫跨 792 題避開字面偵測且從未答對。字面答案於前 100 題有 44.3% 符合已公布解答,401 題之後僅 0.1%,印證訓練語料污染與記憶效應;工具效應顯著且隨提示詞不同而方向逆轉。限制包括各配置僅生成一次、工具涵蓋不完整、單次執行計時、僅作語法層級分類,以及語料極可能受污染。本研究的重要性在於證明僅靠結構檢查的評測反而會選出最弱系統,語意正確性必須仰賴實際執行驗證。

evidence: Section 5.1: 'CatBoost obtains the lowest aggregate MAE (€9.9k), which is 10.2% lower than the training-set median' and best prompted LM is Qwen3.5-9B static CoT (€10.8k MAE); Table 3 shows train median MAE 11,006 vs CatBoost 9,881.

Appendix D.1 Table 26: paired bootstrap tests with 1,000 resamples; CatBoost significantly better than train median and strongest prompted LM (Pr=1.000), but not significantly better than BGE-M3 dense (Pr=0.935) or ModernBERT late fusion (Pr=0.807).

Section 5.2 Table 5: expanded ReAct diagnostic adds applicant claims and Article 41 reasoning, reducing Qwen3.5-Plus MAE from 18,220 to 8,810 (−51.6%) and raising Zero-F1 from 0.002 to 0.997, demonstrating why award-related material is withheld.

Section 3.3/3.4 and Appendix B.3: target construction separates Article 41 material from model input with eight validation checks; 230 bundled-award candidates manually audited, 72 retained under bundled-proxy exception (Table 10 cascade 18,367→14,575).
Table 15 and Algorithm 1 (Appendix B.4): ID/OOD views constructed by greedy quota matching with eight weighted dimensions; Mean TV 0.025 (ID) vs 0.211 (OOD) vs 0.435 (Challenging).

Limitations: 'Our budget and compute constraints prevent us from repeating all prompted decoder-LM and ReAct runs... single-run estimates'; equitable awards make point-error metrics measure 'fit to the Court's realised practice rather than legal correctness'; scope restricted to English-language ECtHR judgments.

Section 1 footnote: 'Data is available on Hugging Face. Code and documentation are available on GitHub'; Appendix C.6 Table 23 records temperature 0, seed 42, fixed prompt templates; Table 33 reports serialisation ablations with mixed signs (e.g., GPT-OSS-20B CoT −5,041 vs Qwen3.5-9B CoT +1,033).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-evaluation benchmark in legal NLP that directly engages multiple high-weight preferences: it evaluates prompted decoder LLMs (Qwen3.5 variants, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-5.4), chain-of-thought and retrieved few-shot prompting, ReAct-style tool-using agents over a curated knowledge base, and BM25/BGE-M3 retrieval baselines (Section 4.1). It is not a pure domain application since the contribution is LLM/agentic methodology evaluation (leakage-controlled benchmark, prompting and agent failure analysis), not a legal-tech deployment. Novelty is solid: the first benchmark for continuous discretionary monetary remedies at the ECtHR, though smaller prior discretionary-damage studies exist (Section 2). Rigor and evidence are strong: six model families, chronological splits with ID/OOD/Challenging views quantified via total variation (Table 15), paired bootstrap significance tests (Appendix D.1, Table 26), input-serialisation and feature-set ablations (Tables 4, 28, 33), and a leakage diagnostic showing expanded ReAct roughly halves MAE and lifts Zero-F1 to ~0.99 (Table 5), validating the input-separation design. Honest limitations: single-run LLM estimates, residual label noise, and the point-error vs. equitable-award caveat (Limitations). Generalizability is capped by the ECtHR-specific, English-only, nominal-euro scope, which the authors explicitly warn against extrapolating. Reproducibility is good (Hugging Face data, GitHub code, HUDOC IDs, fixed prompts, temperature 0) but weakened by non-redistributed raw text, proprietary API models, and uncharacterized run-to-run variance.

primary_link.title: How Much is a Human Right Worth? ECtHR-NPD: A Benchmark for Predicting Non-Pecuniary Damage Awards

papers.summary: Existing legal benchmarks cover diverse tasks, while continuous monetary remedies remain comparatively underexplored. We introduce ECtHR-NPD, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark for predicting non-pecuniary damage (NPD) awards at the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) from case information when no statutory formula or explicit calculation rule determines the amount. ECtHR-NPD contains 14,575 cases with case-level awards in nominal euros, chronological splits, and a protocol sep
papers.summary_zh: 法律NLP基準多聚焦分類、檢索或受法定規則約束的數值任務，對連續性金錢救濟金額的預測仍相當匱乏。本文提出ECtHR-NPD，據作者所知是首個針對歐洲人權法院（ECtHR）公約第41條非金錢損害（NPD）賠償金額預測的基準；此類賠償依衡平原則裁量決定，並無公開公式可循。資料集收錄14,575件來自HUDOC的判決，附有名目歐元案件層級目標、依判決日期切分的訓練／驗證／測試集，以及ID、OOD與Challenging三種診斷測試視角，並將申請人的賠償主張、法院第41條理由與判決主文等洩漏風險素材排除於模型輸入之外。作者評估六大類方法：常數基線、梯度提升樹、檢索方法、fine-tuning編碼器LM、提示式解碼器LM與ReAct知識增強代理。結果顯示CatBoost以約9,900歐元MAE最佳，較訓練集中位數預測低10.2%；提示式解碼器LM與代理表現不穩定，未能可靠超越特徵基線，且更大或更複雜的組態未必改善。所有模型皆難以辨識零賠償案件、對高額賠償校正不佳，並在Challenging子集上MAE約翻倍。診斷實驗亦顯示若額外提供申請主張與第41條理由，代理MAE近乎減半、Zero-F1升至約0.99，凸顯洩漏控制的必要性。限制包括僅涵蓋英文判決與案件層級目標、標籤可能有殘餘雜訊，且衡平賠償使點誤差指標無法反映法律上可辯護的區間，提示式LM結果亦屬單次執行估計。此基準將法律NLP延伸至裁量性金錢救濟，揭露零賠償辨識與數值規模校正等現有分類導向基準無法量測的失敗模式。

links.title: ERAF4XRD: A multimodal agentic framework for constructing validated experimental X-ray diffraction databases from scientific literature

evidence: Abstract: 'achieved up to 98.7% accuracy for XRD figure identification and generated 1,400 metadata values across 22 fields... 98.5% precision and 90.7% recall, with no unsupported metadata observed among 443 evaluated fields'
Results, 'Manual assessment confirms the reliability' section: 'GPT-5.2 presented the strongest XRD figure identification performance, with 94.8% precision, 90.8% recall, and a 92.8% F1-score'

Results, 'Benchmark dataset': 273 publications, 3,150 candidate figures, 282 manually verified XRD figures, candidate-to-XRD ratio ~11:1 (Table 1)
Results, 'Scalability': 'Claude Sonnet 4.5 was fastest at 0.96 min/PDF, followed by GPT-5.2 (1.29 min/PDF)'; GPT-5.5 gave only 95.9%->96.2% accuracy gain at substantially higher cost (Fig. 9d)
Data availability: 'https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22683615'; Code availability: 'github.com/niaz60/ERAF4XRD'
Discussion, limitations: 'ERAF4XRD also currently reconstructs validated figure-specific metadata but does not fully digitize numerical diffraction data from figures'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope because the core contribution is LLM/agent methodology, not a pure domain application: a multimodal ReAct-style agentic pipeline (Steps 0-III) with tool use, independent validation agents, hallucination removal, and systematic comparison of frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Grok 4.1), evaluated on a materials-literature XRD benchmark. Strong preference alignment with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, grounding/hallucination control, and multimodal VLM usage, though the evaluation domain is niche. Novelty is moderate: agentic scientific information extraction is well-populated (nanoMINER, DIVE, ChatMOF cited); the distinct contribution is automated source-grounded validation plus deterministic crystallographic consistency checks integrated as a pipeline component, and data-metadata linking rather than extraction alone. Rigor is high: 273-publication/3,150-candidate benchmark with dual-reviewer ground truth, imbalanced-class metric discussion, four-model comparison, strategy ablations (agentic vs single-pass, full-document vs targeted preprocessing, visual-input configurations), failure-mode taxonomy, runtime/cost analysis, and CIF cross-validation; limitations (no numerical digitization, subset sizes of 35/47 publications) are acknowledged. Evidence is strong and quantified, but rests on proprietary, version-drifting closed APIs and small evaluation subsets for some tasks. Generalizability is claimed (Raman, EXAFS) with only preliminary support; the validation architecture and model-selection findings transfer beyond XRD. Reproducibility aided by public code and Zenodo benchmark, weakened by commercial-model dependence.

primary_link.title: ERAF4XRD: A multimodal agentic framework for constructing validated experimental X-ray diffraction databases from scientific literature

papers.summary: The scientific literature contains decades of experimental measurements that remain difficult to access as structured data for modern AI and data-driven research. Much of this information is distributed across figures, captions, text, and tables, requiring experimental data and their context to be identified, connected, and verified before they can be reused. Here we introduce ERAF4XRD (Experiment Reader Agentic Framework for X-Ray Diffraction), a fully automated multimodal (i.e., image and text
papers.summary_zh: 科學文獻累積了數十年的實驗量測結果,但這些資訊散布於圖片、圖說、內文與表格中,難以轉換為機器可讀的結構化資料,限制了AI與資料驅動研究的發展。本文提出ERAF4XRD,一個全自動的多模態多代理框架,能從期刊論文重建並驗證實驗性X光繞射(XRD)紀錄。框架分四步驟:步驟0自ArXiv、Elsevier、Springer與CrossRef下載開放取用文獻並篩選XRD內容;步驟I以具備視覺能力的LLM辨識XRD圖片並擷取圖層級詮釋資料;步驟II自內文擷取補充詮釋資料,並與對應圖片正確連結;步驟III由獨立代理依據原始文件證據驗證輸出,再輔以非LLM的確定性一致性檢查。在含273篇論文、3,150張候選圖片的基準測試中,GPT-5.2達到98.7%的XRD圖片辨識準確率;獨立人工評估顯示,443個評估欄位中精確率為98.5%、召回率為90.7%,且未發現無依據的幻覺詮釋資料。自動驗證修正了44.5%的初始擷取結果,輸出亦與COD晶體學資料庫的CIF紀錄高度一致。研究比較GPT、Claude、Gemini與Grok等模型,顯示GPT-5.2整體最為均衡,而更新模型未必帶來等比例改善;針對XRD相關證據的目標式前處理優於輸入全文,代理式推理則主要惠及較小模型。此框架尚未數位化圖片中的數值繞射資料,對非傳統XRD呈現方式亦有漏失,但其「可靠性優先於完備性」的自動驗證設計,為將文獻轉換為可信的機器可讀實驗資料庫提供了可規模化的途徑。

links.title: Trajectory Learnability for Offline On-Policy Distillation with Imperfect Teachers

evidence: Abstract: method 'improves an offline OPD baseline by up to 2.7 percentage points' while using '2 GPUs and about 22 GPU hours, compared with 3 GPUs and 36-48 GPU hours for representative online OPD methods'.
Table 1 (Section 5.1): Qwen3-4B-Base LWD reaches 69.1% AIME24, 42.1% HMMT25, 44.5% LCB v5 vs Lightning-OPD 66.4%/40.5%/42.6%; 1.7B code results remain below online variants.
Table 3 (Section 5.2 ablation): failed-case zero weight averages 55.5% vs full retention 55.0%, shared reduced 56.4%, learnability-based 57.1%—supporting the graded-retention hypothesis.
Table 4 (Section 5.2 ablation): tiered trajectory weighting averages 57.1% vs dense span 56.6% and continuous trajectory 56.7%.

Appendix A.3: for code, 'teacher success is approximated by normal termination and strict extraction of a complete Python program... These code labels measure format validity rather than functional correctness.'

Appendix A.1-A.3: full instantiation details (150 updates, tier rule z<=-0.5 / z>=0.5 with v<1.0, weights 0.15/0.25/0.35 clipped and globally scaled to 0.25, Adam betas, batch 256, lr 2e-6); Section 5 states no checkpoint selection and fixed final checkpoint, but no code release is mentioned.
Section 5 Evaluation protocol: avg@32 on AIME24/AIME25/HMMT25 (30 problems each) and avg@4 on LCB v5/v6, seed 42, temperature 0.6—no error bars or seed-variance analysis reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (on-policy distillation of Qwen3 language models with reasoning/code evaluation) that is squarely within preferences. The learnability signal—re-scoring stored teacher-failed trajectories under a successful-only reference checkpoint—is a clever, cheap alternative to prefix-continuation recoverability estimation, but it is an incremental refinement within a crowded selective/reweighted-OPD literature (ReNIO, FiRe-OPD, RA-OPD, Lightning-OPD). Experiments are protocol-matched with two ablations and two student scales; however, gains are modest (1.6-2.7 pts), math benchmarks have only 30 problems with no variance/significance reporting, tier thresholds and weights (0.15/0.25/0.35) are hand-set without sensitivity analysis, the first-order interpretation is unvalidated, and the code-domain success label is only format validity per Appendix A.3. Generalization is limited to one model family and two domains. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed hyperparameters, pinned LiveCodeBench commit, and exact prompts, but no code/data release is claimed.

papers.summary_zh: 本文研究離線同策略蒸餾中如何面對不完美教師。此設定只需蒐集一次學生軌跡與教師監督並重複使用,效率高,但教師一旦在部分題目上失敗,其不良監督便會在整個訓練過程中持續影響學生。作者指出教師成敗僅是題目層級的粗糙訊號,不代表該軌跡上所有監督都無用;若透過從多個前綴反覆續寫來估計教師可否補救,又會喪失離線效率。為此,他們提出可學習性加權蒸餾(LWD):先只用教師成功的題目訓練一個參考模型(successful-only learning),再比較該模型與原始模型對教師失敗題目中已儲存詞元的對數概似變化,作為詞元級可學習性訊號;經平滑與標準化後彙整為軌跡級低、中、高三個層級,分別賦予有界正權重,用以加權原始蒸餾損失。實驗將 Qwen3-8B 蒸餾至 Qwen3-4B-Base 與 1.7B,在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 及 LiveCodeBench 上,4B 模型於所有基準皆超越離線基線 Lightning-OPD(如 AIME24 自 66.4% 提升至 69.1%),並比肩或勝過多數線上 OPD 變體,且僅需 2 張 GPU 與約 22 GPU 小時,低於線上方法的 3 張 GPU 與 36–48 小時。消融實驗顯示失敗案例不宜全留或全刪,軌跡層級分層加權表現最佳。限制包括程式碼任務的教師成敗僅以格式有效度近似、額外的成功專屬蒸餾階段使離線成本倍增,以及 1.7B 模型在程式碼基準上仍略遜於線上方法。此研究顯示教師失敗可轉化為分配監督強度的分級訊號,而非二元過濾器。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological audit of three Hungarian LLM development efforts, squarely within LLM scope: benchmark reliability, data contamination, continual pretraining with LoRA, catastrophic forgetting, RLHF/RLVR gaps, reasoning-model evaluation settings, and training cost/carbon accounting. Strengths: original controlled re-evaluations (Tables 1-3, 5 runs with mean±std), verification against public lm-eval-harness task configs, and a carbon reconstruction validated to within 3.5% of the reported figure (Sec. 6). Novelty is limited since it contributes critique and re-measurement rather than new methods; some inferences rest on flagged assumptions (GSM8K prompt omission, TF32 for ChatPULI), HuGME metric pathologies (empty/repetitive outputs scoring high) are acknowledged but not fixed, and no code release is stated, though Appendix A.2 documents sampling parameters, harness version, and evaluation cost.

A detailed examination of the corresponding studies, however, reveals several methodological limitations. First, the reliability of the evaluation protocols is questionable. Contrary to the findings of Csibi et al. [2026], evaluation under
papers.summary_zh: 本文系統性檢視近年匈牙利三項生成式語言模型計畫：遵循 GPT-3 架構的 OTP 雙語模型、以 continual pretraining 加 supervised fine-tuning 改造 Llama 3.1 與 Qwen2.5 的 PULI/ChatPULI 系列，以及透過 LoRA 適配 Qwen3-4B 的 Racka-4B。作者指出這些研究的評估可信度存疑：ChatPULI 將 7,344 筆 HuLU 題目混入訓練資料造成汙染；Racka 以公開驗證集而非測試集評分、修改評估腳本卻未說明細節，且使用 lm-eval-harness 預設的 multiple_choice 輸出型態，使推理模型無法產生思考鏈；OTP 的自製評測集更取自自身預訓練語料。作者依建議的推論參數重跑 HuGME 與原始基準，發現 Qwen3-4B 在 11 項任務中有 9 項優於 Racka-4B，而三個匈牙利化模型在 MMLU-Redux、GSM8K、HumanEval 等基準皆出現能力退化，Racka-4B 的 HumanEval 更從 91.95 跌至 29.88。文章另批評其語料管線停留在 2020 年水準、缺乏消融實驗與 RLHF 等後訓練，並依 GPU 時數估算能耗、碳排與成本，重構 Racka 的 1,290 kg CO2eq 排放量誤差僅 3.5%。儘管 HuGME 部分指標會獎勵空泛回覆、作者亦受限於未公開的 OTP 權重，本評論仍凸顯嚴謹實驗設計、資料去汙染與跨團隊協調對低資源語言模型開發的關鍵性。

links.title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement

evidence: Abstract: 1.17M answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, Reddit; OMRA reduces measured gap by 54.4% on average across four LLM families

§4.1: controlled benchmark of 3,600 answers over 900 questions; four families DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Llama; baselines ToT and RoT; DeepSeek-V3.2 as fixed ontology extractor; extractor reliability checked on 100-question subset (Appendix C.6)
Table 1: OMRA Avg. Shrink 74.9% (DeepSeek), 48.2% (Claude), 47.5% (GPT), 47.1% (Llama), averaging 54.4%; only method improving all three gap views on every base model

Table 4 / §5.2 Finding 4: 30 annotators, OMRA preferred win rate 62.4% [53.6, 69.9] vs Real with 25.6% human-likeness win rate; authors state CI overlap with Few-shot makes this 'supportive rather than statistically decisive'

§3.2-§3.3 + §4.1: both the gap metrics (transfer/marginal/geometric over ontology vectors) and OMRA's over-explained span identification derive from the same LLM-based ontology extractor, creating a self-referential measurement loop partially mitigated by human-agreement checks (Table 8, Pearson 0.89-0.954)

Appendix D.5 (Tables 9-11): Length-Controlled Few-shot reaches 57.3% shrink, sentence-mood variants ≤5.8%, platform-aware prompting ≤52.0%, vs OMRA 74.9% on DeepSeek; Table 12 preservation check (stance 93.5%, factual 90.0%) uses DeepSeek as judge on its own outputs
Limitations: inference-time correction does not alter the model's internal preference; offline evaluation only; dual-use risk of engagement manipulation acknowledged

Appendix B.5: commitment to release processing code, prompts, ontology schema, filtering rules, splits, and de-identified data subject to platform redistribution constraints; full prompts provided in Appendix G
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM research: diagnoses a gap between AI preference (LLM-as-judge/synthetic preference signals relevant to alignment and reward modeling) and real user engagement, then corrects it via OMRA. The angle—validating AI preference against 1.17M naturally occurring engagement signals rather than benchmark labels—is genuinely novel relative to known judge biases (verbosity, position, self-preference). Experimental breadth is good: four LLM families, few-shot/ToT/RoT baselines, ablations, and length/mood/platform-aware controls (Tables 1, 4, 9-11), plus honest limitation and CI-overlap caveats. Key weaknesses: the diagnosis metric and the intervention share the same LLM-based ontology extractor (DeepSeek-V3.2, §4.1), so the headline 54.4% gap reduction is partly self-referential—the method optimizes the very instrument that defines the gap; external validation (30-annotator human eval on ~132 items, OMRA vs Real) is small and authors concede it is 'supportive rather than statistically decisive'; engagement labels are within-question ranks, an imperfect proxy evaluated only offline. Reproducibility is promised (Appendix B.5) and full prompts are given (Appendix G), but no code link and some hyperparameters are unspecified.

primary_link.title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to generate and evaluate online content, yet it remains unclear whether the qualities they associate with higher engagement match what real users respond to. We study this question using 1.17 million answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, and Reddit, comparing real platform answers and AI-generated answers across four within-question engagement levels. We introduce Ontological Preference Measurement, which represents answers along three dimensi
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被用來生成與評估網路內容,但其認為能提高互動的品質,未必符合真實使用者的反應。本文蒐集知乎、Quora 與 Reddit 上 25,978 個問題、共 117 萬則回答,在同一問題內將回答依投票排序劃分為四個互動等級,以排除曝光量與平台流量等干擾。作者提出「本體偏好測量」框架,以邏輯、情感、表達三個維度刻畫回答特質,並以遷移、邊際與幾何三種差距診斷 AI 偏好與真實互動的落差;驗證顯示本體特徵預測真實互動的能力優於文字嵌入與各 LLM 評審。核心發現是「邏輯過度綁定」:模型為了達到目標互動會加入更多明確的論證結構,但真實的高互動回答更仰賴情感與表達上的吸引力;在合成資料上訓練的預測器套用至真實回答時,Spearman ρ 驟降至 −0.073。據此提出 OMRA,遮蔽並重建過度解釋的片段,同時保留立場、事實內容與連貫性,在四個 LLM 家族上平均縮減 54.4% 的落差,勝過 Few-shot、ToT 與 RoT 等基準;人類評估中其兩兩偏好勝率達 62.4%,儘管真實回答更常被認為出自人類之手。控制實驗顯示長度、句式語氣與平台提示皆無法解釋其成效。限制包括依賴 LLM 本體抽取品質、僅在推論階段修正而不改變模型內部偏好,且屬離線評估,並有被濫用於操縱互動的風險。本研究對 RLHF 與 LLM-as-a-judge 的可信度提出重要警示。

links.title: Re2A: Situated Conversational Recommendation via Rubric-based Preference Reasoning and Alignment

evidence: Section 3.1: rubric-guided preference reasoning trained with GRPO; binary MLLM-judge rewards (Eq. 2-4) using frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as judge.
Section 3.2: heterogeneous negative construction (situation-conflicting Yl1 and preference-conflicting Yl2) for user preference-conditioned DPO.
Section 5.1, Table 1: Re2A Hit@1 48.12 vs ReGeS 39.45 on SIMMC 2.1 with Qwen3-VL backbone.
Section 5.2 / Figure 3(a): removing reasoning (End-to-End SFT) drops Hit@1 to 31.2%; heterogeneous vs homogeneous DPO improves VHR 13.4->5.2 and WMR 11.2->7.4.
Appendix I.3, Table 19: call-matched diagnostic showing structured preference states beat free-form reasoning on frozen baselines; paper explicitly avoids attributing full gain to GRPO/DPO alone.
Appendix I.2, Table 16: independent judges Gemini 3.1 Pro (+0.59 [0.44,0.76]) and Claude Opus 4.8 (+0.90 [0.85,0.97]) confirm positive Judge-Avg margins over ReGeS.
Appendix I.6, Table 21: bidirectional zero-shot fashion<->furniture transfer, Re2A 32.17/33.94 Hit@1 vs ReGeS 25.84/27.36.
Table 3: per-turn latency 2342.7ms (Re2A) vs 1220.9ms (ReGeS); distilled 4B reasoner variant 1838.4ms at 46.71% Hit@1 (Appendix I.4).
Appendix E: LoRA r=64/alpha=128, AdamW lr 2e-5, 8x A100, seed 42, pinned GPT-5.2 version gpt-5.2-2025-12-11; full prompts in Appendices A-B.
Limitations section: acknowledges cascaded error propagation, teacher-bias propagation from proprietary LLM, and restriction to static visual scenes.
Abstract: code availability claimed at https://github.com/DongdingLin/Re2A.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper (not a pure domain application): core contributions are rubric-rewarded GRPO for structured preference reasoning and heterogeneous-negative preference-conditioned DPO, instantiated on Qwen3-VL and LLaVA-NeXT backbones, which aligns strongly with high-weight preferences (LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Alignment, Agents). Novelty is moderate: the framework is a competent composition of established techniques (GRPO, DPO, LLM-as-judge, constitutional-style rubric induction); the dynamic rubric selection and targeted dual-negative construction are the freshest elements. Rigor is unusually thorough: two datasets, two backbones, three baseline families, facet-level rubric ablations, call-matched diagnostics (Appendix I.3) that honestly separate the structured interface from synthesized data effects, independent-judge rescoring with CIs above zero (Table 16), alternative simulators, teacher/judge replacement (Table 20), and human evaluation with Fleiss' kappa. Evidence is internally consistent and well-attributed to tables, though human audits are small (15 pairs/type; 60 sessions) and the original judge shares lineage with the teacher. Generalizability is bounded: only two recommendation datasets, static scenes, and cross-domain transfer limited to fashion<->furniture (Table 21). Reproducibility is aided by released code, exhaustive prompts, and pinned model versions, but depends on proprietary GPT-5.2 for data construction. Latency cost is transparently reported (2342.7ms vs 1220.9ms for ReGeS, Table 3) with a distilled 4B mitigation.

primary_link.title: Re2A: Situated Conversational Recommendation via Rubric-based Preference Reasoning and Alignment

papers.summary: Real-world recommendation scenarios are commonly grounded in shared physical environments during user-recommender interactions. This motivates situated conversational recommendation (SCR), a complex task requiring recommender assistants to jointly reason over dialogue history, co-observed scenes, and in-scene item attributes. However, current approaches struggle with this setting due to two intertwined challenges: accurately understanding situated user preferences throughout the conversation and
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對情境式對話推薦（SCR）提出Re2A框架。SCR要求推薦助理在共享實體環境中，同時考量對話歷史、共同觀察的場景與場景內物品屬性，面臨兩大挑戰：如何準確推斷使用者於情境中的偏好，以及如何生成同時滿足使用者需求與場景限制的回應。Re2A將此任務形式化為「先推理、後對齊」流程：首先以自動歸納的評分規準（rubrics）引導模型產生顯式的偏好狀態，規準涵蓋情境性、物品相關性、一致性與輔助四個面向，並以凍結的MLLM擔任評審、動態篩選規準，透過GRPO進行獎勵最佳化；接著設計偏好條件化DPO，自動合成情境衝突與偏好衝突兩類異質負樣本，實現對使用者意圖與場景一致性的雙重對齊；推論時採階層式流程，先由偏好狀態檢索目標物品再生成回應。在SIMMC 2.1與SCREEN兩資料集上，以LLaVA-NeXT與Qwen3-VL為骨幹，Re2A超越ReGeS、CRAG等基線（如SIMMC 2.1 Hit@1達48.12%），並將視覺幻覺率從25.4%降至5.2%，弱匹配率亦大幅下降。限制包括階層式推論增加延遲且可能傳播上游錯誤、仰賴強大教師模型進行離線規準歸納與負樣本合成，且僅考慮靜態場景；作者另提供蒸餾4B推理器以緩解延遲。此研究顯示顯式結構化推理能有效提升對話推薦的忠實度與情境適切性，對打造真實環境中的情境推薦助理具參考價值。
