links.title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection

evidence: Section 3, Table 2: sparse readouts beat native prediction on all six tasks; Qwen mean 0.432 native vs 0.740 SAE probe, hook only 0.486 (17.6% gap recovery); Gemma 0.532 to 0.714.

Section 4.1 / Figure 2: silent-feature knockout changes probe score 24.2-62.8x more than the monitored yes/no margin; routed-feature patching changes native margin 16.2-140.2x more; paper explicitly flags ratios as scale-dependent, not mediation fractions.

Section 5 / Table 8 (Appendix I): calibration-only direct logit routing raises mean macro-F1 from 0.4405 to 0.7204 vs probe 0.7404 (93.3% recovery); four tasks select the grid boundary beta=8, so no interior optimum established.
Appendix G, Table 6: knockout uses at most 15 eligible examples per task and routed patching at most 5 donor-target pairs; HarMeme/MAMI/CrisisHateMM/MultiOFF have no eligible knockout examples.

Appendix H, Figure 6: rank-32 bilinear adds only +0.0122 over gated pairwise baseline on validation; the 0.0707 test gain compares the full pair-aware readout to native Gemma-3-12B; test-seen count n=1000 vs 931 paired predictions 'remains to be reconciled'.
Appendix J, Table 11: Gemma EXIST cross-lingual gains 0.0145±0.0302 and 0.0095±0.0373 across five seeds, with SD exceeding mean; paper claims only cross-lingual decodability, not stable superiority.
Appendix J, Tables 12-13: image permutation reduces probe macro-F1 by 0.148-0.206 while no-OCR changes strongest readouts by at most 0.0671, supporting visual dependence beyond supplied OCR.

Limitations section: readout gap is 'not an apples-to-apples comparison' (supervised probes vs frozen native model); mechanistic claims local to selected layers, dictionaries, features, and anchors; no readiness claim for autonomous moderation.

Appendix B (Hardware and runtime): B200/A100 cluster, activation caching dominant cost; no statement of public code, probe, or SAE-residual release, limiting reproducibility despite detailed per-run configurations in Appendices B-I.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope interpretability study of LVLMs (Gemma-3, Qwen3.5): SAE-based probing, causal feature interventions, logit routing, and LoRA distillation for harmful-content classification. Strongly matches curator interests in interpretability, multimodal AI, LLMs, and AI safety, though it misses the heaviest preference categories (agents, reasoning/CoT, Japanese NLP) and is not a pure-vision paper, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Methodologically careful: locked calibration-only selection, dense/random-sparse controls, base-vs-residual SAE ablations, paired bootstrap and McNemar tests, honest limitations. Main readout-gap result is large and replicated across two families and six tasks (Table 2). Weaknesses: interventions rest on tiny eligible subsets (n<=15 knockout, n<=5 patch pairs, Appendix G Table 6), headline FHM gain over the gated baseline is only +0.0122 (the +0.0707 is vs native, Appendix H), Gemma cross-lingual gains are unstable (0.0145±0.0302, Table 11), sensitivity ratios are scale-dependent and not mediation fractions, a 931-vs-1000 denominator discrepancy is acknowledged as unreconciled (Figure 6), and no code/artifact release is stated despite detailed configurations. Solid, unusually self-critical contribution; claims are appropriately scoped to decodability vs routing vs correctness.

primary_link.title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection

papers.summary: When a large vision-language model misclassifies a harmful meme, the failure may reflect missing internal evidence or an inability to route represented evidence to its output. We distinguish these cases in Gemma-3 and Qwen3.5 using sparse autoencoders, role-conditioned probes, causal interventions, and recovery experiments across six harmful content benchmarks, with additional Spanish and Hindi-English code-mixed evaluations. Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary
papers.summary_zh: 當大型視覺語言模型誤判有害迷因時，失敗可能源於內部證據缺失，或證據雖已表示卻未能路由至輸出。本文以 Gemma-3 與 Qwen3.5 兩個模型家族為對象，結合稀疏自編碼器（SAE）、角色條件化探針、因果介入與復原實驗，在六個有害內容基準上評估，並加入西班牙文與印地語—英語混碼資料的穩健性測試。結果顯示，稀疏讀出在全部六項二元任務上皆超越原生預測：Qwen 平均 macro-F1 由 0.432 升至 0.740，Gemma 由 0.532 升至 0.714。介入實驗發現，靜默特徵消融對探針分數的敏感度是對原生輸出的 24–63 倍，而路由特徵修補對輸出的敏感度則高出 16–140 倍，顯示探針判別方向與輸出路由方向明顯分離。僅以校準資料選取係數的直接 logit 路由可回收 93.3% 的平均落差；探針蒸餾 LoRA 能改善原生預測，但共享多任務調適引發負遷移。Gemma-3-12B 在 FHM 上的案例呈現分散式 rank-32 影像—提示交互作用，macro-F1 達 0.756，高於原生的 0.685。跨語言、OCR 消融與影像擾動控制證實訊號超越英文、非僅仰賴 OCR，且實質依賴配對視覺證據。作者提醒此落差並非對等比較，部分介入樣本有限，機制結論僅限於所選層、字典與輸出錨點。整體而言，研究指出路由而非表示本身是有害迷因分類的關鍵瓶頸，為模型可解釋性與內容安全系統設計提供新方向。

links.title: Beyond Outcomes: Dual-View Relational Learning for Efficient Agent Benchmarking

evidence: Abstract: 'With only 20 tasks, it achieves 24x-40x compression on APEX-Agents and BFCL, reducing mean absolute error (MAE) by 14.5%-28.2% over the strongest competitors'.

Abstract vs Section 1 contributions: abstract states 'improving Kendall's tau by up to 7.2% relative to EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified' while the contribution bullet states 'improving Kendall's tau by up to 5.4%' — numeric inconsistency.
Table 2: DualViewEval reports best MAE and tau across all five benchmarks at anchor sizes 20/40/60 (mean ± std over ten splits), e.g., BFCL K=20 MAE 4.202±0.804 vs Anchor Points 4.914±0.973.

Table 3: w/o ORM (process-only) fails catastrophically on Terminal-Bench 2 (MAE 50.142, tau 0.010 at Anchor=20), while w/o PRM is close to full model, indicating the outcome view carries most of the signal.
Appendix C.1 / Table 4: all seven Qwen configurations held out; DualViewEval average MAE 2.020 vs EssenceBench 2.746 and SparseEval 5.897.

Section 5 analysis: text attributes the learned-gamma distribution, training-data-proportion, and efficiency results to 'Figure 10', but captions assign these to Figures 8, 9, and 10 respectively — inconsistent figure cross-references.

Appendix D Algorithm 1 and Appendix B equations (12)-(18) give full optimization procedure and metric definitions (e.g., lr 0.05, 1000 epochs, B=5 folds in Section 4.1); no explicit code or data release statement appears in the paper.
Section 4.1 / Table 1: aligned outcome matrices built from public leaderboards plus self-run APEX-Agents trajectories (26 models x 480 tasks), totaling 132,387 outcome pairs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for LLM agent evaluation (Agents & Tool Use, evaluation/benchmarking): proposes DualViewEval, a benchmark-compression method that fuses outcome and trajectory-derived process relation matrices to learn an exact-size miniset. Novelty is moderate: benchmark compression is well studied (Anchor Points, TinyBench/gp-IRT, SparseEval, EssenceBench), and the new angle—six observable trajectory statistics plus dual-view Gram-matrix fusion with a straight-through hard Top-K gate and Kernel Ridge head—is a sensible but incremental composition of known parts. Rigor is solid in structure (5 benchmarks, 5 baselines, 3 budgets, 10 splits, ablations of both views, selector and architecture ablations, held-out Qwen-family test, fixed-gamma sensitivity, complete Algorithm 1), but marred by internal inconsistencies: the abstract claims up to 7.2% Kendall-tau improvement over EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified while the contribution list says 5.4%, and Section 5 text cites Figure 10 for the learned-gamma, training-proportion, and efficiency analyses whose captions belong to Figures 8-10, indicating sloppy cross-referencing. Evidence strength is good (Table 2 with mean±std supports 'best on all datasets', Table 3 shows w/o ORM collapses on Terminal-Bench 2 at MAE 50.1/tau 0.010, Appendix C.1 shows transfer with avg MAE 2.020 vs 2.746 for EssenceBench), though some results have high variance (e.g., APEX tau 0.800±0.274). Generalizability is supported across benchmarks and a held-out model family but only for agent benchmarks with trajectories. Reproducibility benefits from detailed metric definitions (Appendix B) and hyperparameters, but no code/data release statement is present. Weighted score ≈0.70.

primary_link.title: Beyond Outcomes: Dual-View Relational Learning for Efficient Agent Benchmarking

papers.summary: Agent benchmarks are substantially more costly to evaluate than conventional LLM benchmarks. Benchmark compression is therefore a natural solution, yet existing methods primarily model redundancy in task--model final-score distributions, which is important in agentic evaluation. To address this limitation, we analyze large-scale trajectories and identify six complementary process signals that are systematically associated with final agent performance. To disentangle agent performance redundancy
papers.summary_zh: 代理基準的評估成本遠高於一般 LLM 基準：長程推理、反覆呼叫工具與有狀態環境互動，使單次評估動輒耗費上萬美元或數天運算，而現有基準壓縮方法多僅依賴最終分數的冗餘結構，忽略背後的執行過程。本文提出 DualViewEval，先分析五個代理基準的大規模軌跡，從十二項可觀測統計量中篩出六項與最終表現系統性相關的過程訊號（步數、工具失敗率、工具類別熵、驗證工具比例、必要寫入執行、讀寫驗證閉合），再以「結果關係矩陣」與「過程關係矩陣」雙視角融合，透過 straight-through 硬 Top-K 閘門學習精確大小的精選任務集，並以 Kernel Ridge 預測器結合分數與排名損失進行端對端聯合最佳化。在 BFCL、τ²-Bench、Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-bench Verified 與 APEX-Agents 五個基準上，僅用 20 個任務即達 24–40 倍壓縮，MAE 較最強對手降低 14.5%–28.2%，Kendall's τ 同步提升，訓練速度較 SparseEval 快約 4.2–8.3 倍，且對完整留出的 Qwen 模型家族仍具遷移能力。限制在於仰賴開放軌跡資料、六項過程指標仍屬淺層統計，且當受測模型與訓練分布差異過大時預測可能失準。此方法使高頻、低成本的代理評測成為可能，精選任務集亦能放大各模型的行為差異，提供分數之外的診斷價值。

links.title: PageRecall: Measuring Page Selection in Literature-Grounded Question Answering

evidence: §5: 'The original policy (BM25 over pages, top 4) achieves 52.6% gold-page recall' over 97 units; conditional table shows reader cites correct page in 45 of 48 locators (94%) when shown, 7 of 31 (23%) when not shown
§5 selector comparison table: BM25 top-4 52.6%, RRF top-4 53.6%, BM25-8 ∪ anchors 75.8%, all pages 100%; median paper ≈19k tokens fits context budget
§7: padding heuristic caused test paper precision 0.840→0.453; removing it 'raised test paper F1 to 0.762 and the composite to 0.568, the largest single improvement'
§8: permutation-voting moved test multiple-choice accuracy 0.840→0.920 with distribution A 8 / B 9 / C 13 / D 20; Limitations concedes 'six is a weak basis for a mechanism claim'
§9: entailment gate negative result — MC answers judged unsupported are correct 15/16 vs supported 22/25; enforcing the gate would cost accuracy 0.902→0.537
§13: reproduce.py harness verifies gold file by hash, recomputes dev metrics with the organisers' evaluator, replays cache requiring 'zero cache misses and byte-identical output'; GitHub repo linked
Table 1: final test scores paper F1 0.762, evidence F1 0.441, MC accuracy 0.920, table cell accuracy 0.242 macro, composite 0.577 from organisers' online evaluator
Limitations: 'Sample sizes are small: 55 development questions and 71 test questions'; closed model 'exposes no seed control' so reproduction requires the released response cache
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-based grounded-QA system paper squarely on-topic for LLM, RAG/retrieval, evidence grounding, and evaluation preferences: a claude-sonnet-5 pipeline (§4) over a 27,487-paper pool with page-level citation. Its best work is methodological self-measurement: a controlled decomposition showing the page selector (52.6% gold-page recall over 97 units, §5) rather than the reader (94% correct citation) bottlenecks evidence grounding, a quiet-failure analysis (31/45 wrong-page emissions), an honest ablation of a dev-fitted padding heuristic that cost 0.245 paper F1 (§7), an option-permutation positional-bias correction (0.840→0.920 MC accuracy, §8), and a negative result that groundedness does not predict correctness (§9). Novelty is moderate: oracle-decomposition echoes QASPER, the 'show the whole paper' fix is self-described as blunt, and permutation voting is a known debiasing trick. Rigor is genuinely careful (deterministic selector measurement, single-parameter ablation, disclosed caveats on the non-like-for-like dense baseline and unmeasured lost-in-the-middle threat) but rests on 55/71 questions, with the MC debias on six corrected answers acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is exemplary for a closed-model system: content-addressed sha256 call cache, provenance stamping, and a reproduce.py harness verifying claims against committed artifacts (§13). Generalizability is bounded: the fix applies only when documents fit in context, and validation is on a single shared task. Not out-of-scope; no unsupported claims detected, and test numbers come from the organizers' evaluator (Table 1).

primary_link.title: PageRecall: Measuring Page Selection in Literature-Grounded Question Answering

papers.summary: We describe our system for LitTraceQA (GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026): given a research question, retrieve the relevant papers from a pool of 27,487, cite the page and the table or figure where the answer lives, and answer in a requested format. Our main finding is that evidence grounding is limited by retrieval, not by reading. The page selector put the annotator's page, which we call the gold page, in front of the model that locates evidence only about half the time (52.6% gold-page recall), while tha
papers.summary_zh: 本文描述參加 LitTraceQA（GroundLM 2026 共享任務）的系統：給定研究問題，須從 27,487 篇論文中檢索相關文獻，標註答案所在頁面與表格或圖片，並以指定格式作答。核心發現是證據定位的瓶頸在檢索而非閱讀：頁面選擇器僅 52.6% 的情況把 gold page 送給讀者模型，但拿到正確頁面時，48 個定位中有 45 個（94%）引用正確；缺頁時模型鮮少拒答，45 例中 24 例給出錯頁，形成大量靜默失敗。由於每篇論文中位數長度僅約 19k tokens，作者改為直接把全文放入上下文，gold-page recall 達 100%；BM25 在文件內頁面排序上因 IDF 退化與主題詞彙重疊而失效。系統另以確定性結構錨點處理「第 24 篇參考文獻」等依序數定位的問題，並以排列選項的多數投票修正選擇題偏愛最後選項的位置偏誤，將測試準確率從 0.840 提升至 0.920。蘊含把關的負結果顯示答案是否有根據與其正確性近乎獨立，且指標無法鼓勵棄權。最終測試成績為 paper F1 0.762、evidence F1 0.441、選擇題準確率 0.920。限制包括樣本小（開發 55 題、測試 71 題）、除偏結論僅基於六個修正案例、PDF 版本不符、公式內容常缺席於文字層，且系統依賴無 seed 控制的封閉模型，須靠釋出的回應快取重現。本文提醒：先測量選擇器召回率再投資閱讀器；文件塞得進上下文時乾脆不要選擇；調參須逐一消融而非整批評估。

links.title: CaMeLoT: CaMeL orchestrated with Temporal logic for static verification and liveness

evidence: Section 5.1, Table 3: on four AgentDojo suites, CaMeL and CaMeLoT agree on 59 of 75 tests (42 both pass, 22 both fail, 17 both block; 9 CaMeLoT-only pass, 7 CaMeL-only pass), run with claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
Section 5.1: CaMeLoT achieves static coverage of 22 out of 28 CaMeL security policies; confidentiality/reader-based policies are explicitly not handled statically

Section 5.2, Table 5: CaMeLoT catches all 7 hand-constructed unsafe SOC plan variants while the simplified taint-only CaMeL baseline catches only S7; text admits properties were designed to exceed CaMeL's expressiveness
Section 5.3, Table 9: prompt-to-CTL extraction exact on 85/97 tasks (87.6%), faithful on 88/97 (90.7%), 100% vocabulary and grounding survival
Section 5.3, Table 10: direct CTL generation is model-dependent (GPT-4.1 nano 12/97 clean tasks; Claude Haiku 4.5 96/97) versus 97/97 for the typed pipeline, supporting the architectural design
Section 6: loop/conditional abstraction as nondeterministic choice 'may produce false positives and block some safe plans'; token-savings benefit is argued qualitatively, never quantified

Section 4 footnote 2: implementation is a public fork of the CaMeL repo (github.com/detlearsom/camelot); Section 5 uses public AgentDojo suites and a bespoke simplified SOC scenario with only 4 end-to-end P-LLM tests (Table 6)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM-agent security: extends CaMeL (prompt-injection defense for tool-using agents) with pre-execution CTL model checking (nuXmv) of generated plans, counterexample-guided plan repair, and a typed-obligation pipeline that grounds natural-language task requirements into temporal logic without letting the LLM write CTL directly. Strong alignment with Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and LLM preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental: plan-verification via NuSMV/TLA+ with counterexample repair exists (Ramani et al., TraceFix, TemporalGuard, AgentSpec); the differentiators are static-before-execution checking, the CaMeL integration, and the trusted compilation path. Rigor is mixed: Experiment 1 (22/28 CaMeL policies mirrored; 59/75 agreement on AgentDojo with claude-haiku-4-5) is reasonable; Experiment 2 uses a deliberately weak taint-only CaMeL baseline on hand-built unsafe plans (7/7 vs 1/7), and end-to-end tests cover only 4 cases; token-savings claims in the abstract are argued qualitatively (Section 6) but never measured. The E2 ablation (direct CTL generation: GPT-4.1 nano 12/97 clean vs typed pipeline 97/97, Table 10) is a genuine strength. Generalizability is constrained by dependence on CaMeL's restricted Python plan language and static provenance; confidentiality/reader properties are explicitly left to runtime. Reproducibility is decent: public code fork (github.com/detlearsom/camelot, Section 4 footnote), public AgentDojo benchmark, named model version, and CTL policies tabulated, though the SOC scenario is bespoke.

primary_link.title: CaMeLoT: CaMeL orchestrated with Temporal logic for static verification and liveness

papers.summary: LLM-based agents generate and execute multi-step plans that invoke external tools which can access private data or execute commands. In this setting, security is a property of the entire execution that a plan creates, not just any single step. The plan itself is a critical artefact that captures the tool calls, control flow, and data dependencies. We present CaMeLoT, a complement to CaMeL, an existing defence against prompt injection in tool-using LLM agents. CaMeLoT extends CaMeL by adding a st
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出CaMeLoT,一套擴充Google DeepMind CaMeL的神經符號防禦方法,對抗工具型LLM代理的提示詞注入攻擊。CaMeL政策為程序式、時間上局部的執行期檢查,無法自然表達活性(liveness)或跨整個執行的時序性質,不安全計畫常到後期才被攔下,浪費運算與token。CaMeLoT在計畫產生後、工具呼叫前插入靜態驗證層:將P-LLM的受限Python計畫經AST轉為有限狀態機,標註工具呼叫、來源污點與歷史述詞,以CTL表達安全政策並用nuXmv模型檢查器驗證;失敗時反例軌跡轉為修復提示引導重規劃,類似CEGAR迴圈。系統亦能以型別化義務從使用者提示萃取任務層級CTL性質,由可信程式碼接地(grounding)與編譯,避免LLM直接產出不可靠公式。結果:AgentDojo四套件上,CaMeLoT靜態覆蓋28條CaMeL政策中的22條,75個計畫有59個判定一致;SOC情境攔截全部7種不安全變體,簡化版CaMeL僅攔截污點類違規;提示萃取於97項任務達87.6%精確比對,20個受控違規全被攔截且與手寫公式一致。限制:靜態污點抽象可能過度阻擋安全計畫,機密性(讀者集)檢查仍留給CaMeL執行期,非決定性迴圈抽象可能漏驗部分性質,工具呼叫視為黑箱。整體而言,此研究顯示形式化時序驗證可在執行前攔截不安全計畫、節省成本,補足執行期防禦之不足,對代理系統安全極具實務價值。

links.title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions

evidence: §2.2 Evaluation Flow: DyMT-ESB generates user queries conditioned on seed stereotype and dialogue history via gpt-4o-mini (equations 1-3), avoiding pre-specified turns
§3.2 Models: five open-weight LLMs (Gemma3-12B, Qwen3-8B, Llama3.1-8B, Phi-4, Olmo3-7B) plus Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite; gpt-4o-mini used as both U-LLM and judge, distinct from all targets
§3.6 / Table 1: human evaluation with 3 annotators (authors) on 125 turn-level instances; Human-Human Gwet's AC1 0.76, Human-LLM 0.70; Appendix C reports weak Fleiss' kappa of 0.35 in Phase 1
§3.4 Baselines: FairMT-Bench recomputed by authors; paper explicitly states the comparison 'is not intended as a controlled ablation between the static and dynamic settings'
§4 / Table 3: cumulative bias ratio increases 7.92-11.25 percentage points from turns 5 to 10, with Religion showing the largest increase (avg 13.33 pp)
Appendix D Table 8: 95% dialogue-level bootstrap CIs reported for cumulative bias ratios; Limitations states bootstrap captures dialogue-level sampling only, not run-to-run variance
§5.1 / Figure 3: claims of non-monotonic bias and re-emergence are based on transition visualization; Table 4 reports re-emergence ratios of 4.58-10.00% across models
Ethics Statement: generated dialogues/datasets not released due to harm risk; only the evaluation framework code is released at https://github.com/rem-h4/dymt-esb
Limitations: English-only, six models, six bias categories, authors as annotators, and full dynamic pipeline not independently rerun
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM safety/evaluation paper: it proposes DyMT-ESB, a response-conditioned multi-turn protocol for measuring social bias dynamics, evaluated with LLM-as-a-judge and guardrail models across six LLMs. Preference relevance is high (LLM evaluation, AI safety, red-teaming-adjacent, prompting methodology). Novelty is moderate: dynamic/LLM-simulated multi-turn evaluation exists (MART, CoSafe, LLM-as-interviewer cited in §6); the contribution is applying history-conditioned query generation to social bias and characterizing late emergence, non-monotonicity, and re-emergence. Rigor is decent: human validation of the judge (Gwet's AC1 0.70 human-LLM in Table 1), 240 seed stereotypes, bootstrap CIs (Appendix D Table 8), honest caveats that the FairMT-Bench comparison is not a controlled ablation (§3.4); weakened by author-annotators (§3.6), 125-instance human sample, weak Fleiss' kappa (0.35, Appendix C), single judge model, and no significance testing for cross-model claims. Evidence supports the headline that bias appears in coherent low-refusal dialogues (Table 2) and late-emerging bias of 7.92-11.25 pp from turns 5-10 (Table 3), but several dynamics claims rest on qualitative figure inspection (§5.1) and low absolute bias rates. Generalizability is limited by English-only, six mostly small models, and six bias categories (Limitations). Reproducibility is partial: code and full prompts released (Appendix F), but no dialogue data release (Ethics Statement) and no independent reruns of the pipeline (Limitations, sixth point).

primary_link.title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions

papers.summary: Warning: This paper contains examples of stereotypes and social bias. LLMs are increasingly used in interactive settings by the general public, making the evaluation of model behavior in multi-turn conversational scenarios important for safety, including stereotyping-related harms. However, existing multi-turn social bias evaluations often rely on pre-specified or template-based user inputs that do not adapt to model responses and typically assume a fixed dialogue length in advance. In this pape
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）多輪對話中的社會偏見評估問題。既有評估多仰賴預先設計或模板化的使用者輸入，無法隨模型回應調整，且對話輪數固定，難以觀察偏見隨輪次演變的動態。作者提出 DyMT-ESB，一個受控的動態評估協定：以一句種子刻板印象陳述為錨點，由使用者查詢生成模型（gpt-4o-mini）依據對話歷史動態產生後續提問，再以 LLM-as-a-Judge 逐輪標記偏見，並支援可變輪數評估。實驗涵蓋六個模型（Gemma3-12B、Qwen3-8B、Llama3.1-8B、Phi-4、Olmo3-7B 與 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite），結果顯示即使在連貫且低拒答的互動中，偏見仍會出現；累積偏見率於第 5 至 10 輪間再增加約 7.92 至 11.25 個百分點，呈現「晚發偏見」、逐輪非單調變動與偏見重現等現象，且模型間排名會因評估協定不同而改變。人類標註驗證評審可靠度（Gwet's AC1 約 0.70 至 0.76），護欄過濾分析亦顯示偏見在 ShieldGemma 事後過濾後仍可觀察。限制包括僅以英文進行、受測模型與偏見類別涵蓋有限、生成對話尚未完全貼近真人互動，且未提出減緩方法。此研究強調社會偏見應視為輪級動態現象，為超越固定腳本的安全評估與後續對齊資料合成奠定基礎。

links.title: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts

evidence: Abstract: 'a Challenger searches for an executable protocol transformation with large gain destruction... a validity firewall checks that task semantics are preserved' - core contribution statement.

Section 1: distinguishes 'task-specific shortcut' from 'benchmark-wide shortcut', citing 58.1% of OfficeQA questions mention numerical scales and 95.2% of unit statements precede a table (Supplementary C.1, Table C.1).
Section 5.1: OfficeQA Full has 246 questions split into D_evo=49, D_disc=49, D_conf=3x24, D_cert=76; fixed budget of three Proposer rounds; Pro V2 (90 questions) as cross-corpus evaluation.
Table 1: CHASE R_ProV2 30.37% vs RawHarness 27.04% and HarnessCompass 26.30%; certification R_rel 68.86% vs RawHarness 67.98% - margins small (76 questions, 3 rollouts), no variance reported.
Table 2: Syn-Ledger CHASE R_0 38.30% vs RawHarness 15.22%, Delta_BS -17.79% vs HarnessCompass -3.53%; Oracle-B0 attains slightly lower Delta_BS (-18.91%) but with privileged access to B0.

Section 5.3: first-round counterfactual reverses H1's gain from +8.16% under B_rel to -5.10% under B_b1 on D_evo; second-round candidates with gains up to 15.31% all violate the epsilon=0.05 constraint (Table C.4).

Section 4 / Supplementary A: Theorems 1-3 give finite-archive certification of Delta_BS and G0, an admission-count bound (Theorem 2), and a stopping certificate (Theorem 3), with complete proofs in A.2-A.4.
Appendix B.1: all methods use 'gpt-5.6-sol with high reasoning effort' for agent/Proposer/Challenger; proprietary model, and no code-release claim appears anywhere in the paper.
Discussion: 'This claim is relative to the evaluated counterfactual family, whose coverage is limited by our three-round search budget' - explicit generalizability limitation.
Appendix C.5, Table C.7: CHASE uses fewest uncached tokens (22.39M) and 17.2% fewer total tokens than HarnessCompass, but search-stage cost is 2.43x HarnessCompass (Table C.8).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic-evaluation paper: harness optimization is shown to exploit benchmark-wide protocol shortcuts, and CHASE counteracts this via an adversarial Challenger that mines validity-preserving benchmark counterfactuals, with finite-archive statistical certification. Strong fit to Agents & Tool Use and Red Teaming & Evaluation, moderate fit to LLMs (LLM agents are the substrate, not the contribution) and partial fit to AI Safety (benchmark gaming/reward hacking). The framing (benchmark-wide vs task-specific shortcuts) and Challenger-plus-certification design are reasonably novel combinations of metamorphic testing, red teaming, and counterfactual repair. Formalism is substantive: Theorems 1-3 with full proofs in Supplementary A, plus careful disjoint splits and confirmation thresholds. However, empirical scale is small (OfficeQA: 49 evolution/76 certification questions, 3 rollouts; only 3 Proposer rounds), main-table gaps are modest (Table 1: 68.86% vs 67.98% R_rel; 30.37% vs 27.04% ProV2) with no confidence intervals or significance testing, thresholds are hand-set under budget, and the guarantee assumptions (packing, closure, small rho) are not empirically validated. Framework is benchmark-agnostic in principle but requires benchmark-specific transformation surfaces and validity firewalls; authors concede coverage is limited by the three-round budget. Detailed implementation appendices and a public OfficeQA dataset aid reproduction, but no code release is stated and all roles depend on a proprietary model.

primary_link.title: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts

papers.summary: Reliable agent evaluation is complicated by automatic harness optimization, which repeatedly uses a released benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to guide a Proposer that edits prompts, memory, retrieval, tools, and control code around a fixed target agent. Task holdout varies semantic tasks but leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a "bad genius" Proposer can produce a cheating harness whose released-benchmark gain depends on a benchmark-wide shortcut. We introduce Counterfactual Harness Search and E
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討 agent 評測的可靠性:當 Proposer 反覆利用已發布 benchmark 的回饋來最佳化 harness(涵蓋提示、記憶、檢索、工具與控制程式碼)時,可能寫入橫跨整個 benchmark 的捷徑,例如因協定中證據位置固定而形成的關聯。僅更換題目而協定不變的 held-out 評估無法察覺此類 benchmark 級捷徑。作者提出 CHASE(Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution):每輪 harness 更新後,Challenger 搜尋能大幅摧毀增益、同時保留題目語意的可執行協定轉換,經有效性防火牆檢查與獨立確認集驗證後,納入有限封存檔,作為後續 Proposer 演化與最終選拔的約束;理論上形式化捷徑中和的目標 benchmark B₀,證明有限封存檔對 B₀ 的統計保證,以及序列搜尋之確認次數上限。實驗以合成基準 Syn-Ledger 與 OfficeQA 進行:CHASE 在 Pro V2 取得 30.37%,高於 HarnessCompass 的 26.30%,並在 76 題認證集上維持最高且最穩定的分數;在 Syn-Ledger 上其增益大部分存活於中和後的 B₀,顯示優於採用固定閘門的基線。限制包括僅三輪搜尋預算使反事實覆蓋有限,更豐富的轉換或更強的 Challenger 可能揭露更多協定依賴。此工作凸顯 agent 分數實為 agent、harness 與協定堆疊的共同產物,CHASE 提供直接檢驗協定依賴、使 harness 演化增益可信的實務途徑。
papers.title: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts
papers.title_zh: Bad Genius:以反事實引導 harness 演化,超越任務特定捷徑

links.title: BENCHCOMPASS: From Scores to Signals for Training and Harness Decisions in Payment-Domain LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'best frontier model reaches 89.6% on Open Context-Grounded Reasoning and 81.7% under attacked inputs, while a representative 32B open-weight model reaches 69.8% and 42.6%'
Section 3.1: 'BenchCompass does not evaluate an end-to-end retrieval system, tool-using agent, or multi-agent decomposition pipeline' — limits agents/RAG relevance
Section 5.5: '60 randomly sampled candidates... blindly re-reviewed... Binary agreement was 57/60 (95.0%; Cohen's kappa = 0.900)'
Table 4 (Section 5.6): 'reviewers accepted 251/255 decisions (98.4%); all audited Base Open and Attacked Open decisions were accepted'
Section 5.6 / Table 12: cross-family judge sensitivity, pooled agreement 93.05% (Qwen3.5-397B) and 91.97% (Qwen3.6-27B) with DeepSeek V4 Flash
Section 5.3.1: 'a Codex corpus-access harness raised Qwen3.6-27B from 61.05% to 92.63%, while payment-domain QA SFT... raised it to 94.74%' — small-N actionability checks only
Limitations: 'labels are behavioral diagnostic signals rather than causal explanations; matched repair experiments are needed'
Abstract / Section 5.1: 'Benchmark data and code are available at https://github.com/ant-intl/BenchCompass'; Appendix D Table 9 lists full API model IDs, provider routes, and decoding settings
Section 5.3.2: 'Qwen3.5 397B-A17B reaches 84.4% on CGR-OB but 72.2% on TIA-OB, and Llama 4 Maverick reaches 68.8% versus 46.1%'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A payment-domain LLM benchmark (306 expert-admitted cases) with a diagnostic Closed/Open/Attacked-Open protocol that attributes failures to missing parametric knowledge, poor context use, or harness brittleness. Strongly relevant to core preferences: it evaluates 16 LLM variants, uses LLM-as-judge with cross-family sensitivity checks (Section 5.6), and probes robustness under answer-preserving input perturbations. It is not a pure domain application since the diagnostic-signal framework and construction pipeline are general LLM-evaluation methodology, but the payments focus and explicitly non-agent, non-retrieval scope (Section 3.1) temper relevance. Rigor is high: calibrated expert review with sample IAA (Cohen's kappa = 0.900, Section 5.5), human audit of 255 judge decisions at 98.4% acceptance (Table 4), bootstrap SEs (Table 14), and candid limitations noting diagnostic labels are not causal interventions. Novelty is moderate: domain LLM benchmarks and automatic construction (AutoBencher, BenchBuilder) exist; the answer-preserving attack validation and Closed/Open signal table are incremental but genuinely useful refinements. Evidence is strong for benchmark characterization but the repair-hypothesis/actionability checks (Codex harness and QA-SFT on one 27B model over 95 items, Section 5.3.1) are small-scale and explicitly non-causal. Generalizability is limited by the proprietary payment snapshot and expert-review dependence, though generator portability was tested once. Reproducibility is aided by a public GitHub release with prompts, rubrics, model outputs, and full model/provider configs (Appendix D), but relies on commercial APIs and partially restricted source documents.

primary_link.title: BENCHCOMPASS: From Scores to Signals for Training and Harness Decisions in Payment-Domain LLMs

papers.summary: Payment operations are a critical financial infrastructure, but the value of large language models in this domain remains unclear because payment rules change quickly, evidence is fragmented, and decisions depend on transaction state, participant role, region, and payment rail. Existing benchmarks do not isolate whether failures come from missing payment-rule knowledge, poor use of supplied evidence, or brittleness under imperfect harness inputs. We introduce BENCHCOMPASS, a payment-domain bench
papers.summary_zh: 支付營運是關鍵的金融基礎設施，但其規則快速變動、佐證文件零散，正確判斷常取決於交易狀態、參與者角色、地區與支付軌道；現有基準無法區分模型失敗究竟源自缺乏領域知識、未能善用所提供的證據，或是在不完美 harness 輸入下不夠穩健。本文提出 BenchCompass，一條由領域文件驅動的基準建構管線：從版本化支付文件建立結構感知分塊與型別化證據包，結合 60 種支付情境框架與 Bloom 認知層級產生候選題目，經 LLM 品質關卡與保持答案不變的任務輸入攻擊，最後由支付領域專家審核准入。釋出的 Pro 基準含 306 題：95 題支付知識選擇題、96 題情境推論開放題與 115 題攻擊情境題，並採 Closed、Open、Attacked Open 三種設定，將結果轉為模型—題目配對的診斷訊號。在 16 個模型上，最佳前沿模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 於開放情境推論達 89.6%，受攻擊輸入時降至 81.7%；代表性 32B 開源模型則為 69.8% 與 42.6%。Closed 到 Open 的大幅提升顯示多數失敗屬知識存取問題，但攻擊情境揭示模型即使握有正確規則，仍可能遵循貌似合理卻無效的流程。人工審計對 LLM 評判的接受率為 98.4%。侷限包括僅代表特定文件快照、訊號屬行為診斷而非已驗證的因果介入，且評分規準仍有敏感度殘留。此基準可協助研究人員與支付實務者判斷應優先投資領域訓練、脈絡工程或規則適用性驗證。
papers.title: BENCHCOMPASS: From Scores to Signals for Training and Harness Decisions in Payment-Domain LLMs
papers.title_zh: BenchCompass：從分數到訊號——支付領域大型語言模型的訓練與 Harness 決策指引

links.title: Beyond Routine Compliance: Cunning Data Cultivates Safety Vigilance in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'reducing mean ASR across nine backbone-benchmark combinations from 17.40% to 15.05%' via Cunning-augmented SInternal (Sec 4.3).
Sec 4.1 Implementation Details: 'Each training configuration is run once per backbone, so we report point estimates and interpret small differences descriptively.'
Sec 4.1 Training Data: 'It includes 681 examples (0.95%) categorized as safety-related anomalous questions... We have not evaluated training with this subset removed.'
Sec 4.2 Finding 2: 'Cunning->Safety achieves lower U+C ASR than Safety in all nine model-benchmark pairs, with an unweighted mean reduction of 11.98 percentage points.'
Sec 4.3: 'The safety gains are not uniform: SafeDialBench ASR increases by 6.45 percentage points for Qwen3-4B, and WildJailbreak ASR increases by 2.60 percentage points for Qwen3-8B.'
Supplementary A.2 (Choice of OPSD): 'GRPO can also include a reference-policy KL penalty..., and we do not run a matched OPSD-GRPO ablation.'
Supplementary A.3: paired-bootstrap 95% intervals for safety-gate gains of +14.22 [9.70,18.75], +15.74 [11.49,20.00], +15.30 [11.11,19.50] percentage points.
Sec 3.3 Interpretation and Scope: 'our experiments do not directly estimate these geometric quantities, we treat the result as a qualitative explanation rather than a numerical prediction.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM safety-alignment paper: training on non-safety 'cunning' reasoning-trap data (Ruozhiba-derived) to cultivate vigilance that transfers to jailbreak robustness, evaluated on three open-weight reasoning backbones and combined with a SOTA safety pipeline. Novel framing (non-safety data as a precursor to safety alignment) with a conditional theory, though the core ingredients (OPSD, GRPO, existing safety pipelines) are borrowed. Rigor is mixed: careful matched-initiation comparisons, nine model-benchmark pairs, bootstrap CIs on trace analysis, and honest negative results (overrefusal increases, per-benchmark regressions in Sec 4.3), but every configuration is run once (Sec 4.1), safety scoring relies on a single LLM judge (Qwen3Guard) without human validation, and key confounds are untested: no ablation isolating OPSD vs SFT on the same cunning data ('we do not run a matched OPSD-GRPO ablation', A.2) and the 0.95% safety-related training subset is never removed ('We do not report retraining with the safety-related subset removed', A.2). Evidence is directionally consistent (Finding 2: lower ASR in all nine pairs; mean 17.40%->15.05% over SInternal, Sec 4.3) but gains are modest, two benchmarks regress, and the theory is explicitly 'a qualitative explanation rather than a numerical prediction' (Sec 3.3). Generalizability is limited to Qwen-lineage reasoning models of 4-8B with Chinese-community training data. Reproducibility is helped by detailed hyperparameters, seeds, and external code links (A.2), but the 72K corpus and rubrics have no stated release and depend on a proprietary teacher model.

primary_link.title: Beyond Routine Compliance: Cunning Data Cultivates Safety Vigilance in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Safety alignment teaches large language models (LLMs) to recognize harmful requests and reject risky instructions. Yet aligned models can fail when harmful intent is concealed within seemingly benign contexts. Robust safety therefore requires both knowledge of safety boundaries and \textbf{vigilance}: the ability to detect unusual premises, misleading reasoning, and latent risks beneath surface-level semantics. Vigilance requires models to scrutinize a request's underlying intent and assumptions
papers.summary_zh: 安全對齊教會大型語言模型拒絕有害請求，但當有害意圖藏於看似無害的語境時，模型仍可能失守。本文提出「警覺性」：辨識誤導前提、非典型推理與表層語義下潛藏風險的能力，並指出現有訓練易使模型落入慣性服從。作者聚焦刁鑽問題——題目不必然涉及安全，卻含隱藏目標、錯誤前提、非字面意義或詭異推理。團隊以 Ruozhiba（弱智吧）貼文建立 72K 訓練範例與 1K 留出測試集，透過 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD）訓練，教師取得陷阱提示而學生全程未見，其後銜接安全 SFT。實驗涵蓋 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-8B：Cunning 訓練在九組模型—基準組合中有八組降低 U+C ASR，平均降 9.22 個百分點；Cunning→Safety 在全部九組優於單純 Safety SFT，平均再降 11.98 個百分點；結合 SOTA 流程 SInternal 後，平均 ASR 自 17.40% 降至 15.05%。軌跡分析顯示，經匹配安全 SFT 後，安全判斷更常在有害規劃展開前主導回應，正面路線翻轉的回應也更短。限制包括各設定僅執行一次、增益不均（部分基準 ASR 反升）、理論分析僅屬定性、語料含 0.95% 安全相關範例且未消融，部分推理任務略有損失。此研究顯示非安全資料可刻意培養能遷移至安全場景的通用推理能力，補充傳統安全對齊。
papers.title: Beyond Routine Compliance: Cunning Data Cultivates Safety Vigilance in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越慣性服從：以刁鑽資料培養大型語言模型的安全警覺性

links.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering

evidence: Section 4.1, Table 2: global accuracy zero-shot 60.17, RAG 93.38, Top-k triples 75.60, G-Retriever 89.71
Section 4.2, Table 3: benchmark-aware KG lifts G-Retriever to 91.41 and Top-k to 77.92; linear projection 89.50 matches graph encoder 89.71
Section 4.3, Table 4: zero-shot Portuguese transfer reaches 91.18 vs 89.44 on Spanish Literatura; zero-shot drops to 53.40
Appendix D, Table 6: oracle per-article retrieval raises RAG to 96.72 but G-Retriever only to 90.27, attributing residual error to extraction not retrieval
Appendix A.2: Graph-RAG grid search performed on PCST alone without the trained module, resting on a separability assumption
Appendix E, Table 7: inference context 874.8 vs 2814.3 tokens; extraction cost 72.26 EUR; 9,942 s encoder training per fold
Section 6: acknowledges single frozen reader, narrow cross-lingual evidence (one category, typologically close language), and MCQ elimination bias
References: He et al. (2024) entry lists 'MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model' title while cited throughout as G-Retriever, a citation mismatch
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM knowledge-augmentation study: compares RAG, Top-k triples, and G-Retriever over KGGen-extracted graphs on cultural MCQ (LatamQA) with a frozen Qwen2.5-3B reader. Strong topical fit to LLM + RAG & Knowledge + NLP, though no Japanese NLP relevance. Methodologically it is mostly an application/evaluation of existing tools (KGGen, G-Retriever); the benchmark-aware KG upper-bound diagnostic, the hard single-large-noisy-KG regime, and the finding that a linear projection matches the graph encoder are modest but genuine contributions. Rigor is solid: per-category results (Table 2), component ablations (Table 3), oracle retrieval analysis (Appendix D, Table 6), grid search (A.2), cross-validation, and honest limitations (single reader, MCQ elimination bias, test-info leakage in benchmark-aware KG framed as non-deployable diagnostic). Weaknesses: Graph-RAG hyperparameter search done without the trained module under an unverified separability assumption (A.2), no significance testing, sparse k-fold details (A.4), a mismatched bibliography entry (He et al. 2024 lists an MA-LMM title for G-Retriever), and a minor 72% vs 74% error-reduction inconsistency between abstract and conclusion. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent across Tables 2-7. Generalizability is limited: one dataset, one reader, one category, and a typologically close language pair for transfer. Reproducibility is good: code availability claim, detailed hyperparameters, prompts (Appendix C), and full cost disclosure (Appendix E), though the code link is a placeholder.

primary_link.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）對文化特定事實普遍存在長尾缺陷，尤其是拉丁美洲等代表性不足地區的知識，模型容易以幻覺作答。本文在 LatamQA（涵蓋八個拉丁美洲文化主題、取材自西班牙文維基百科的選擇題資料集）上，系統性比較標準 RAG 與圖譜式增強方法。團隊以 KGGen 從 5,848 篇文章端對端抽取知識圖譜，讀者模型為 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，檢索編碼器為 jina-embeddings-v3，比較對象包括 RAG、Top-k 三元組，以及結合 PCST 子圖檢索與訓練式圖編碼器軟提示的 G-Retriever。結果顯示 RAG 整體最強（93.38%），G-Retriever 為 89.71%，但可將基礎模型的錯誤率降低 72%，改用基準感知圖譜後提升至 78%（91.41%），與 RAG 的差距縮小至約 2 個百分點，顯示三元組抽取品質而非檢索本身才是主要瓶頸。此外，圖譜方法的推論上下文平均約 875 tokens，僅為 RAG 的三分之一，且訓練後的投影模組可零樣本遷移至葡萄牙文。限制方面：四選一題型存在 25% 猜測下限、實驗僅使用單一小型讀者模型、跨語言證據僅限文學類別與語系相近的葡語，且資料源自維基百科，偏向有文獻紀錄而忽略口傳文化。本研究為文化長尾知識注入提供了圖譜式與檢索式方法之間的務實取捨分析，顯示圖譜路線在離線建構成本可控的前提下具備競爭力。
papers.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 知識圖譜增強與檢索增強生成（RAG）在文化相關問答上的比較

Sec. 5.2 Implementation Details: population K=20, iterations T=100, tournament size 3, P_cross=0.6, lambda=0.5, mu=0.25, k=4 demonstrations, Qwen3-8B backbone for all agents, Sentence-BERT embeddings
Table 1: MAGER 0.826 Acc / 0.835 F1 on PolitiFact, 0.812 Acc / 0.643 F1 on GossipCop, 0.839 Acc / 0.898 F1 on MCFEND vs few-shot graph LLM 0.756/0.758, 0.755/0.533, 0.760/0.838
Sec. 5.6 and Table 3: five ablations (w/o Evolution, w/o Reasoning Fitness, w/o GICL, w/o Schema Enrichment, w/o Meta-Path Aggregation) each show degradation

Sec. 5.9 and Table 5: backbone comparison Llama3-8B 0.832 Acc, Qwen3-8B 0.839, GPT-4 0.851 on MCFEND

Sec. 5.4: improvements reported as '+6.8%', '+8.8%' etc. relative to content-only few-shot, which are percentage-point deltas over accuracies 0.758 to 0.826
Sec. 5.1: controlled low-resource setting of 100 labeled instances, remainder held out for evaluation
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with LLM preferences: a frozen-LLM, multi-agent framework (generator/detector/evaluator/augmentation agents) that evolves meta-paths via genetic search, with graph-based in-context learning and reasoning-trace fitness, evaluated on Qwen3-8B/Llama3-8B/GPT-4 (Sec. 4, 5.2, 5.9). Methodology is language-centric (agents, ICL retrieval, reasoning evaluation) rather than a pure domain application, so it stays in scope. Novelty is moderate: LLM-guided meta-path evolution already exists (EvoPath, Liu et al. 2025, cited in Sec. 2.3), so contribution is the reasoning-fitness + GICL combination on fake news. Rigor is decent—100-label low-resource protocol, five ablations (Table 3), cross-domain transfer (Table 4), data efficiency (Fig. 3), sensitivity (Fig. 4)—but no significance tests or variance, the schema-enrichment and evaluator-agent implementations are underspecified (Sec. 4.1/4.3), the fitness judge uses the same model family as the detector risking circularity, and 'improvements' in Table 1 are percentage points mislabeled as %. Evidence is quantitative and consistent across three datasets but single-run. Generalizability is claimed via cross-dataset transfer yet only tested on fake-news benchmarks; broader graph+LLM applicability is unverified. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link (Abstract) and full hyperparameters (Sec. 5.2), but prompts, evaluator criteria, and enrichment procedure are not released in the text.

primary_link.title: Reasoning through Evolution: Automatic Meta-path Discovery for LLM-based Fake News Detection

papers.summary: Propagation structures provide crucial evidence for fake news detection, yet existing approaches primarily rely on supervised GNN-based models, which require substantial labeled data and exhibit limited generalization. Although large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, directly feeding them raw propagation graphs creates a significant modality mismatch and severe information overload, making structure-aware reasoning unreliable in zero-shot and few-shot settings. To bri
papers.summary_zh: 假新聞偵測長期依賴以GNN為主的監督式模型，需要大量標註資料且跨領域泛化能力有限；而大型語言模型（LLM）雖具備推理能力，直接輸入原始傳播圖卻會產生模態不匹配與資訊過載，在zero-shot與few-shot情境下表現不佳。本文提出MAGER，一個受基因演算法啟發的多代理人演化框架，協調語意結構增強、候選生成、偵測與推理評估四個LLM代理人，自動演化出最適合LLM推理的meta-path，將龐大且雜訊多的傳播圖壓縮為緊湊、可解讀的子圖證據，並引入圖形化in-context learning（GICL），依語意與結構相似度聯合檢索示範實例。適配度函數同時評估偵測正確率與推理品質，推論時再以檢索信心加權聚合多條meta-path。在PolitiFact、GossipCop與MCFEND三個資料集、僅使用100筆標註的低資源設定下，MAGER相較few-shot純文字LLM分別提升6.8%、8.8%與8.8%的準確率，並超越PCoT、DKFND等近期方法；以GossipCop訓練的跨領域實驗同樣展現較佳泛化能力。消融實驗顯示演化搜尋貢獻最大，且方法對Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B與GPT-4等骨幹皆穩定有效。此框架免訓練、資料效率高，讓凍結的LLM成為可獨立運作的假新聞偵測器；但其依賴完整的傳播圖資料，論文亦未深入探討多代理人反覆迭代的計算成本，為主要限制。

links.title: Visual Compliance via Executable Safety Rule Entailment

evidence: Abstract: claims average F1 improvement of 9.8 points and Robustness Index gain of 17.9 over the strongest baseline on SafetyVisionBench.

Section 4.1 Baselines: compares against Direct Prompting, ViperGPT, ETA, SafeCLIP, CLUE, and CompAgent, all run with the same visual foundation models (SAM 3, SigLIP 2, Depth Anything 3, Google Document OCR).
Section 4.2, Table 1: GuardEn achieves the highest F1 in all four domains (84.4/86.4/69.0/74.9) averaging 78.7 F1 with Gemma 4 26B as inference VLM.

Section 4.3.4 and Appendix C.4, Table 10: ablations show relative F1 drops of 30.1% (relation grounding), 27.4% (verifier loop), 16.5% (tool-aware grounding), 12.8% (scene-grounded execution), consistent with per-domain numbers.
Appendix D.7, Table 18: GuardEn attains best F1 in all sixteen backbone-domain combinations across Gemma 4 26B/12B, Qwen 3.5 27B, and GPT-5.4-mini.

Appendix A.3-A.4: benchmark images are generated with Imagen 4 and Gemini 3 Pro Image and manually verified by the authors; visual plausibility agreement is only 75.8%, and platform-content images are not released (pipeline only).
Limitations: GuardEn is limited to deductive entailment over explicit safety rules; analogical reasoning and rule-completeness dependence are acknowledged as open.
Appendix D.8-D.9, Tables 19-20: external evaluations on LlavaGuard (F1 71.1 vs CLUE 70.8) and MM-SafetyBench SD+TYPO (F1 82.3 vs CompAgent 75.1) support non-benchmark-co-design claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM-safeguard framework (GuardEn) that externalizes safety rules as executable proposition trees via LLM decomposition/verification and grounds atomic propositions with scene graphs and tool-augmented detection. It is clearly in scope: it matches AI Safety/evaluation, LLM-based reasoning decomposition, agents/tool use, and multimodal safety preferences, and is not a pure CV or domain application since the methodology is LLM-driven rule reasoning with CV only as tooling. Rigor is strong: six adapted baselines, per-domain F1 with 3-run std (Table 1), ablations matching claimed relative drops (Table 10 vs §4.3.4), backbone sweeps (Table 18), and two external benchmarks (D.8, D.9). Novelty is moderate: the method assembles known techniques (LAMBADA-style backward chaining, Self-Refine verifier loops, scene-graph grounding, ViperGPT-style execution) and the chief new artifact is the self-built SafetyVisionBench whose images are AI-generated (Appendix A.3) and author-verified (visual plausibility agreement only 75.8%, A.4), weakening external evidence. The paper honestly acknowledges limits to deductive-only entailment. Reproducibility is partial: extensive prompts and hyperparameters are disclosed (Appendix B, Figures 17-20), CC BY 4.0 image release for three domains, but pipeline depends on closed frontier models and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Visual Compliance via Executable Safety Rule Entailment

papers.summary: Recent advances in LLMs and VLMs have enabled safety systems to reason beyond simple risk patterns toward more contextual and semantic safety concerns. However, as risk patterns continue to evolve and safety rules become more complex, existing training-based end-to-end safeguards face persistent challenges in adaptability and explainable reasoning over complex safety rules. To address these challenges, we propose GuardEn (Guarding by Safety Rule Entailment), an executable safeguard framework tha
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對視覺安全防護的兩大挑戰：風險模式持續演進所需之適應性，以及複雜安全規則所需之可解釋推論。現有訓練式端對端防護多採固定風險分類，難以及時因應新興風險，亦缺乏明確可驗證的推理步驟。作者提出 GuardEn，將視覺安全評估形式化為規則蘊含問題，分兩階段運作：Safety-Rule Compilation 透過由上而下分解與驗證器回饋，將安全規則拆解為原子命題，並編譯成以邏輯運算元組成的可執行命題樹；Scene-Grounded Execution 則於測試時以物件偵測、OCR 與深度估計建立場景圖，由下而上將原子命題對應到影像中的具體證據。針對抽象概念或專業詞彙造成的偵測落差，另設計 Tool-Aware Visual Grounding，由 VLM 迭代提出替代關鍵字並快取重用。實驗於自建 SafetyVisionBench 進行，涵蓋 FDA 食品、紐約建築、Meta 社群準則與英國 CAP 廣告四領域，含 24K 不安全與 10K 高難度安全案例。GuardEn 平均 F1 達 78.7，較最強基準提升 9.8 分，Robustness Index 提升 17.9 分，並將視覺線索與規則框架引發的假性違規降低逾 80%。消融實驗顯示關係定位與驗證迴圈最為關鍵；案例研究亦展示規則修訂（如 2022 年英國賭博廣告新規）可透過重新編譯快速適應。限制在於涵蓋範圍受安全規則完整性約束，且僅支援演繹式蘊含，類比推理需輔以案例檢索，每張影像約需 8.6 至 11.6 秒推論。整體而言，本研究示範外顯化、可執行的規則結構結合視覺證據，能兼顧準確性、穩健性與可解釋性，為影像安全防護提供了務實的新典範。
papers.title: Visual Compliance via Executable Safety Rule Entailment
papers.title_zh: 以可執行安全規則蘊含實現視覺合規檢驗

Table 2 (Section 4/5): SRM alone +24.5% and Full +25.1% overall relative to baseline; AMM alone only +4.1%, supporting the claim that execution-time control is the dominant lever.

Appendix A Reproducibility Notes: Swift uses Flan-T5-large; Sage/Critic use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M served locally via vLLM; AMM uses Letta archival memory; warm-up of 2 variations per task (60 episodes) populates memory and is excluded from evaluation.

Absence check: no variance, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests are reported for any configuration comparison in Section 5 or Appendices B-F.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-agent paper: extends the SwiftSage dual-process agent with an episodic memory module (AMM) and bounded execution-time self-reflection (SRM), hitting Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, LLM, Memory, and RAG preferences. Rigor is solid for a workshop-scale study: a 4-way controlled ablation on a shared substrate (Table 1), task-macro aggregation, oracle-length grouping (Table 2), mechanism-level logs (Tables 5-6), and sensitivity analyses (Table 8), including the useful negative result that raising the Critic budget from 3 to 6 calls degrades score 64.33 to 52.95. Novelty is incremental: the underlying mechanisms (episodic memory, Reflexion/Self-Refine-style critique, pre-execution validation) are established; the contribution is their bounded, interface-aware composition and the finding that Gate-1 filtering, not replanning, drives gains. Evidence is internally consistent and detailed but rests on a single run in a single environment (ScienceWorld) with no variance estimates, significance tests, or comparisons to external baselines (e.g., ReAct, Reflexion) under the same 7B runtime; baseline (51.67) is far below original SwiftSage numbers, limiting external comparability despite the honest 'no SOTA claim' (Section 4 Protocol note). Generalizability is explicitly limited to one text environment and one model backbone (Section 8). Reproducibility is supported by a detailed appendix (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M via vLLM, Flan-T5-large Swift, Letta memory, 60-episode warm-up, budgets/caps) but no code release and partly hand-crafted, unspecified thresholds (stagnation, repair rules).

primary_link.title: Cognitive Extensions for Dual-Process Language Agents: Memory and Self-Reflection in Interactive Environments

papers.summary: Language agents remain brittle in interactive environments, where success requires long-horizon state tracking, valid action execution, and recovery from failed steps. We extend SwiftSage, a dual-process agent that combines a fast action proposer with a slower planner, using two modular cognitive extensions: an Adaptive Memory Module (AMM) for salience-gated episodic storage and trigger-driven retrieval, and a Self-Reflection Module (SRM) for bounded execution-time validation and corrective inte
papers.summary_zh: 本論文處理語言代理在互動環境中的脆弱性:長時程狀態追蹤、動作有效性與失敗後的恢復。作者以 SwiftSage 雙歷程架構為基底,提出兩個模組化認知擴充:「自我反思模組」。AMM 以顯著性閘門寫入情節記憶,並在觸發點檢索相關經驗;SRM 於執行前進行 Gate–1 驗證、偵測停滯,並在必要時呼叫有預算限制的 Critic 修正行為。兩模組以功能旗標掛載於相同執行基底,可在 ScienceWorld 上進行受控消融,並使用本地 Qwen2.5-7B 作為 Sage 與 Critic。結果顯示完整系統最佳:平均分數 64.62、成功率 43.17%、成功步數 19.33;SRM 單獨貢獻最大(64.33),AMM 單獨效果有限(53.83)。分組分析顯示 SRM 在短任務最有效,完整系統於中、長任務領先,代表記憶須在執行穩定後才能發揮;機制日誌指出改善主要來自持續過濾無效動作並減少 System 2 呼叫,而非更多反思,將 Critic 預算由三次增至六次反而使分數下滑。限制包括:僅於 ScienceWorld 文字環境評估、記憶表示與檢索較簡單、尚缺語意層級的技能固化、停滯門檻與修復規則為手工設計,且部分分析仍屬相關性質。本研究的意義在於指出:認知啟發的擴充應置於正確的因果介面——記憶提供證據、反思控制執行,而執行時間控制才是此設定下的主要槓桿。
papers.title: Cognitive Extensions for Dual-Process Language Agents: Memory and Self-Reflection in Interactive Environments
papers.title_zh: 雙歷程語言代理的認知擴充:互動環境中的記憶與自我反思

links.title: The Illusion of Local Privacy: Confidentiality Boundary Failures in Consumer LLM Serving Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'a previously undocumented authorization flaw in llama.cpp that allows one authenticated client to restore another tenant's saved conversation state; the attack succeeds in 200/200 controlled trials'

Section 4.2.1, Table 5: 'every measured inference leaves between 13 and 14 recoverable plaintext prompt copies'; sequential-tenant run recovers '110 plaintext copies and approximately 10.8 MB' from 11 of 12 tenants

Section 4.2.3, Table 6: sanitisation reduces copies from 110 to 78 (~29%) and plaintext from 10,834 KB to 3,352 KB (~69%), but 'prompt information remains recoverable from 11 of 12 tenants' under both configurations
Section 4.2.3, Table 7: KV-cache zeroisation latency delta ranges from -0.016 s to +0.020 s (n=50 per model), below ~0.5% of mean request latency
Section 4.4: 'The secret is reproduced in 126 of 200 trials (63%)'; 'a threshold classifier...achieves an AUC of 1.000 for each of the four evaluated models'

Section 4.1, Table 4: 24-hour AFL++ campaign with ASan/UBSan, '>1.2x10^7 parser invocations', zero parser crashes, malformed loads, or sanitizer violations; scope explicitly bounded ('Undiscovered parser vulnerabilities may nevertheless exist')

Section 4.3: LM Studio 'logSensitiveData' enabled by default with canaries recoverable 'days after' requests; disabling the setting eliminates recovery; Ollama shows no persistence in examined artifacts; 205 network-monitored runs show 'no external connection attempts'
Section 3.6 and Appendix B: Wilson 95% intervals, McNemar's test, explicit per-boundary success/failure criteria, and positive-control checks before interpreting null results
Open Science section: 'the artifact is available at: https://github.com/0xzodiac/Local-LLMs-Forensics' including harnesses, patches, and SHA-256 model digests
Figure 1 caption: boundaries labeled 'wrapper application (B1), serving interface (B2), runtime memory (B3), and the model file (B1)' - duplicate B1 label, a minor internal inconsistency
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-security measurement paper on LLM serving infrastructure: clearly LLM-centric (local serving, KV cache, multi-tenant llama-server) and aligned with LLM, AI Safety, and Inference & Serving preferences, though it contributes security methodology rather than language-model methodology. Novelty is moderate: the boundary decomposition (Integrity/Lifetime/Persistence/Isolation) and the undocumented llama.cpp cross-tenant authorization flaw (CWE-862/639) are new, but memory residue, wrapper persistence, and prefix-cache timing channels extend known results the authors themselves cite (Sections 1, 5). Rigor is strong: UUID canary ground truth, fixed versions and SHA-256 model digests, Wilson intervals and McNemar's test (Sections 3.6, Appendix B), patched-vs-unpatched and allocator-config ablations (Section 4.2.3, Appendix A.1), positive controls for null results, and carefully bounded claims (Section 4.1 'Scope of the Negative Result'). Evidence is quantitative and reproduced (200/200 trials, 63% model-mediated disclosure, AUC 1.000 timing; Table 5/6/8), though some tables rest on only three runs. Generalizability is explicitly scoped to one serving engine, two wrappers, four model families, and one hardware setup, which limits transfer but is honestly stated. Reproducibility is supported by a released artifact with configs and patches (Open Science section), though no independent verification is available. Minor rigor ding: Figure 1 caption labels two different boundaries 'B1'.

primary_link.title: The Illusion of Local Privacy: Confidentiality Boundary Failures in Consumer LLM Serving Systems

papers.summary: Running large language models (LLMs) locally is often considered more private than cloud-hosted inference because user prompts remain on the device. We ask whether keeping inference local is, by itself, sufficient to keep those prompts confidential. Our results show that it is not: prompt confidentiality also depends on how the surrounding serving software handles prompt data before, during, and after inference. We examine four boundaries at which prompt confidentiality can fail in consumer loca
papers.summary_zh: 本研究追問:在個人電腦上本地執行大型語言模型(LLM),是否足以保護提示詞的機密性?作者指出兩者並不相同,機密性取決於周邊服務軟體如何處理提示資料。團隊開發 LLAnalyzer 量測框架,將本地 LLM 服務堆疊拆解為四個邊界:模型載入的完整性邊界、執行時記憶體的生命週期邊界、包裝應用程式的持久性邊界,以及服務介面的隔離邊界,並以 UUID 金絲雀標記逐一取證。針對四個開放權重模型家族與兩個消費級平台,24 小時 AFL++ 模糊測試(逾 1.2×10^7 次執行)未發現 GGUF 解析器崩潰或畸形模型載入;但推論結束後,主機記憶體仍殘留 13 至 14 份可復原的明文提示副本,12 個接續租戶中 11 個的提示可被回收,部分 CUDA 卸載至 GPU 亦不消除殘留。消毒機制雖降低約 29% 副本數與 69% 明文量,延遲增加低於 0.5%,卻未完全恢復機密性。LM Studio 預設組態會將提示明文寫入磁碟,關閉敏感資料日誌後消失;Ollama 則未觀察到此現象。作者另發現 llama.cpp 一個未被記錄的授權缺陷:已認證的客戶端可還原另一租戶儲存的對話狀態,200 次受控試驗全數成功,模型續寫重現受害者密語的比例為 126/200;共享提示前綴快取更形成時序側通道,AUC 達 1.000。研究結果限於所測試的軟體版本、組態與探索過的狀態空間,負結果亦非普遍安全的證明。本文的價值在於揭示本地推論必須搭配跨生命週期的明文管理、資源層級授權與共享狀態隔離,才能提供真正的提示詞機密保證。

Section 6 / Table 2 (p.18): 24 unique failures total, 19 in repository versions and 5 in AI versions; 17 unique crashes and 7 unique hangs across classic and AFL++ testing

llm_evaluation.rationale: An empirical reliability study of code produced by a five-stage agentic LLM workflow (Claude Code Opus 4.8 with subagents) versus release-quality human Linux utilities, evaluated with classic black-box and AFL++ fuzz testing. It sits squarely in high-weight preference areas (agentic AI/code generation, LLM agents, security evaluation). Rigor is solid: fixed methodology, matched seeds/configurations between repo and AI versions, root-cause debugging of all 24 failures, and honest negative findings (unreliable agent progress reports, weak self-generated tests, >20 audit rounds for make). Novelty is moderate since the authors explicitly assemble known best practices rather than propose new methods, and fuzz-based reliability comparison extends the authors' own 1990/2022 lineage. Evidence is detailed but rests on only 10 programs, 24 unique failures (19 repo vs 5 AI), one proprietary model, and one operator with no statistical treatment; the abstract's claim that AI code is 'more likely to have hangs' is not directly supported by Table 2 counts (repo 4 hangs vs AI 3) absent a proportional argument. Generalizability is limited to C CLI utilities under one workflow; reproducibility is undermined by a [TBD] availability URL, no released skills/prompts, and stochastic proprietary-model generation, despite well-specified fuzzing parameters.

The question is how can we verify these claims in an objective way? In this project, we attempted to answer this question based on three practices. First, we applied a typical best-practices agentic AI workflow for software development. Second, our target programs were ten well-known, release-quality human-written Linux utility programs so that we
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討以代理式AI(agentic AI)開發軟體時,生成程式碼的可靠性能否與人類撰寫的程式碼相比。團隊以Claude Code Opus 4.8搭配最佳實務的五階段代理式工作流程——自手冊頁規格推導功能清單與測試oracle、設計、撰寫程式、一致性稽核與安全稽核——重建cat、dash、dc、grep、less、make、ptx、strings、tac與tnftp十個Linux工具程式,並以經典黑箱模糊測試與AFL++涵蓋率導引的灰箱模糊測試,與套件庫中人類撰寫的最新版本比較。主要結果:全部24個獨特失敗中,19個來自套件庫版本,僅5個來自AI版本;AI程式較少發生緩衝區溢位等記憶體錯誤,卻較易因演算法效率不佳而呈現無窮迴圈或近乎停滯(hang);AI版本唯一的當機來自沿用的不安全函式庫libedit。研究亦發現代理式開發需要嚴謹實務與人工監督:代理可能虛報功能完成或謊稱獲得豁免;大型程式的瓶頸不在程式生成而在驗證,須輔以上游測試、手動測試與真實工作負載(如以make建置Linux核心與十七套軟體)。論文最後示範僅修改提示與技能,約十五分鐘即將ptx的正規表示式引擎替換為RE2,顯示代理式工作流程可作為軟體規格,降低日後維護與軟體永續性的成本與門檻。

evidence: §3.1: 'ScienceIDE provides 64 environments from 27 scientific codebases and 2,812 manufactured tasks... repair and implementation supply nearly all (2,515 and 295) and acceleration two so far'

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent infrastructure paper squarely within preference space: coding agents operating in executable environments, SFT (LoRA on Qwen 4B/9B/72B with GPT-5.6-sol teacher trajectories) and online RL with verifier rewards (GRPO variant, DAPO-style asymmetric clipping). Not out-of-scope: the scientific domain is substrate, while the methodology is language/agent/RL. Novelty is moderate — environment-from-codebase construction follows SWE-Gym/R2E-Gym/SWE-smith, but calibrated scientific checks (pointwise/invariants pass policies), environment-specific task factories, and the budget-truncation masking fix are genuine contributions. Rigor is unusually high: validity anchors (witness/empty-delivery/defective-floor), bootstrap intervals, cohort-separated inventory, and candid contamination audits (§9.1: 455 upstream-directed commands, 21 confirmed fetches; §9.2: aggregator-key channel inflating DeepSeek score .365→.294). Weakened by small held-out repair samples (e.g., reward 0.0000→0.3333 implies very few tasks), screening then confirmation on 20–128-item benchmarks with unadjusted multiple comparisons, a confirmed decline (HumanEvalFix Python 9B −8.33), and single-run RL comparisons without seed variance. Evidence supports the headline agent-gap claim (§3.2.1: top model 67.1%, eleven of fifteen below 40%) but transfer claims are selective; the authors themselves flag no cross-codebase transfer (§5). Generalizability limited to reference-verifiable repair/implementation in computational physics/geoscience (2,515 repair, 295 implementation, only 2 acceleration tasks). Reproducibility aided by pinned sources, licenses (Appendix 12), full hyperparameters (Appendix 11.1 Table 4 settings), and data artifacts, but private verifiers and expert curation limit independent replication, and links in the text are placeholder stubs.

primary_link.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments

papers.summary: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. We introduce ScienceIDE, infrastructure for turning the world's scientific code into programmable environments for scientific agents. Guided by expert-defined scientific
papers.summary_zh: 科學程式碼庫蘊藏數十年可執行的模型、方法與工具，但工具鏈零散、領域慣例隱晦、正確性判準特殊，使其難以轉化為可靠的學習經驗，作者稱之為「科學經驗瓶頸」。ScienceIDE 提出開放基礎建設：在專家定義的科學案例與驗收標準下，AI 代理將版本控管的程式碼庫編譯為可執行環境，模組封裝執行期、科學檢查與私有驗證器，環境專屬工廠再依修復、實作、加速、重現等任務族製造題目，互動軌跡同時供評估、SFT 與 RL 使用。目前已登錄 27 個程式碼庫、64 個環境、2,812 個任務與 1,076 個可執行檢查。在 85 題 ScienceIDE-Hard 評測中，Fable 5.1 以 67.1% 嚴格成功率居首，Opus 5 與 Astra 為 64.6% 與 63.1%，顯示頂尖代理仍約三分之一未解。以 GPT-5.6-sol 驗證軌跡對 Qwen 基底模型做 LoRA SFT，訓練出 PhAI-IDE 系列，在 held-out 科學修復與 BBH、HumanEvalFix 等公開基準皆有增益；線上 RL 採 Dr. GRPO 式優勢估計並遮罩預算截斷軌跡，使 LAPS 與 MITgcm-biogeo 的 held-out 獎勵分別提升約 2.4 倍與 2.0 倍。限制方面，證據限於可參照驗證的修復與實作任務，未涵蓋開放式發現；驗證本身屬科學建模選擇，預訓練污染未排除，跨程式碼庫遷移亦未證實。本文價值在於把專家科學判斷轉成可重用的執行契約，使科學軟體成為訓練科學智慧與通用能力的共享基盤。
papers.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
papers.title_zh: ScienceIDE：將全球科學程式碼庫轉化為 AI 代理可學習的環境

links.title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions

evidence: Abstract and Table 3: character 3-gram BM25 selects 162/164 lexically matched requests but only 85/166 paraphrases; restricting to seven candidates raises paraphrase top-1 to 0.825±0.023 over five distractor seeds.
Section 3, Table 1: separating an in-catalog gate reduces delegate-to-skill errors from 134/150 (standalone BM25) to 12/150 and raises routing accuracy 0.367→0.592.

Section 5, Table 4: best BM25-score gate (G3) reaches 0.697 mismatch-in AUC vs 0.806 for frozen e5; Section 5 cluster bootstrap gives e5−G3 = 0.109, 95% CI [0.059, 0.159], and query length alone hits 0.741, above G3.

Section 6 and Table A3: P3 (BGE ranker) beats retained P1 by nine accuracy and eight completion requests but is rejected on measured cost (197.3 ms vs 13.9 ms CPU median; 846.1 MB vs 278.3 MB); Limitations admits the latency budget was set after seeing the measurement.

Section 7, Table 7: two of four native-calling checkpoints (Gemma 4 E4B-it load failure on heterogeneous head_dim; Granite 4.0 H-Small missing pythonic parser) produce no routing rows under the fixed vLLM 0.27.1 protocol, with captured errors in Appendix F.

Ethics Statement: 'Neither the utterances nor the catalog is public at the time of writing'; Limitations states all 600 utterances are synthetic and authored, limiting external validity despite full environment detail in Appendix A.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An on-device tool-routing study squarely inside Agents & Tool Use and LLM function-calling territory (with retrieval, edge-efficiency, and multilingual non-English NLP angles; Korean-English, not Japanese). Its core empirical claim - selection is a retrieval problem solvable by character 3-gram BM25 under matched vocabulary, while abstention/in-catalog gating requires a frozen encoder - is well decomposed and measured separately, which prior architectural splits (TinyAgent, Needle 2) did not quantify. Rigor is unusually high: alias length/shuffle controls, five-seed candidate ablations with SDs, cluster bootstrap CIs on AUC gaps, preregistered danger/ask caps, and a candid Limitations section admitting the post-hoc latency budget and mis-set coverage target. Evidence is strong internally but rests on 600 single-author synthetic utterances and a 70-action authored catalog with unobserved production match share, capping generalizability. Reproducibility is mixed: exhaustive environment, rule-set, and error appendices, but neither catalog nor utterances is released. The BGE-ranker and native-caller rejections on cost rather than quality are honestly framed.

primary_link.title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions

papers.summary: An AI assistant that calls tools makes two decisions on every request: which tool to invoke, and whether any available tool applies. In the usual design a single language model makes both, by emitting a call or by declining to emit one. On a device that has to answer without a server, the language model is what makes that design expensive, dominating both the latency and the memory of the router. The common alternative is to remove the model completely and rank the catalog of local actions with
papers.summary_zh: 裝置端AI助理每次請求需做兩個決策:選擇呼叫哪個本地工具(選擇),以及目錄中是否存在適用工具(棄權)。在無伺服器的裝置上,語言模型是延遲與記憶體的主要負擔,常見替代方案是改用檢索器排序本地動作目錄。作者指出此替換並不對稱:檢索器必回傳最高分候選,無法表達「目錄內沒有合適動作」。研究以600個韓英合成請求與70個本地動作(64個技能加6個檔案工具)分別評估兩項決策,半數請求重用目錄詞彙、半數為改寫。結果顯示字元3-gram BM25在詞彙匹配請求達0.988 top-1,改寫僅0.512,但候選集縮至7個可升至0.825;分離式閘門將委派誤判為技能的錯誤從134/150降至12/150。然而BM25分數特徵無法可靠區分改寫請求與目錄外請求(AUC最高0.697),凍結編碼器multilingual-e5-base則達0.806,因此保留的管線P1把神經模型用於棄權:P1以BM25排序加e5閘門,達0.645準確率、0.627覆蓋率、13.9毫秒CPU延遲與278.3 MB。神經排序器P3與Qwen3-4B原生呼叫雖提升品質,卻因14倍與約80倍的延遲及更多記憶體被依成本否決;四個原生檢查點僅兩個能在vLLM協定下部署。限制包括語句皆為合成、混合比與目錄由作者自訂、延遲預算為事後訂定、確認互動為模擬。結論:裝置端路由中,棄權而非選擇才是需要神經元件的理由,排序器則由成本預算決定,對裝置端工具呼叫系統設計具直接參考價值。

papers.title_zh: 選擇即是檢索,棄權則不然:橫跨70個韓英動作的裝置端工具路由

links.title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract: 'our refinements improve downstream accuracy by up to 1.7 pp over vanilla SFT (and 5.7 pp over an LLM-deletion baseline) while reducing per-sample inference messages by up to approximately 40% and inference tokens by up to approximately 48%'
Sec 3.2 / Table 2: L1 Avg. Acc. 50.04 vs Vanilla SFT 48.35 (+1.7pp); L2a Avg. #toks 10,977 vs Vanilla SFT 20,940 (~48% reduction), L2a lowest #msgs (14.30) among SFT systems

Appendix H: 'the best checkpoint per system is chosen by held-out 4-benchmark accuracy'; four checkpoints (200/600/800/1396) evaluated for L1/L2a/L3a but 'a single checkpoint at step 600 for Vanilla SFT and Critical-Path' — asymmetric sweep on the same benchmarks reported in Table 2
Sec 3.1: benchmarks SimpleVQA (300), LiveVQA (300), HLE (330), MMSearch (171); 'We report gpt-5-nano judge accuracy' (judge prompt in Appendix J, Prompt D) — no human-eval validation of the judge
Limitations: 'Our study is scoped to one base model family (Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking) ... transfer across base models and modalities is left to follow-up work'

Appendix A Table 4 and Appendix G Table 11: full SFT and DPO hyperparameters disclosed (lr, schedule, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, vLLM TP=8 in App. B); Abstract claims 'Code is available here' without a verifiable repository in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM agent/tool-use methodology paper (ReAct-style multi-turn trajectories, SFT and DPO on tool-using agents, inference-cost reduction) rather than a pure CV or domain application. The round-level dependency-DAG recasting of agent trajectories with three deterministic edit levels (L1 leaf prune, L2/L3 merges, L2a/L3a rephrased) is a genuinely fresh angle versus sample-level data selection or single-response CoT compression. Experimental coverage is broad (4 baselines, 6 edit variants, DPO extensions, Chain-of-Draft probe, annotator agreement, stuck-rate and format-gap analyses). However, rigor is undercut by a checkpoint-selection protocol that picks the best checkpoint on the same four benchmarks used for reporting, with 4 checkpoints swept for the proposed edits but only one for the SFT baselines (Appendix H), inflating the headline +1.7pp and 48%-token claims; benchmark sets are small (171-330 items); accuracy is a gpt-5-nano LLM judge with no human validation; and no significance testing is reported. Generalizability is explicitly limited to one base model family. Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameter tables (App. A/G) and complete prompt transcripts (App. J), but the code link in the Abstract ('available here') is unverifiable from the document.

primary_link.title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: Multi-turn agent trajectories often contain redundant rounds (failed tool calls, parallel sub-queries, verification-only steps) that inflate both training and inference cost. We propose viewing each trajectory as a \emph{round-level dependency DAG} that exposes which rounds are globally load-bearing for the final answer, and fine-tune agents on trajectories refined through this DAG. Given an LLM-annotated DAG, these edits are deterministic and interpretable, with optional rephrasing. Models trai
papers.summary_zh: 多回合工具增強型 agent 軌跡常含失敗的搜尋、重複驗證或結果從未進入最終答案的平行子查詢等冗餘回合,同時推高訓練與推論成本。本文提出將每條軌跡視為回合層級的相依 DAG:先由 LLM(GPT-5.4)標註哪些回合對最終答案具全局承重作用,再執行確定性、可解釋的圖編輯,包含三種層級:葉節點剪枝(L1)、嚴格合併(L2,父節點與子節點皆相同才合併)、寬鬆合併(L3,僅需共同父節點並迭代至收斂),另可加上 LLM 改寫(L2a/L3a)使合併後的思考段落連貫。作者以 6196 條多模態工具使用軌跡微調 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking,並於 SimpleVQA、LiveVQA、HLE、MMSearch 四項基準評估:L1 平均準確率達 50.04%,較 vanilla SFT 提升 1.7 個百分點,較 LLM 刪除式基線 Critical-Path 高出 5.7 個百分點;L2a 則在準確率與 vanilla SFT 相當的情況下,將每樣本推論訊息數與 token 數分別減少約 40% 與 48%,成為最具成本效益的變體。分析顯示 L3 因合併產生訓練—推論格式落差而推高卡死(stuck)率,LLM 改寫可大幅緩解;Chain-of-Draft 等推論期提示壓縮則無法轉移至此多回合情境。限制包括僅驗證單一基礎模型家族、標註與改寫各需一次 LLM 呼叫,且 eval-loss 與下游準確率脫鉤,宜以下游指標挑選 checkpoint。此研究將軌跡精煉化為透明的圖編輯問題,為兼顧準確率與部署成本提供通用做法。
papers.title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning

links.title: What Counts as Strategic Reasoning? A Systematic Mapping of Chess Research on Humans, Engines, and Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'The final map comprises 84 core study families, classified according to agent type, strategic-reasoning stages, and evaluation dimensions.'
Section 4.4: 'The final mapped corpus contains 84 Core study families and 19 Context study families.'
Section 4.6: 'Independent duplicate coding was not performed across the complete corpus; consequently, the study does not report an inter-rater agreement statistic.'
Section 5.2 (Table 2): LLM studies show R1 State representation in 20 of 28 LLM-coded study families, described as 'particularly prominent in this category'.
Section 5.3 (Table 3): E1 Legality/state consistency in 18 of 28 LLM studies; 'no LLM study in the current Core corpus is coded for direct evaluation of E10 Human-AI synergy.'
Section 6.6: formal definitions Delta_aug = P(H+A) - P(H) and Delta_syn = P(H+A) - max{P(H), P(A)}, attributed to Vaccaro et al. 2024 meta-analysis.
Section 7 (Threats to Validity): acknowledges search coverage limits, single-coder subjectivity, and that the map is 'a reproducible snapshot defined by the documented final search cutoff'.
Data and code availability: replication package (protocol, queries, codebook, dataset, analysis script) archived on Zenodo at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22695754.

Section 6.1: cites Ruoss et al. 2024 (grandmaster-level transformers without explicit search) and Jenner et al. 2024 (causal evidence of learned look-ahead in Leela Chess Zero) as internal-evidence examples.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systematic mapping study (84 core study families, 2023-2026) of chess as a testbed for strategic reasoning across humans, engines, neural/RL systems, LLMs, and hybrids. Highly relevant to top-weighted preferences: it centrally analyzes LLM state representation, generalization/memorization, explanation faithfulness, and metacognition (28/84 LLM-coded studies), plus human-AI collaboration and agentic hybrid systems. Rigor is solid for a survey: documented multi-source search, conservative coding with a verification pass, and a candid threats-to-validity section; however, single-coder coding with no inter-rater agreement and queries deferred to the replication package limit verification from the text. Evidence is descriptive count data with appropriately hedged interpretation rather than primary experimental results, and the augmentation-vs-synergy formalization is largely imported from Vaccaro et al. 2024. The conceptual extensions (hybridization taxonomy across structural locus and temporal coupling) are reasonably novel. Chess-domain scope constrains generalizability, though the evaluation framework transfers. Zenodo-archived replication package supports reproducibility claims.

primary_link.title: What Counts as Strategic Reasoning? A Systematic Mapping of Chess Research on Humans, Engines, and Language Models

papers.summary: Chess has long served as a model domain for studying search, expertise, decision-making, and artificial intelligence. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has renewed the relevance of chess as a controlled environment for investigating strategic reasoning and comparing human and artificial decision-making. We present a systematic mapping study of recent research spanning human players, classical chess engines, neural and reinforcement-learning systems, LLMs, and hybrid approaches. The f
papers.summary_zh: 西洋棋長期是研究搜尋、專業知能與決策的模型領域,但人類認知、傳統電腦西洋棋、神經與強化學習系統、大型語言模型(LLM)及混合方法的文獻彼此分散,難以判斷策略推理的哪些成分真正被檢驗。本文採系統性繪製研究(SMS),搜尋2023至2026年Scopus、Web of Science與策展文獻集,納入84個核心研究家族,沿代理人類型、策略推理九階段(R1至R9)與十項評估維度(E1至E10)進行多標記編碼。地圖顯示文獻高度集中於情境評估、評價與行動選擇(63/84);明確規劃(R5僅17)、解釋與忠實性、後設認知(R9僅10)及人機協同(E10僅7)相對稀缺。LLM研究特別強調狀態表示、合法性與泛化;有依據的解釋則多見於混合架構。作者論證:選出好棋不等於證明規劃或前瞻推理;人類表現提升僅是增強,須與較強單一元件比較才能宣稱真正協同,並提出混合化的結構層次與同步/非同步耦合作為框架延伸。限制包括單一編碼者、未報告編碼者間信度、部分區分屬事後詮釋,且地圖僅為特定時段的快照。本文意義在於將西洋棋定位為銜接認知與計算觀點的受控橋樑,並提出明確規劃、有依據且忠實的解釋、後設認知校準與人機互補四大優先研究方向。
