links.title: GYROval: A Robust Benchmark for Cultural Value Orientation in Large Language Models

evidence: Section 3.1: run-level self-consistency at temperature 0 ranges 91.7%-100% (median ~99.5%), ICC 0.748-1.000, effective sample sizes 214-296 vs 6,338-11,200 raw runs, justifying vignette-level analysis.
Section 3.2 and Table B.1: all twelve (factor, axis) cells exceed the 20,000-replicate permutation null p95; e.g., Modality/OE W=0.7398 vs null p95 0.3728, Modality/SS W=0.5099 vs 0.3729.

Section 3.5 / Table 2: stability ceilings computed from 800 rotations (item factors) and 600 run splits (paired factors); decision role has the lowest share of ceiling (0.620 SS), temperature the highest (0.989 SS).
Section 3.11.2 / Table 3: probe accuracies 68.3%-96.7% vs majority baselines 51.7%-90.0% across eight model-axis cells; margins explicitly reported (e.g., gemma OE +6.7 pp vs T-lite SS +40.0 pp).
Section 3.11.4: cross-model patching evaluated on n=8 (OE) and n=9 (SS) disagreement items with wide Wilson CIs; transfer asymmetry significant only on SS (Fisher p=4.11e-4, 9/9 vs 1/9).

Section 3.9: 48 analytical specifications yield stable concordance (e.g., modality/OE 0.7161-0.7406); refusal imputation shifts W by <=0.0051; two bootstrap percentile intervals exclude their own point estimates, an attenuation property the authors flag.
Section 2.2 and 4.7: no human baseline, ceiling, or external criterion gathered; single prompt template and fixed option order in the main run (counterbalanced re-run only planned, Section 2.3).

Data availability: instrument publicly released (github.com/SergAIvichLab/Vignette_questions) with 225-row EN/RU/temperature files and an audit script reproducing Section 2.1-2.2 structural numbers, though model responses and run-level labels are deliberately excluded from the released files.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuinely LLM-centric evaluation paper: a 224-item cultural value benchmark administered to 20 named LLMs (GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, Russian models) with a paired bilingual (EN/RU) protocol, a rank-concordance stability analysis against permutation nulls and stability ceilings, and a small mechanistic sub-study (linear probes, difference-of-means, RSA/CKA, activation patching). It matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, evaluation/benchmark, interpretability, AI-safety bias auditing) but misses the heaviest ones (no Japanese content, no core reasoning or agent methodology beyond an 'Agent' role factor). Methodological rigor is unusually strong: vignette-level unit of analysis justified via ICC and design effects (Section 3.1), 48 specification sensitivity grid (Section 3.9), explicit stability ceilings (Table 2), and an honest limitations list (Section 4.7). However, the paradigm is adapted from CDEval and the authors' own prior Hofstede study, so novelty is incremental; evidence for cross-model mechanistic transfer rests on only 8-9 disagreement items (Section 3.11.4); there is no human baseline or external criterion (Section 2.2, 4.7); and generalizability is constrained by the EN/RU-only, two-country-weighted panel admitted in the ethics statement.

primary_link.title: GYROval: A Robust Benchmark for Cultural Value Orientation in Large Language Models

papers.summary: We present a robust benchmark for measuring cultural value orientation in large language models on the two Inglehart-Welzel axes over several domains and roles (hence GYROval - Gridded Yielding of Robust value Orientation), together with the results of administering it to twenty models. Items are binary contrastive scenarios in the sense introduced by CDEval: both options are legitimate courses of action, neither is correct, there is no answer key, and a model's score on an axis is the proportio
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出GYROval，一套衡量大型語言模型文化價值取向的穩健基準，操作化Inglehart–Welzel文化地圖的兩大軸線：神聖—世俗與服從—解放。作者沿用CDEval的語意情境法，建構224個完全交叉因子設計的二選一對比情境（7個主題×4種決策角色×8個價值面向），每題兩個選項皆屬正當行動、無標準答案，模型得分為落在計分極性的回應比例。團隊對20個模型施測，其中11個另接受成對的俄文翻譯版本與第二組取樣溫度，並以平手修正的Kendall's W一致性係數，對照20,000次置換虛無分配評估排序穩定性，輔以2,000次bootstrap信賴區間。結果顯示：在決策角色、主題、語言與溫度四種擾動下，模型相對排序在所有實驗格均顯著高於隨機虛無，但絕對分數仍隨條件位移超過量表兩成，排序穩定與測量不變性是不可混同的兩項主張；角色敏感度跨模型相差6.5倍（解放軸）與5.3倍（神聖—世俗軸），取樣溫度最穩定、決策角色影響最大；改用俄文僅造成小幅位移而不改變整體排序。機制子研究在5個開放權重模型上，以線性探針與激活修補（activation patching）證實價值方向可從內部表徵解碼且具因果效力。限制包括缺乏人類基準與外部效標、僅使用單一提示模板、bootstrap區間因重抽衰減，以及機制子樣本偏小。此基準提醒：分數必須連同題組的領域與角色組成一併解讀，對審計部署中模型的文化規範偏差極具參考價值。
papers.title: GYROval: A Robust Benchmark for Cultural Value Orientation in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: GYROval：衡量大型語言模型文化價值取向的穩健基準

Table 7 (Appendix A.5): SR falls from 69.9 to 65.5 under D435-like disparity noise model
Section 4.4: real-world deployment on AgileX TRACER 2.0 with only 10 episodes per difficulty level per baseline, no statistical significance reported
Appendices A.9-A.10: complete reward equations (Eqs. 6-18) and GRPO hyperparameters (Table 9: G=8, epsilon=0.20, beta=0.02, lr 1e-6, 2000 steps)

Appendix A.11: stated limitation that the low-level module requires sensor-provided metric depth, limiting RGB-only deployment; no code or dataset availability statement appears anywhere in the provided text
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM-based embodied navigation agent whose core methodology is language-centric: coordinate-grounded structured chain-of-thought (Section 3.3), a teacher-VLM data engine producing GroundingCOTVLN-188K (Section 3.4), and GRPO-based RL post-training with execution-aware reward maps (Section 3.5, Appendices A.9-A.10). This places it squarely within reasoning/CoT, multimodal agents, and RL post-training preferences rather than pure robotics, so the 0.20 out-of-scope cap does not apply. Novelty is solid: temporally aligned grounded CoT (<obj>/<prev_obj> with SAM 3 world-marker tracking) and progress-aligned pixel goals as a reasoning-execution interface go beyond prior single-image grounding (ViGoRL) and latent-feature pixel goals (DualVLN), though each ingredient exists in prior work. Rigor is strong: extensive baseline table (Table 1), cross-dataset transfer (Table 2), component ablations (Table 3), corpus-controlled comparison (Table 4), capability retention (Table 5), depth-noise robustness (Table 7), and a stated limitations section (A.11). Evidence is weakened by small real-world evaluation (10 episodes per difficulty, Section 4.4), a 100-episode manually annotated grounding analysis, val_unseen-only results with no variance estimates, and data-efficiency comparisons that mix heterogeneous data accounting (Appendix A.1). Generalizability is supported by R2R-to-RxR transfer (59.9% SR, +20.1 over AwareVLN, Table 2) and real-robot deployment, but is bounded by indoor Matterport3D scenes and the acknowledged RGB-D dependency (A.11). Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed hyperparameters (Tables 8-9) but no code or dataset release statement appears in the text, and the 397B teacher model may be inaccessible.

primary_link.title: GroundingVLN: Reasoning and Acting with Grounding for Vision-Language Navigation

papers.summary: Although vision-language models (VLMs) possess strong visual understanding and reasoning capabilities, existing vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents struggle to connect semantic reasoning with spatial execution. Two coupled gaps remain in this connection, as intermediate reasoning is not explicitly anchored to visual evidence and high-level decisions lack precise spatial goals to guide low-level motion. Cognitive science suggests that human navigation bridges these levels hierarchically b
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言導航（VLN）代理長期存在兩個相互糾結的缺口：中間推理未能明確錨定於視覺證據，高層決策也缺乏精確的空間目標來引導低層動作。本文提出 GroundingVLN，以視覺接地（visual grounding）作為推理與行動之間的共同介面：模型在結構化思考鏈中，將任務相關證據以座標標記（<obj>、<prev_obj>）綁定至影像位置，並預測與語義進度對齊的像素目標，再由低層規劃器（RTAB-Map 與 A* 演算法）轉換為原始動作。為訓練這些能力，作者建立自動資料引擎產生 GroundingCOTVLN-188K，利用 3D 世界標記與 SAM 3 追蹤解決視角變化下實體的時序對齊；另提出 GEAR 強化學習，透過執行感知的像素目標獎勵圖與多層次獎勵（GRPO）對齊推理、空間決策與下游執行。結果顯示，GroundingVLN 在 R2R-CE 達 69.9% SR、RxR-CE 達 75.1% SR，僅使用最強基線約 0.9% 的訓練資料；僅以 R2R 訓練即可在 RxR-CE 達 59.9% SR，較 AwareVLN 提升 20.1 個百分點，且大致保留預訓練模型的一般多模態能力，並在真實機器人實驗中勝過各基線。限制在於低層執行模組仍依賴公制深度感測進行反投影與 SLAM 定位建圖，不利於缺乏深度感測器的平台。此研究示範視覺接地可作為連結高層認知與低層執行的高效介面，為資料高效的具身導航提供可行範式。

evidence: Abstract: 30B-A3B improves SEA-HELM overall from 46.06 to 51.57 and 120B-A12B from 49.30 to 63.44 across seven Southeast Asian languages.

Section 4.2 'Online on-policy distillation': reverse-KL top-k distillation from teacher RedHatAI/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-FP8-dynamic on student-generated trajectories, with ~3,000 concurrent agent instances and >=100,000 sessions (Table 4).

Section 5.3: eight independent runs per model, 2,000 bootstraps with 95% confidence intervals; Section 6 Tables 5-7 give per-language, per-capability point estimates with mixed results (e.g., 30B Cultural Thai 65.56->48.98; Safety decreases on Indonesian/Malay at 30B).

Section 3.4 and Limitations: retained Nemotron tokenizer yields ~5x token count for Khmer/Lao/Tamil, and Filipino is absent from the CPT corpus—honest negative findings supporting the tokenizer-bottleneck claim.

Section 4.2: 'we perform merging with the nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 and nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-BF16 respectively'—a final merging step with no ablation isolating its contribution.

Naming inconsistencies: Section 1 refers to '120B-A3B' and '30B-A12B'; Figure 1(a) cites base 'Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16' while Section 2.1 cites 'Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-Base-BF16'; Table 3 shows asymmetric 150B vs 33.5B CPT token budgets without justification.

Table 3/Table 4: full training configurations (AdamW, WSD schedule without final decay, 32 H200s, 114.23/186.65 hrs CPT; post-training LR 1e-5, batch 24, HSDP parallelism), plus leaderboard URL https://leaderboard.sea-lion.ai/ support reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multilingual LLM technical report (SEA-LION-v4.8, 30B-A3B and 120B-A12B MoE hybrids) squarely in scope: it matches the LLM, training/optimization, agents-in-post-training, and evaluation preferences strongly, though its regional focus is Southeast Asian rather than Japanese. Novelty is moderate: the base architectures, tokenizer, and teacher are inherited from NVIDIA Nemotron; the main technical contributions are a unified SFT + online on-policy distillation pipeline and a decoupled agentic rollout/training infrastructure (~3,000 concurrent agents, token-exact capture), which is solid systems work but an application of known distillation ideas to regional adaptation. Rigor is mixed: evaluation uses 8 runs and 2,000-sample bootstrap CIs with per-language/per-task breakdowns and honest limitation analysis (tokenizer bottleneck, missing Filipino data, uneven capability gains), but there are no ablations isolating CPT vs SFT vs OPD vs the disclosed final weight-merging step, and no external multilingual baselines beyond the Nemotron parents. Evidence strength is reduced by internal inconsistencies (Section 1 misnames '120B-A3B'/'30B-A12B'; Figure 1(a) cites 'Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16' while Section 2.1 cites 'Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-Base-BF16'; asymmetric 150B vs 33.5B CPT token budgets unexplained; missing table cells). Reproducibility is above average: detailed hyperparameters, hardware, durations, public leaderboard, and four checkpoints claimed released, though the CPT corpus is only coarsely specified and no code/data release is stated.

The family includes 30B-A3B and 120B-A12B models, with both continued-pretrained base checkpoints and post-trained variants. We adapt the models using Southeast Asian, reasoning, code, and multilingual parallel datasets, followed by post-training with supervised fine-tuning and online on-policy distillation. On SEA-HELM, the 30B-A3B model improves the overall SEA sco
papers.summary_zh: 這份技術報告介紹 AI Singapore 推出的 Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8 模型家族，針對大型語言模型在東南亞語言上支援不均的問題。團隊以 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 為基礎，開發 30B-A3B（總參數 30B、活化參數 3B）與 120B-A12B 兩種規模，各提供持續預訓練 Base 模型與後訓練版本。方法分兩階段：持續預訓練使用 150B 高品質詞元，涵蓋問答、推理、程式碼與雙語平行資料，並採用省略最終衰減階段的 WSD 學習率排程以保留模型可塑性；後訓練結合監督式微調（SFT）與線上同策略蒸餾（online on-policy distillation），學生模型在約 3,000 個並行代理環境即時生成軌跡，並依更強教師模型的 top-k 輸出以反向 KL 目標學習，訓練資料隨學生策略持續演化。在 SEA-HELM 評測上，30B-A3B 整體分數由 46.06 提升至 51.57，120B-A12B 由 49.30 提升至 63.44，其中坦米爾語與緬語進步最大，指令遵循、自然語言推理與理解能力的改善最為一致。作者也坦承限制：保留原始 Nemotron tokenizer 使高棉語、寮語與坦米爾語的詞元效率偏低；持續預訓練語料未明確涵蓋菲律賓語，其進步僅仰賴跨語言遷移；文化、生成、安全與多輪能力的改進仍呈現語言相依的取捨。此研究顯示，不必從零訓練基礎模型，透過區域導向的持續預訓練與線上後訓練，即可大幅強化東南亞語言能力並兼顧通用能力。

links.title: Understanding AI Provider Recommendations in Local Service Markets

evidence: Abstract: no-search match rates of 4% (open-weight doctors) and 11% (proprietary doctors) vs. 64-71% with search, establishing the retrieval-configuration finding.
Section 3.1: within-model design — 'Arms B and C answer exactly the same prompts, so differences between them measure the effect of search alone' over 2,010 identical prompts.

Section 4: registry matching on name+city with a specialty-based collision test; arm A's matched doctors at 11.4% primary-care share vs. 13.5% national base, showing its matches are name coincidences.

Section 5.4: without search, matched advisory firms carry Form ADV Item 11 disclosures at 39.4% vs. 5.1% base (size-adjusted 2.8x in >100-employee band); with search, 1.7% (z=-4.9), an inversion holding under clustered bootstrap (Appendix G).

Section 6: robustness — gpt-oss-20b replication of all arm-A qualitative findings, refusal-selection check via restricting to never-refused paraphrases, and seeded 100-name merge audits driving three matcher corrections.

Section 7: acknowledged limitations — single proprietary model at one time, differing prompt grids between arms A and B, U.S./English scope, and that web coverage as mechanism 'our design cannot confirm' (Section 3.2).
Contributions footnote 1: released replication pipeline at github.com/hazemibrahim97/referral-layer-replication; Appendix A states grids frozen with SHA-256 hashes pre-query.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An algorithm audit squarely centered on LLM behavior: hallucinated referrals, retrieval/search configuration effects, and prompting — well within LLM/RAG/evaluation/safety preferences, not a capped pure-domain application. Novelty is real (first audit linking AI referrals to official quality/misconduct registries, plus a within-model search contrast) but the contribution is empirical auditing rather than new language methodology. Rigor and evidence are strong: three arms with identical prompts, extraction validated at P/R 0.98 on 150 labeled responses (Appendix C), BH-corrected per-cell tests, metro-clustered bootstrap and one-firm-once checks (Appendix G), registry-based specialty collision test (Section 4/5.1), frozen hashed prompt grids, and replication on a smaller open-weight model (Section 6). Limitations are honestly stated: one proprietary model at one time, arm A vs. B prompt grids differ, US/English-only, contested registry quality measures, and the web-coverage mechanism is inferred not measured, which caps generalizability. Reproducibility is good for the open-weight arm and released pipeline, but the proprietary search arm is inherently non-replicable.

primary_link.title: Understanding AI Provider Recommendations in Local Service Markets

papers.summary: When someone asks an AI assistant which doctor to see or which firm to trust with their savings, the answer is a referral. We audit AI provider recommendations in four registry-backed service domains across the 100 largest U.S. metropolitan areas, matching every recommendation against the official registry for its domain (Medicare clinician and facility records, and SEC adviser disclosures), under three conditions: an open-weight model, a proprietary model without web search, and the same propri
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討AI助理推薦在地服務提供者(如醫師、安養機構、財務顧問公司)時的可信度問題。作者在美國100大都會區,針對醫師、醫院、安養機構與顧問公司四個領域進行演算法稽核,設置三種條件:開放權重模型(gpt-oss-120b)僅憑記憶回答、專有模型關閉網路搜尋、同一專有模型開啟原生搜尋,並將每筆推薦與Medicare臨床醫師與機構紀錄、SEC Form ADV不當行為揭露等官方登錄資料比對。主要發現:無搜尋時,開放權重模型推薦的醫師僅4%能在被查詢城市對應到真實臨床醫師,且屬姓名巧合(專科分佈與全國隨機抽樣無異),專有模型為11%;捏造集中在網路覆蓋稀疏的領域,開啟搜尋後醫師與安養機構比對率升至64%與71%。無搜尋時,被推薦顧問公司攜帶SEC不當行為揭露的比例為登錄基準率的3.6倍,開啟搜尋後反轉為顯著低於基準;搜尋也大致消除小型都會區的比對劣勢。餐廳分析顯示推薦主要依循能見度(評論數溢價3至5倍)而非品質(評分最多僅+0.11星);醫師答案僅0.3%引用政府來源。限制包括品質測量仰賴登錄資料本身、專有模型僅測一個、比對規則保守低估真實率,且僅涵蓋美國與英文情境。本研究指出,AI轉介可信度取決於檢索配置而非模型本身,而無檢索的答案外觀上無從辨識,此「可觀察性落差」是轉介層的核心透明度問題,具公平性意涵,作者建議揭露來源類別而非信心分數。

links.title: Echo: Learning-based Matching Decompilation using Trusted Back Translation

evidence: Abstract: Echo produces 2.43× more exact matches than the strongest baseline and 2.75×/7.4× more matched Mirai functions than GPT-5.6 and Codex
Section 4.1.1: trains a neural decompiler via MLE on ~4M ExeBench C programs with sampled compilation configurations; model jointly predicts source and configuration
Section 6.1: benchmarks (HumanEval 164, ExeBench 200, Synthesis 112, Mirai 62) with verification that no evaluation assembly sequence appears in training
Section 6.3: exact match defined as equality of normalized target vs recompiled assembly; behavioral equivalence treated as auxiliary metric
Section 7.5: test-time scaling comparison under known configuration with same query budgets, including LLM4Decompile 1.3B; ND-allocation ablations at 400-query budget
Section 7.6 / Table 3: Mirai match rates Echo 35.5%, Echo-Base 29.0%, GPT-5.6* 12.9%, GPT-5.6 8.1%, Codex 4.8%; agentic Codex setup underperforms direct LLM querying
Section 7.4 / Figure 10: Phase 2 and Phase 3 refinement combined outperform either phase alone across three benchmarks
Table 2: CFG similarity Echo 0.902/0.949/0.965 highest across HumanEval/ExeBench/Synthesis vs GPT-5.6 and LLM4Decompile baselines
Section 7.6 Future Improvements: limitations include harder exact matching for long optimized programs, edit-distance metric weakness, and 1.3B model capacity
Open Science: anonymous artifact repository with source code, evaluation scripts, Hugging Face model checkpoints, quick-start example; ~3 hours on one A30 GPU per benchmark sweep
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric program synthesis paper: Echo fine-tunes a 1.3B domain-specific language model for decompilation and uses a reasoning LLM (GPT-5.6) plus tool invocation, directly matching Code & Programming, LLM, and test-time inference preferences. The trusted back-translation framing—compilation as deterministic verifier whose mismatches drive rule-based, neural, and reasoning-based repair—is a genuine methodological contribution over prior matching decompilation (Schulte et al., Decomperson, PyLingual) that used matching only as a binary signal. Evaluation is fairly strong: four benchmarks, six baselines, multiple compiler/optimization settings, matched query-budget comparisons (Section 7.5), refinement ablations (Figure 10), and a train/eval leakage check (Section 6.1). Weaknesses: headline benchmark results appear only in figures without exact per-setting numbers in text; Echo's 100-query budget vs baselines' single query partially offsets its advantage despite matched-budget controls; x86-64-only, function-level scope; the Codex agentic result (Section 7.6) is a negative data point acknowledged but thinly analyzed. Mirai results are concrete and internally consistent (35.5%/12.9%/4.8% yields the claimed 2.75×/7.4×). Artifacts, models, scripts, and hardware are described in Open Science, though the repository link is a placeholder.

primary_link.title: Echo: Learning-based Matching Decompilation using Trusted Back Translation

papers.summary:
Neural decompilers can recover readable and recompilable source code from binaries, but their predictions remain difficult to trust. Matching decompilation addresses this problem by searching for source code whose recompiled assembly exactly matches the target, providing stronger evidence of correctness. However, exact matching remains challenging for optimized binaries under unknown compilation configurations.
  We present Echo, a matching decompilation system based on trusted back-translation.
papers.summary_zh: 神經反編譯器可從二進位檔還原可讀且可重新編譯的原始碼，但預測難以信任：編譯成功不保證語意正確，而行為等價測試在真實場景多半不可行。比對式反編譯要求還原碼重新編譯後的組合語言與目標完全一致，可提供編譯器背書的正確性證據，但在編譯組態未知且程式經過最佳化時，精確比對極為困難。本文提出 Echo，核心概念為「可信任回譯」（TBT）：反編譯雖易出錯，其逆向的編譯在固定組態下卻確定可信，因此可將候選程式重編譯、與目標組語比對，並把差異視為結構化回饋，將神經反編譯從一次性預測轉為迭代搜尋。系統分三階段：先以 1.3B 參數的領域模型同時產生原始碼候選與編譯組態，並以演化式組態合成挑出最有希望者；再結合規則改寫與神經修補模型，依組語差異逐步修復；最後交由通用推理 LLM 處理需推導常數等複雜修補。在 HumanEval、ExeBench、Synthesis 與真實惡意軟體 Mirai 上，Echo 的精確比對率平均為最強基準 GPT-5.6 的 2.43 倍，控制流圖結構相似度也最高；在 Mirai 上達 35.5% 比對率，分別為 GPT-5.6 的 2.75 倍與 Codex 的 7.4 倍，是首個為惡意軟體函式提供明確正確性保證的神經方法。限制方面，真實二進位檔與單檔基準仍有落差、程式較長時暫存器配置等差異易擴大、模型僅 1.3B 規模。此成果對惡意軟體分析、漏洞研究與軟體稽核深具價值。

links.title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution

evidence: Abstract: proposes dynamic Stretch Zone mechanism with a single-parameter-space Scaffolder/Learner alternation and GRPO-based dual-loop co-evolution.
Section 4.1 Implementation Details: instantiated on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA on two NVIDIA H100 GPUs; GPT-4o-mini used as judge for negotiation and OR rewards.
Table 1: STRETCH reaches 67.9 ER / 63.6 SA on Mano Complex and 58.7 / 55.0 on Complex OR with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, versus R-Zero 64.8/61.7 and 58.2/53.2.
Table 2: on CraigslistBargain with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, STRETCH attains SR 0.79, PG 0.61, AT 7.32, but on Llama-3.1-8B DPDP attains the best AT (6.83), which the authors acknowledge in Section 4.2.
Section 4.3 / Figure 3: ablations of Untrained-Frozen, SFT-Frozen, External Scaffolder (GPT-4o-mini), and Binary Reward scaffolders over 6 epochs support difficulty-alignment claims.
Table 3: No Golden Experience Replay drops Mano Complex to 54.3 ER / 44.7 SA with format collapse by Epoch 4; target p=0.5 beats p=0.8 and p=0.2 configurations.
Limitations section: concedes GPT-4o-mini is both seller simulator and part of the reward/evaluation pipeline, creating simulator dependence, and restricts claims to constraint-grounded settings.
Section 2.1-2.2: prior co-evolution works (AZR, R-Zero, GenEnv, TTCS, COvolve, G-Zero) and SEELE's ~50% target-accuracy hint scaffolding limit the novelty of the core idea.
Appendix A.2 and D: LoRA rank 16/alpha 32, AdamW lr 2e-5, 6 epochs, batch size 16, and end-to-end Scaffolder/Learner/Judge prompts are disclosed; code link given in Section 1 footnote.
No statistical significance, seed variance, or error bars are reported anywhere in the experimental sections despite small margins over self-play baselines on the Llama backbone (Table 1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper on self-improving reasoning via RL (GRPO) with co-evolving task generator and solver, matching LLM, reasoning, RL, and training preferences strongly. However, novelty is incremental: generator-solver co-evolution is well covered by cited AZR, R-Zero, GenEnv, TTCS, and the p=0.5 difficulty target echoes SEELE (Section 2.1-2.2); the shared-parameter role switching and Golden Experience Replay are modest additions. Rigor and evidence are middling: solid ablations (Section 4.3, Table 3) and two backbones, but no variance/significance reporting, margins over R-Zero are small on the Llama backbone (Table 1: 56.2/49.5 vs 55.3/46.8), self-play baselines are authors' re-implementations (Section 4.2), and negotiation rewards depend on GPT-4o-mini acting as simulator and judge, a circularity the authors themselves flag in Limitations. Generalizability is explicitly restricted to constraint-verifiable domains. Reproducibility is aided by a code link, hyperparameters (Appendix A.2), and full prompts (Appendix D), but relies on a proprietary judge/simulator.

primary_link.title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) often suffer from capability stagnation in self-improvement training because fixed difficulty levels fail to adapt to their evolving proficiency. To address this issue, we propose STRETCH (Self-Taught Reasoning Evolution via Targeted CHallenge), a unified framework inspired by cognitive scaffolding theory. STRETCH introduces a dynamic Stretch Zone mechanism that continuously aligns question difficulty with the model's solving capability. Within a single parameter spa
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在自我改進訓練中常因訓練題目難度固定，隨著能力提升而陷入停滯或獎勵崩潰。本文提出 STRETCH 框架，靈感源自認知鷹架理論，以動態「Stretch Zone」機制持續將題目難度對齊模型的當前解題能力：在單一參數空間內，模型交替扮演 Scaffolder（生成邊界推進的自適應題目）與 Learner（以 GRPO 強化學習最佳化解題軌跡），雙迴圈非同步更新配合難度對齊獎勵（以 50% 成功率為峰值）與 Golden Experience Replay 經驗回放，穩定訓練並抑制 reward hacking。在作業研究基準（Mano Complex、Complex OR）與多輪議價（CraigslistBargain）上，STRETCH 以 Qwen2.5-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 為骨幹，一致超越提示方法、領域基線（ORLM、LLMOPT、StepORLM）與自我對弈基線（Absolute Zero、R-Zero）；例如 Qwen2.5 於 Mano Complex 達 67.9% ER 與 63.6% SA。消融實驗證明動態難度對齊、共享參數與回放機制缺一不可，移除回放會引發格式崩潰。侷限在於依賴可驗證獎勵與 GPT-4o-mini 模擬器評審的模擬器依賴，尚未驗證於開放式任務。此框架為突破靜態強化學習能力高原提供了實用的自我改進路徑。
papers.title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution
papers.title_zh: STRETCH the Boundaries：邁向漸進式 LLM 演化的統一自學習框架

Sec. IV-B, Table I: AeroWeaver highest mean reward on all nine tasks (e.g., pursuit-evasion 130.00±4.80 vs HMAS-2 70.00±4.60), but Coverage, guided navigation, private communication, and circular formation show identical baseline means to two decimals (e.g., -14.81±1.02 vs -14.81±1.00)
Sec. IV-B: 'AeroWeaver consumes 52.0-70.0% fewer tokens than HMAS-2 across the nine tasks and fewer tokens than Centralized on four tasks'; 'from one episode per condition'

Sec. IV-C, Table II: ablations of skill activation, coordination reports, reward correction; reward correction 'least detrimental ablation in eight tasks'; normalized scores with task scales Kt listed
Sec. IV-D: backbone sensitivity (GPT-5.6 Luna, GLM-5.3-Flash, qwen3.8-flash) and prompt perturbation showing distractor insertion hurts more than paraphrase/reorder
Sec. V: 'current evaluation is conducted with a predefined skill catalog and simulated execution conditions'; physical UAV validation deferred to future work
Abstract/code website: https://github.com/Admire-ljb/AeroWeaver
Sec. IV-A: baselines limited to in-house Centralized planner and HMAS-2 adaptation; no head-to-head against surveyed systems (SMART-LLM, CaPo, EMOS, AERIS, TALKER)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly preference-aligned: an LLM-agent harness (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5) for distributed UAV swarms with role-conditioned skill dispatch, directed peer messaging, and training-free experience-guided score correction (RL-adjacent, weight 1.5); not pure robotics since the methodology is language-agent harnessing. Novelty is moderate-integration: skill.md packages echo Voyager-style skill libraries, the online update closely follows JitRL-style logit correction, and the group's own AERIS/TALKER precede it; the distributed body-local no-central-joint-action design is the main differentiator. Rigor is decent (9 tasks, 2 baselines, 3 ablations, backbone and prompt-perturbation checks, 10 episodes/pair per Sec. IV-A) but limited: baselines are only an in-house Centralized planner and an adapted HMAS-2, no comparison to the surveyed swarm LLM systems, no significance testing, and token costs come from a single episode per condition (Sec. IV-B). Evidence strength is tempered by four of nine tasks showing identical baseline means to two decimals (e.g., Coverage -14.81 for both baselines in Table I) and round-number returns (90.00/130.00 in pursuit-evasion), plus normalized ablation scores that obscure raw magnitudes. Generalizability is bounded by a predefined 22-skill catalog and simulation-only AirSim/MPE-inspired evaluation, acknowledged in Sec. V. Reproducibility benefits from a public code URL, named backbone, and hyperparameters (gamma=0.95, beta=0.8), though prompts and full skill library are not included.

primary_link.title: AeroWeaver: An Embodied-Agent Harness for Weaving Aerial Skills into Distributed, Adaptive Swarm Execution

papers.summary: Collective intelligence is a collaborative autonomy paradigm in which multiple agents pursue shared objectives through local perception, information exchange, and coordinated action. UAV swarms embody this paradigm by coordinating multiple vehicles in tasks such as search, inspection, and tracking. Recent advances in large language model (LLM) agents have strengthened natural-language task understanding and high-level planning, providing a flexible semantic interface between mission descriptions
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 AeroWeaver，一個面向無人機群的具身代理執行框架（harness），旨在解決將大型語言模型（LLM）代理應用於群飛任務的三大挑戰：語意決策如何對應到可執行能力、全域任務推理如何與分散式執行調和，以及如何運用任務經驗進行持續調適。方法上整合三個元件：(A) 空中技能框架，將無人機能力表示為附有 skill.md 文件的型別化技能套件，依任務情境檢索並為各角色啟用技能子集；(B) 分散式群集編排，為每架無人機綁定角色條件化的本地代理，透過定向同伴訊息協調，不設中央動作控制器；(C) 經驗引導的線上強化，以角色索引的狀態—動作—獎勵紀錄估計技能優勢，據此修正首詞機率分數，達成免訓練的線上策略最佳化。實驗於 AirSim 模擬環境的九個 MPE 風格任務中，AeroWeaver 的平均回合報酬全面優於 Centralized 與 HMAS-2 兩個基線，並較 HMAS-2 節省 52–70% 的 token 消耗；消融實驗顯示技能啟用、協調回報與獎勵修正皆有貢獻，系統對不同 LLM 骨幹具備穩健性，但對插入無關資訊的提示擾動較為敏感。目前驗證限於預定義技能目錄與模擬條件，尚未於實體無人機上測試。此工作的重要性在於以統一的執行邊界串接任務級語意推理、機身本地協調與經驗調適，為語言模型驅動的無人機群自主運作提供可行的系統架構。

links.title: GeoMesh: Workload-Balanced and Sign-Compressed Geo-Distributed LLM Training

evidence: Abstract: GeoMesh reduces time-to-target perplexity by up to 70.2% over baselines and reduces straggler-/WAN-induced idle by 8.0x/5.6x while preserving comparable zero-shot accuracy.
§2.2 Observation 1-2: H100 spends 20.9% Idle_hete and all workers 65.8% Idle_net under DiLoCo; HALoS reaches 25.7 vs DiLoCo 23.0 perplexity at 3B tokens (11.7% worse).
§4.3 Table 2: ablation shows AWB-only 7.6h, CSS-only 6.5h, full GeoMesh 2.8h vs DiLoCo 12.0h at perplexity cost 23.0 -> 23.4; compression sweep FP32/FP16/8-bit/1-bit gives 12.0/10.0/8.0/6.5h.
§4.4 Table 3: 150M zero-shot average 37.58% for GeoMesh vs 37.88% DiLoCo (-0.8%, within reported standard errors).
Appendix B.7 Table 17: three random seeds at 150M preserve ordering (GeoMesh TTP 1.1-1.4h, FP 23.4-23.9).

§7 Limitations: WAN emulated with measured Azure bandwidths and Linux tc, no latency/jitter/packet loss; real geo-distributed cluster validation, no top-k/low-rank comparison, and no convergence proof all deferred to future work.
Appendix A.2: builds on OpenDiLoCo and hivemind under MIT; states 'We will release the GeoMesh source code as a research artifact' but provides no repository link.

Appendix D Theorem 1: worst-case CSS reconstruction error bound ||g_hat - g_bar||_inf <= 2*eta_in*h_max under Lion; authors note it bounds reconstruction fidelity, not convergence, and is loose in the typical same-sign regime.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on geo-distributed LLM training: adaptive workload balancing assigns per-worker batch sizes/inner steps proportional to GPU speed and memory, and 1-bit sign compression with token-weighted aggregation cuts WAN payload ~32x. Directly relevant to the LLM (2.5), training/optimization, and scaling/efficiency preferences, though it is infrastructure work rather than LLM methodology (no reasoning, prompting, RAG, safety content). Novelty is moderate: sign compression (SignSGD) and speed-proportional workload splits exist; the contribution is their combination at round-level GDT synchronization plus the token-weighted aggregation and the Lion/CSS structural compatibility argument. Rigor is solid: motivating measurements (§2.2: 20.9% Idle_hete, 65.8% Idle_net, HALoS 11.7% worse perplexity), mechanism/optimizer/compression ablations (§4.3 Table 2), extra baseline (Async Local-SGD, App. B.8), 3-seed variance (App. B.7), 8-worker and 1.1B checks (B.5-B.6), a simple but honestly-caveated worst-case bound (App. D Thm 1, explicitly not a convergence proof), and a transparently reported failed Streaming DiLoCo reproduction (B.9). Evidence is credible but bounded: single run per main configuration (acknowledged §4.1), WAN emulated via tc from Azure iperf profiles rather than a real geo-distributed cluster (§7), models only 150M-1.1B, and no comparison to adapted top-k/low-rank compression or Sailor/WLB-LLM. Generalizability is limited by scope the authors themselves delineate (§7). Reproducibility is good: full hardware, hyperparameter tables (App. A.5), emulation procedure (A.3), but code release is only promised (A.2), no public artifact provided.

primary_link.title: GeoMesh: Workload-Balanced and Sign-Compressed Geo-Distributed LLM Training

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly trained on GPUs distributed across multiple regions, but geo-distributed training is challenging in practice. Real clusters often contain GPUs with different speeds and memory capacities, and they communicate over slow wide-area networks. Our analysis shows that this creates serious problems: existing synchronous methods preserve stable updates, but fast GPUs wait up to 20.9% of their runtime for slower ones, and all workers spend, on average, 65.8% of thei
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討跨地理區域分散式（geo-distributed）LLM訓練的困境：真實叢集中的GPU硬體異質，速度與記憶體容量各異，且需透過低頻寬廣域網路交換模型更新。作者分析發現，現有同步方法（如DiLoCo）因最慢GPU拖累，快的GPU有20.9%執行時間在等待，全體平均65.8%時間耗於同步；非同步方法（如HALoS）雖減少等待，卻因更新過時使困惑度惡化11.7%。GeoMesh為同步式框架，提出兩項機制：自適應工作負載平衡（AWB）依各GPU記憶體與量測速度指派專屬batch size與內部步數，對齊每輪完成時間；壓縮符號同步（CSS）以1-bit符號張量搭配輕量幅度純量與token計數取代全精度pseudo-gradient，通訊量降低近32倍，並以token加權聚合維持更新尺度。在H100、A100、L40S與RTX 6000 Ada組成的異質叢集及Azure量測頻寬下，訓練150M至500M參數的LLaMA風格模型，GeoMesh較基準最多縮短70.2%達到目標困惑度所需時間，異質與網路造成的GPU閒置分別降低最多8.0倍與5.6倍，zero-shot準確率與DiLoCo相當（僅差0.8%）。限制包括：僅驗證至8個worker與1.1B模型、廣域網路以Linux流量控制模擬頻寬而非真實部署、未與top-k稀疏化或低秩壓縮等方法比較、AWB假設worker速度比例穩定，且缺乏正式收斂證明。此研究顯示同步式分散訓練在妥善分配運算與壓縮通訊後，能同時兼顧模型準確率與異質資源利用率。

links.title: The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'attack success without VAC ranges from 68% to 100%, whereas VAC reduces attack success to 0% on every model, with 78% legitimate-task completion and a 0% false-block rate'.

Section 8, Table 8: per-model ASR+VAC = 0% across GPT-4.1 (n=20), Gemini-2.5-Flash (n=133), Llama-4-Scout (n=18), gpt-oss-120b (n=115), Qwen3-32B (n=20), Qwen3.6-27B (n=7); footnote marks GPT-4.1 as a separate single-seed run.

Section 7.3 and Appendix D Algorithm 4: 'The VAC human (Arm C) sees the ground-truth descriptor and risk and denies any elevated-risk action' — the oracle is deterministic and by construction, not a user study; naive arm returns Approve when 'no visible red flag => deceivable'.

Section 4.7: 'a systematic evaluation with adversarial page-mutation scenarios is left to future work, and residual risk is bounded by the executor's view of the action' — limits the TOCTOU/execution-binding evidence to one scenario despite Section 8.1 claims.

Section 11 External validity: 'one DOM-first agent across 5 open-weight models plus a preliminary GPT-4.1 run, on a bounded suite of ten scenarios' — inconsistent with the 24-scenario suite in Section 7.2.

Section 2 and Table 1: positions VAC against concurrent 'consent integrity' work [27], conceding the shared principle while claiming the browser realisation, dispatch binding, and live cross-model evaluation as differentiators.

Section 7.5 and Appendix C: 'the harness, scenario pages, oracle, and analysis are released, and a single command regenerates every table and figure' — release claimed but no URL given in the document.

Table 10 (n=293): naive HITL arm leaves ASR at 72% vs 78% no-gate, supporting the claim that forgeable confirmations provide near-zero protection; ablation C-p also achieves 0% ASR, indicating provenance fencing is not load-bearing.
Figures 1-5 are all marked 'Figure pending', so no visual evidence is present in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core preferences: LLM agent security, agentic browsers, indirect prompt injection, and HITL safeguards (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation all strongly represented). Novelty is moderate: the core 'consent integrity' principle is acknowledged as concurrent with Weng [27] and is a browser realisation of classical trusted-path/WYSIWYS and confused-deputy ideas (Section 2), though the DOM ground-truth descriptor plus dispatch-time execution binding (C5) is a concrete, web-specific contribution. Rigor is mixed: clear threat model, four-arm ablation, server-side ground-truth scoring, and cross-model sweep are strengths, but the human is a deterministic oracle (Appendix D) that denies every elevated-risk action by construction, making the headline 0% ASR largely a designed property of the gate-plus-oracle rather than a measured human outcome; n is small (293 trials, some models n=7-20, GPT-4.1 n=20), single DOM-first agent, no significance testing, figures marked 'Figure pending', and Section 11 inconsistently says 'a bounded suite of ten scenarios' versus 24 elsewhere. Evidence strength reflects consistent per-model zeros (Table 8) but limited scope and by-construction results. Generalizability is explicitly bounded by the authors (Section 11: one agent, bounded attacks, oracle caveat). Reproducibility: detailed setup, config flags, seeds, port hygiene, and a claimed single-command artifact (Section 7.5, Appendix C), but no artifact URL is provided in the document. Overall a solid, in-scope systems/security paper with useful negative result on naive HITL (72% ASR, Table 10) but limited empirical depth.

primary_link.title: The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents

papers.summary: Agentic browsers can execute security-sensitive actions under a user's authenticated session, making indirect prompt injection and deceptive confirmation interfaces a direct threat to action integrity. Existing human-in-the-loop (HITL) safeguards are insufficient when the approval prompt itself can be influenced by untrusted page content or model-generated text. We present the \emph{Verifiable Action Card} (VAC), an architectural defence that reconstructs approval information from the ground-tru
papers.summary_zh: 代理式瀏覽器會在使用者已登入的工作階段下執行安全敏感操作，因此間接提示注入與偽造確認對話框的 Lies-in-the-Loop 攻擊直接威脅動作完整性。本文指出既有 human-in-the-loop 防護的根本缺陷：確認資訊取自頁面控制的標籤或模型生成文字，兩者皆受攻擊者影響，人類把關形同失效。作者提出可驗證動作卡（VAC），包含五個元件：意圖來源標記（C1）、直接從 DOM 解析元素讀取真實參數（動詞、目標網域、收款人、金額）的動作描述器（C2）、在受信任瀏覽器介面頻外呈現的預設拒絕卡片（C3）、來源感知風險閘門（C4），以及在派發時重新驗證參數的執行綁定（C5），可防範核准後的 TOCTOU 動作替換。實作上以 Electron/Chromium 殼層搭配 Python 代理建置完整代理式瀏覽器，並建立涵蓋 confused-deputy、對話偽造、間接注入與自適應攻擊的 24 情境基準，以伺服器端記錄的真實結果評分。跨 5 個開放權重模型與 GPT-4.1 的實驗顯示：無防護時攻擊成功率為 68%–100%（整體 78%），VAC 在每個模型皆降至 0%，合法任務完成率 78%，誤擋率 0%；naive 確認僅降至 72%，證明保護來自架構而非特定模型。限制包括以透明 oracle 模擬使用者而非真人研究、來源歸屬為啟發式、僅評估單一 DOM-first 代理與有限情境，且無法防範唯讀誤導或使用者被社交工程誘導的情況。本研究的核心教訓是：人類把關的可信度取決於其看到的證據，此設計原則可納入代理安全指引，並與提示層級防禦互補。
papers.title: The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents
papers.title_zh: 可驗證動作卡（Verifiable Action Card）：安全自主代理的可信賴人類把關控制

links.title: From a River in Gilead to the Inference Distributions of Large Language Models: Covert Dialect Bias and Linguistic Profiling at Scale

evidence: Abstract: 260 meaning-matched sentence quadruples, log-probability scoring over housing-relevant adjectives, ten open-weight LLMs, three evaluation contexts (tenant, neighbor, roommate).

Section 3.4: 582,400 scored observations / 436,800 q-scores; Kruskal-Wallis, Dunn's post-hoc with Bonferroni, epsilon-squared; authors state tests 'treat correlated observations as independent' and they 'rest no claim on p-values alone'.

Section 4.1 & Table 2: mean q-scores vs. SAE (e.g., NP tenant negative +0.181, AAVE neighbor negative +0.215); Dunn's post-hoc shows AAVE and NP do not differ overall (p=1.00) but differ from NSE (p<1e-69).

Section 5: attribute-swap null baseline exceeds dialect q-magnitudes by ratios of only 1.03–1.51, described as 'modest'; bias claim rests on structural properties (stereotype concentration, perplexity correlation r=+0.923 across only four dialects, NSE reversal).
Section 4.5: per-model consistency — 9-10/10 models show elevated negative association for AAVE/NP; NSE shows 0/10 in neighbor and roommate contexts.

Section 6: NSE/NP translations were LLM-generated and validated by only two native speakers (agreement scores deferred to repository); lexicons operationalized without community consultation; log-probability bias has 'weak correlation with downstream application-level bias' (citing Gallegos et al. 2024).

Section 3.3: model roster, parameter counts, prompt templates, and adjective lexicons are deferred to the accompanying GitHub repository (https://github.com/intricate-potato/dialect-prejudice-of-llms); models loaded in bfloat16 via HuggingFace, no proprietary API access.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM bias-audit paper squarely matching core preferences (LLMs, AI Safety/bias, evaluation): covert dialect bias measured via log-probability scoring across ten open-weight LLMs in housing judgments. Novelty is incremental but real: adapting the Hofmann et al. (2024) matched-guise method to Nigerian Standard English and Nigerian Pidgin, and using the NSE/NP prestige contrast to disentangle identity vs. prestige — a design the SAE-AAVE pair cannot support (Section 1). Rigor is mixed: large scale (582,400 observations, Section 3.4), nonparametric tests with effect sizes, and an attribute-swap null baseline are strengths, but the authors concede the tests 'treat correlated observations as independent' and that dialect effects exceed the null floor only modestly (ratios 1.03–1.51, Section 5); the headline perplexity–bias correlation (r=+0.923, Section 5) rests on only four dialect-level points; effect sizes are small (d≈0.12–0.21). Evidence strength is moderate: consistent per-model patterns (9–10/10 models, Section 4.5) and distinct stereotype clusters (AAVE 'shady', NP 'foreign' +134.6%, Sections 4.1–4.2), but magnitude claims are conceded to be modest and the log-prob-to-downstream-harm link is acknowledged weak (Section 6). Generalizability is bounded: housing only, open-weight models only, no proprietary APIs (Section 3.3). Reproducibility is decent (public GitHub repo, HuggingFace/bfloat16, Section 3.3) but the paper text omits the model roster, lexicons, and prompt templates, deferring all to the repository. Does not touch reasoning, agents, RAG, or Japanese NLP, capping preference relevance below top tier.

primary_link.title: From a River in Gilead to the Inference Distributions of Large Language Models: Covert Dialect Bias and Linguistic Profiling at Scale

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as housing screening. While alignment techniques mitigate explicit racial bias in generated text, they often leave covert attitudinal associations in internal probability distributions untouched. Adapting the matched-guise sociolinguistic paradigm, we examine covert dialect bias in housing-related social judgments across four varieties: Standard American English (SAE), African American Vernacular English (AAVE), N
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型(LLM)是否已將人類的語言側寫歧視自動化,即作者所稱的「示播列(Shibboleth)問題」。對齊技術雖抑制輸出端的顯性偏見,卻未改變內部機率分佈編碼的態度連結,使偏見隱形且難以稽核。研究擴展 matched-guise 配對偽裝典範,取用 260 組語義對應句,涵蓋標準美式英語(SAE)、非裔美式白話英語(AAVE)、奈及利亞標準英語(NSE)與奈及利亞皮欽語(NP),嵌入租客篩選、鄰居接納與室友選擇三種社會接近度漸增的住房情境,對十個開放權重模型計算住房相關形容詞的 log-probability,以相對 SAE 的 q 分數隔離方言效應。結果顯示:AAVE 與 NP 在全部十個模型一致被懲罰,且各經不同刻板印象群集——AAVE 連結不可靠與社會威脅(shady、unstable),NP 連結貪腐與外來性(corrupt、foreign,後者在鄰居情境上升 134.6%);NSE 則呈情境依賴:正式租客評估中受偏好,社會親密度提高後反受懲罰,證明「聲望」獨立於種族身分運作。平均 perplexity 與負面 q 分數高度相關(r=+0.923),偏見跨西方、東亞、中東與歐洲訓練來源皆存在。限制包括:NSE/NP 譯文由 LLM 生成、僅經兩位母語者驗證;機率層級偏見尚未證明下游分配傷害;形容詞詞庫未經社群諮詢;範圍限於住房。鑑於 AI 已用於租屋平台與篩選流程,而部署指引未要求方言偏見評估,本研究為稽核與政策提供直接依據。
papers.title: From a River in Gilead to the Inference Distributions of Large Language Models: Covert Dialect Bias and Linguistic Profiling at Scale

evidence: §5.1 Table 1: edge0-35b decodes at 20.4 tok/s in 2.9 GiB peak active memory vs 3.9 tok/s at 18.2 GiB for fully resident mlx-lm on a Mac mini M4 Pro 24GB
§5.3 Table 3: prerouter vs on-demand decode gains +80%/+82%/+84% at K=2/4/8 on a 16GB MacBook M2 where the 18.4 GiB checkpoint does not fit
§5.2 Table 2: OpenCompass average 79.2 vs 83.2 (35B) and 69.9 vs 72.7 (8B) vs fp16 bases; §6 reports quality loss concentrating in long-chain reasoning (AIME -6.1 and -10.0)
§3.3 footnote 2: merged-and-requantized LoRA retains 34%/2% of weight-level delta on attention/dense projections and 18% at the logits level, motivating the unmerged parallel delta

§5.1-§5.3: speed baselines are a resident mlx-lm server and the engine's own on-demand streaming; no same-hardware numbers against llama.cpp --cpu-moe, PowerInfer, or MoE-Infinity despite them being cited as related offloading work (§2)

§6 Limitations: single-request FIFO serving, 44 ms/step CPU-side graph-building floor, prerouter gains shrink on hot caches/fast storage, MLX is the only implemented backend (CUDA slot 'architecture, not code')

Artifacts section: framework at github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0, checkpoints and adapters on HuggingFace, Apache-2.0; §3.2/§4 specify head dims, LoRA r=16/α=32, and a three-phase training recipe (head distillation, SFT on student path over ~2M rows, on-policy reverse-KL distillation)
§5.1: measurement methodology - per-arm processes, rotated arm order, matched cache budgets, 3-round medians, and refusal to use cross-session numbers given up to 2.3x spread on the 16GB machine
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems work: SSD streaming of a 35B MoE LLM on a 24GB consumer machine with a trained per-layer prerouter ('prediction is the routing') plus an unmerged recovery LoRA over int4. Preference relevance is high (MoE LLM inference/serving, quantization, LoRA/distillation, edge deployment), not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: expert offloading is well-trodden (FlexGen, PowerInfer, MoE-Infinity, Pre-gated MoE all cited); the cross-token lead-by-one-token prerouter consumed as the actual routing, the routing-replacement training recipe, and the quantified merge/requantize destruction of LoRA deltas (18% logit retention) are the genuine deltas. Rigor is solid on measurement discipline (same-session rotated A/B, medians, acknowledged ±40% single-shot spread, element-wise executor parity tests, cost model fitted within 0.13 ms) but weakened by the absence of head-to-head numbers against competing offloading systems on the same hardware, only two base models on one hardware family, no error bars on the 3.9/2.8-point quality gaps, and unquantified head prediction accuracy/feature drift. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Tables 1-4, oracle ablation, incr_stack +34%) but self-reported with no external baseline comparison. Generalizability is limited: MLX/Apple-Silicon-only, single-request FIFO, gains explicitly shrink on hot caches/fast storage and are bounded by ~25% adjacent-token expert reuse. Reproducibility is decent: framework, checkpoints, and adapters claimed open under Apache-2.0, with detailed hyperparameters and three-phase training recipe, though the ~2M-row distillation corpus is not specified for release.

primary_link.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction

papers.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predic
papers.summary_zh: 論文探討在消費級硬體上部署大型 MoE 模型時的權重記憶體瓶頸:35B 級模型即使以 4-bit 量化仍需 19.5 GB,MoE 稀疏性只縮減運算量、未減少必須儲存的位元組;直接把專家權重放到 SSD 也無效,因為第 N+1 層的專家選擇依賴第 N 層輸出,磁碟讀取無法提前開始以遮蔽延遲。作者提出串流推論引擎 Edge0:每層的 prerouter 於前一個 token 預測下一層路由,且預測直接被當作路由本身,使暫存專家集合與實際路由一致而無須捨棄任何專家,近似代價改於訓練階段償還;另以未合併的 recovery LoRA 從 fp16 teacher 蒸餾補回 int4 量化與路由替換的品質損失,並證明若合併進 int4 再重量化僅約 18% 效果留存,故須以平行 delta 服務。訓練分三階段:蒸餾 prerouter heads、於 student 路徑 SFT、以 reverse KL 做 on-policy 蒸餾。在 24 GB 的 Mac mini M4 Pro 上,35B 模型以約 20 tok/s 解碼、峰值活躍記憶體僅 2.9 GiB,五項基準平均落後 fp16 原模型約 3.9 分;8B 層級達 28 tok/s、1.5 GiB。在權重塞不進記憶體的 16 GB 機器上,prerouter 帶來 80% 至 84% 解碼加速。限制包括一次僅服務單一請求、解碼受每步 44 ms 的 CPU 圖建構成本所限、效益受相鄰 token 專家重疊率僅約四分之一限制,且需付出不可回收的常駐記憶體;長鏈推理(如 AIME)品質損失最明顯。此工作證明權重可留駐 SSD,讓一般桌機即可服務大型稀疏模型,框架與權重皆已開源。

evidence: Abstract: strongest LLM (DeepSeek-V3.1) reaches only 29.5% Final Pass in Basic Education and no model exceeds 44.7% Adaptivity, identifying personalization as the bottleneck
Section 3.4: DAG compliance across 347 textbook nodes and 411 edges, Cohen's Kappa 0.93, verified prerequisite precision of 99.5% after expert correction
Section 4.1: ten open-source LLMs (1B to 30B+) evaluated under Zero-shot and CoT, plus a RAG variant using BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 embeddings and FAISS (Table 5, Appendix B.4)
Section 5.1 Table 6: removing mastery information cuts Adaptivity by 26.1 points for Qwen3-30B-A3B (CoT) while Validity changes little, isolating the role of explicit knowledge-state modeling
Appendix A.1.4 Table A.2/A.3: sensitivity analysis over 25 configurations with 1,000 Monte Carlo runs each; archetype ordering preserved with 100% consistency
Limitations: synthetic learner states and mastery updates; expert evaluation covers 100 personas; benchmark grounded in Chinese textbooks, with cross-language adaptation deferred to Appendix C
Footnote 1: data and code publicly released at github.com/BUAA-IRIP-LLM/PersonaPath; Appendix G provides all prompt templates
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric evaluation benchmark with strong alignment to agents/planning, CoT prompting, RAG, and LLM evaluation preferences; the educational domain is secondary to the language methodology, so it is not penalized as a pure domain application. Novelty is solid: the Knowledge-Centric (goal + prerequisite-graph + persona) paradigm is a genuine gap versus interaction-log benchmarks (Section 2, Table 1). Rigor is above average: DAG validation, Cohen's Kappa 0.93, 99.5% prerequisite precision (Section 3.4), expert ICC(2,2) 0.74-0.85 (Table 3), and a hyperparameter sensitivity analysis with 1,000 Monte Carlo runs per configuration (Appendix A.1.4). Evidence is well-supported by Tables 4-8 and case analyses, with consistent claims (29.5% best Final Pass, 44.7% best Adaptivity). Generalizability is the weakest point: results are grounded in Chinese textbooks and a synthetic IRT simulator, acknowledged in Limitations and Appendix C; expert persona evaluation covers only 100 samples. Reproducibility is good: public code/data (footnote 1), full prompt templates (Appendix G), simulator hyperparameters (Table A.1), and vLLM v0.9.2/hardware details (Section 4.1).

primary_link.title: PersonaPath: Towards Knowledge-Centric Personalized Learning Path Planning

papers.summary: Adaptive learning systems commonly formulate learning path planning as Exercise-Centric (EC) recommendation, where the next step is inferred from item-level interaction logs. Evaluating goal-oriented guidance additionally requires explicit learner goals and curriculum-scale prerequisites: learners with similar exercise records may need different paths toward their targets. We therefore study Knowledge-Centric (KC) personalized learning path planning, where a planner must reason over learner prof
papers.summary_zh: 此論文指出，現行調適學習系統多採「習題為中心」（Exercise-Centric）的推薦典範，僅依答題紀錄推薦下一題，忽略學習者的明確目標與課綱層級的先備知識結構。作者提出「知識為中心」（Knowledge-Centric）的個人化學習路徑規劃任務，並建立 PersonaPath 基準，結合 2,000 個細緻學習者樣貌與涵蓋 77 個科目、347 本教科書、1,751 個單元及 4,092 個概念的階層式知識圖譜；教材取自人民教育出版社與中國智慧教育平台，先以 DeepSeek-V3 抽取結構，再由專家覆核，先備關係精確率達 99.5%，且通過有向無環圖檢驗。評測涵蓋有效性（先備違反與幻覺）、調適性（樣貌一致性與 Cog-Gap 難度貼合）及效率（目標完成與進度連續）三大構面。實驗顯示，十個開源 LLM 中最佳的 DeepSeek-V3.1 在基礎教育最終通過率僅 29.5%，高等教育降至 14.6%，瓶頸在調適性（最高僅 44.7%）。消融實驗證明：移除精熟度資訊會重創調適性、情境雜訊大幅降低有效性與效率、一次性生成雖提高有效性卻犧牲調適與效率，顯示明確知識狀態與逐步互動回饋不可或缺。限制包括學習者狀態屬合成模擬、語料侷限中文課綱、專家評估僅涵蓋 100 個樣貌。此基準將個人化學習評測推向知識規劃層次，凸顯 LLM 因材施教能力的落差，對教育 AI 研究深具參考價值。
papers.title: PersonaPath: Towards Knowledge-Centric Personalized Learning Path Planning
papers.title_zh: PersonaPath：邁向以知識為中心的個人化學習路徑規劃

links.title: Bias Amplification in Multi-Agent Network: How Biased Agents Shape Opinions and Rhetoric

evidence: Section 4.1-4.2: population N=50 fully connected, Llama 3.2-8B via LangChain, temperature 0.7, biased agents A_b in {0,2,4,6,8,10}, K=10 rounds across four topics
Section 4.6: each configuration run 15 times independently; 95% confidence intervals from standard errors across runs

Section 4.4/Table 2: FJ baseline matched on stubbornness (lambda_b=1) and initializations; Llama AI Safety mean shift rises 0.02 to 1.49 and anchor distance falls 1.97 to 0.50 from A_b=0 to 10, versus FJ 0.47/1.53
Section 5.1: A_b=0 baselines show intrinsic drift (Vaccine 0.66, Immigration 0.78, Climate 0.77), attributed to model-level bias interacting with the measured amplification

Section 5.2: semantic alignment computed via SBERT cosine similarity against biased agents' justifications, measured only at the final round; claims partial decoupling of rhetorical and numerical convergence (H2)
Section 7 Limitations: single model/framework, no systematic prompt ablations, final-round-only alignment, one-sided +2 bias anchor; no code or artifact availability stated anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solidly in-scope LLM multi-agent paper: Llama 3.2-8B agents (LangChain) in a 50-node fully connected network, testing how a persistent biased minority shifts neutral agents' opinions versus a matched Friedkin-Johnsen baseline (Sections 3-4). Strong coverage of top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents, AI-safety/bias). The dual-layer finding that SBERT rhetorical alignment rises even where numerical shifts stay moderate (Section 5.2) is the most novel element, though LLM opinion-dynamics simulation itself is well-trodden (cited Chuang, Piao, etc.). Rigor is reasonable for a proof-of-concept: 15 runs per configuration with 95% CIs, matched stubbornness, and an A_b=0 control (Section 4.6), but no significance testing, no prompt ablations, single model, one-sided +2 bias, and final-round-only alignment measurement (Section 7). Table 2 numbers support headline claims (e.g., AI Safety shift 0.02→1.49 vs FJ 0.47), but A_b=0 drift on Vaccine (0.66) and Climate (0.77) reveals model priors that partially confound the amplification effect, as authors admit. No code or data release is claimed, though the prompt template (Figure 2) and parameters are reported, limiting reproducibility to partial.

primary_link.title: Bias Amplification in Multi-Agent Network: How Biased Agents Shape Opinions and Rhetoric

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications involving interaction between agents, where their output plays a role in collective reasoning and decision-making processes. Despite significant research into the functioning of LLMs in such multi-agent systems, the processes of bias propagation in such systems are still a challenge. This work studies how biased opinions are propagated in the form of textual interaction in an environment of LLMs, in which a minority of agents
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型(LLM)多代理系統中的偏誤傳播問題:當少數立場極端且固化的代理持續與中立代理互動時,將如何影響群體意見與語言修辭。作者建構一套模擬框架,在50個代理組成的全連接網路上,針對AI安全管制、疫苗強制接種、移民政策與氣候變遷四項爭議議題進行模擬,偏誤代理占比介於0%至20%,並以Llama 3.2-8B(透過LangChain,溫度設0.7)驅動文字互動,每輪意見變動上限一個類別,共10輪、每組重複15次,另以經典的Friedkin-Johnsen(FJ)模型作為對照基準。結果顯示,即使僅有少量偏誤代理,中立代理的意見也會顯著朝偏誤方向移動,且Llama 3.2的收斂速度與幅度皆大於FJ模型;語意對齊分析(以SBERT計算餘弦相似度)更發現中立代理的修辭隨偏誤暴露單調上升,在意見偏移仍溫和時便已高度採納偏誤代理的用語,呈現修辭與數值意見的部分解耦。此外,疫苗議題在無偏誤基線下仍出現漂移,顯示模型本身的先驗立場。限制包括僅使用單一模型與框架、未進行提示詞消融實驗、語意對齊僅於最終輪測量,以及偏誤僅設於正向極端。本研究對多代理LLM系統的監督與公平性稽核具有重要意涵。

links.title: From Component Snapshots to Lifecycle Traces: Agent-Based Software Composition Analysis

evidence: Abstract: 'SCA-Agent achieves the highest component detection F1 across all lifecycle stages... vulnerability exposure assessment... F1 score of 96.69%, exceeding the best traditional SCA tool by 18.76 percentage points.'

Section 4.1: 'we retain 35 projects for each language ecosystem, resulting in a total of 105 experimental subjects'; '58,211 stage-level dependency instances'; '17,482 CVE-stage ground-truth instances'; 'three annotators independently extract and review dependencies'; implemented on 'Claude Agent framework' with 'Claude-Sonnet-4.6'.
Section 4.1 (Baseline Configuration): Syft, Microsoft SBOM Tool, and cdxgen chosen as representative artifact-scanning, project-dependency, and package-manager baselines.

Section 4.3: removing Planning drops Java F1 by 52.84–88.66 percentage points across stages; removing Reasoning drops Java Code-stage Precision by 52.39 and JavaScript Release-stage Precision by 77.38 points.
Table 4 / Section 4.6: SCA-Agent reports 16,497 TP, 145 FP, 985 FN (Precision 99.13%, Recall 94.37%, F1 96.69%) vs. cdxgen 9,710 FPs (F1 77.93%).
Section 5: 'API cost of SCA-Agent is approximately $0.85 per project, with an average analysis time of about 5 minutes'; runtime coverage 'may still depend on workload coverage'.
Appendix A (Open Science): 'prompts and experience files... available in our anonymous repository at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sca_agent-E0AC/'; dataset/ground truth release not stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent systems paper (Claude-Sonnet-4.6 via Claude Agent SDK, Section 4.1) applying adaptive planning, tool use, and cross-stage reasoning to software composition analysis — squarely within Agents & Tool Use and Code & Programming preferences, though it contributes no new LLM methodology itself. Novelty is moderate: the lifecycle-aware SCA framing (Origin/Propagation/Fate across Code-Build-Release-Deploy-Runtime) is a new problem formulation for SCA, but the agent loop (planning-execution-observation-replanning) is standard. Rigor is solid: 105 projects across three ecosystems, 58,211 stage-level dependency instances and 17,482 CVE-stage instances with three-annotator consensus (Section 4.1), representative baselines (Syft, SBOM Tool, cdxgen), and meaningful ablations showing large degradations without Planning/Reasoning (Section 4.3). Concerns: ground truth construction (Deploy stage via Dockerfiles/docs; runtime via manually designed workloads) partially mirrors the proposed approach's evidence sources, and projects infeasible for full-lifecycle analysis were excluded, favoring the method; no significance testing or variance reported. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Table 4: 16,497 TP / 145 FP / 985 FN, F1 96.69%), with honest cost ($0.85/project, ~5 min) and limitation discussion (Section 5). Generalizability is limited to three ecosystems and curated buildable projects with ecosystem-specific prompts. Reproducibility is partial: prompts/configs released via anonymous repo (Appendix A), but dataset/ground-truth release is not stated and the system depends on a proprietary frontier model.

primary_link.title: From Component Snapshots to Lifecycle Traces: Agent-Based Software Composition Analysis

radar.summary: Software supply-chain security requires accurate identification of third-party components and an understanding of how they evolve from development to execution. Existing software composition analysis (SCA) approaches examine manifests, build environments, release artifacts, containers, or runtime states, but typically produce only stage-specific views of software composition. As dependencies are resolved, removed, repackaged, and transformed across lifecycle stages, a single snapshot cannot capt
radar.summary_zh: 軟體供應鏈安全仰賴準確辨識第三方元件,但現有軟體組成分析(SCA)工具多半只針對單一階段(如原始碼、建置、發布、部署或執行期)產生元件快照,無法同時回答元件從何而來(Origin)與最終流向何處(Fate),跨階段的傳播關係也因此斷裂。本文提出SCA-Agent,一套以代理為基礎、生命週期感知的SCA系統,透過四個步驟重組具證據支撐的元件生命週期軌跡:適應性生命週期規劃、階段感知證據蒐集、跨階段元件推理,以及生命週期感知SBOM建構。系統基於Claude Agent框架與Claude Sonnet 4.6模型實作,能依專案結構與中間觀察動態調整分析路徑。在涵蓋Java、JavaScript、Python生態系的105個真實開源專案(共58,211筆階段級相依性觀察)上,SCA-Agent於所有生命週期階段皆取得最高F1;Origin準確率介於84.44%至99.11%,Fate準確率介於70.94%至97.95%;漏洞曝險評估F1達96.69%,較最佳傳統工具高出18.76個百分點,誤報從9,710降至145。消融實驗證實適應性規劃與跨階段推理缺一不可。限制包括:依賴人工整理的領域知識、每專案約0.85美元與5分鐘的LLM分析成本、分析僅達元件層級而未處理程式碼可達性,且執行期真值受工作負載覆蓋影響。此研究顯示生命週期脈絡能顯著降低供應鏈風險評估的誤判,提供可追溯的元件來源與更精準的漏洞曝險判斷。

Section 4.2 (Study 2, Meaning): visual-cue sweep 98.7-99.8% completion 'without a monotonic improvement', and the marked-pixel reader 'should not be generalized to agents that locate actions from raw pixels alone'.
Section 7.5 (Limitations): web-only implementation, small/mid-tier models only, administrative/commerce applications, no human-user evaluation of usability, trust, or supervisability.
Appendix (Principle index): principles explicitly labeled measured / observed / proposed / null (e.g., P10 and P6 'null'), separating validated from unvalidated design requirements.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to the Agents & Tool Use preference (computer-use/browser agents, agent recovery, shared human-agent interfaces) and evaluated with LLM-driven agents (ChatGPT 5.6 Luna/Terra variants on a ReAct-style harness), though it is an HCI design-system contribution rather than an LLM methodology paper. Novelty is solid: it reverses the usual direction of intervention by making interfaces agent-readable while preserving visual freedom, with a principle-check-evidence mapping; it builds on existing agent-experience heuristics work it cites. Rigor is mixed but honest: three controlled studies (60 components vs 9 implementations; theme/layout sweeps; seven principles across three models and two channels) plus deletion-restoration and transfer experiments, with explicit null and negative results (e.g., MUI/Atomic CRM near-null, shadcn-admin predictably-labelled 79%->74%) and an evidence-status appendix separating measured/observed/proposed/null claims. However, there is no statistical significance testing, workflow-case pairs are n=1-2 per condition, missing Fig.4 model results are 'not treated as failures', and the instruction-file baseline (agent.md) matches Affora at 100% on the primary set, weakening the uniqueness of the mechanism. Evidence is quantitative with denominators but small-n and unmatched denominators in places. Generalizability is bounded: web-only, small/mid-tier models, administrative/commerce domains, no human-user study. Reproducibility details (harness, Docker environments, hardware/software versions) are given but no public artifact/release link is verified in the text.

primary_link.title: Affora: A Design System for Agent-Friendly Interfaces

radar.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly operate software designed for people, but interfaces often leave actions or task state unclear to machine readers. We present Affora, a design system that supports both readers while preserving visual freedom and familiar human workflows. Three controlled studies examine component implementations, visual variation, and interaction-design principles. Their findings inform guidance from individual components to complete sites, supported by reusable implementations
radar.summary_zh: 電腦使用代理日益操作為人類設計的軟體，但介面常未能向機器讀者清楚呈現可用動作與任務狀態。本文提出 Affora，一個同時支援人與代理兩種讀者的設計系統，核心概念是語意基層（semantic substrate）：介面在視覺樣式之下所宣告的控制項、名稱、關係、狀態與選項等機器可讀結構。研究透過三項實驗展開：元件實作比較顯示純語意 HTML 的代理成功率達 91%，八個元件函式庫僅 68.3%–86.7%，修復語意並揭露選項與狀態可將成功率由 43% 提升至 90%；視覺變異實驗顯示在語意基層不變下，跨主題與版面配置的 DOM 完成率維持 99.5%，證明視覺自由度得以保留；互動設計原則實驗則發現經典準則對代理未必成立，例如額外確認會增加互動成本。在獨立撰寫的介面上，增益取決於規則是否對應既有缺陷；WebShop 隱藏選項案例的規則擴充使完成率由 8% 升至 68%。釋出流程案例顯示動作數減少約 21%–40%、token 用量減少 24%–41%，惟配對樣本少，僅屬初步證據。限制包括僅測試中小型模型、以網頁為主、未評估人類使用者的效益。此研究顯示代理效率部分是介面性質，可在不犧牲視覺表達的前提下連結使用者體驗（UX）與代理體驗（AX）。

links.title: Fallacy Benchmarks Measure Scheme Recognition, Not Fallacy Detection

evidence: Abstract & Table 1 (§6.3): native-to-matched false-positive-rate rise 16.6%±1.6%→58.9%±2.9% on CoCoLoFa (5 seeds) and 5.7%→62.0% on Reddit within-corpus (3 seeds), with RoBERTa replication at 19.7%→70.3%.

§6.3: wrong-scheme negatives are labeled with the scheme they instantiate 85.9% of the time vs 0.4% for the source type (200-to-1 preference); type-specific gap +40.9±1.9pp; per-type gaps +10.7 to +73.1pp.

§6.4 Table 2: dissociation replicates on three zero-shot LLM detectors — type-specific separation +31.0pp (Sonnet 5), +45.6pp (Haiku 4.5), +25.5pp (Qwen3.6-27B) — while the raw native-to-matched gap is +0.5pp (interval spanning zero) on Qwen3.6-27B.
§6.1: only 3 of 183 sampled native 'none' items are scheme-matched (1/30 CoCoLoFa, 1/30 Reddit, 1/63 MAFALDA, 0/60 Argotario); inter-annotator agreement 86.3%, three-way κ=0.74, Gwet's AC1 0.82.
§6.7: three non-author annotators confirm judge precision 93.1% (67/72); restricted to human-confirmed-valid subset the FPR is 56.6% (30/53) vs native 16.6%, with planted decoys caught 6-7 of 8.
§6.5: Touché 2026's deliberately built negative class yields 26.2±1.8% vs 42.9% on the paper's matched negatives; register rewrite moves FPR only 24.6%→26.2% (1.6pp), bounding the register confound.

Appendix B: Scheme Foils released on GitHub (655/738 CoCoLoFa, 387/389 Reddit items) with disclosed impurity (6.9% matched, 22.5% wrong-scheme); Appendix A gives full training hyperparameters; Appendix C gives all generation and zero-shot prompts.

Limitations: authors state generated rates are 'not estimates of deployment-time magnitude', the naturally-occurring check uses only 13 confirmed items, wrong-scheme condition is 77.5% certified, and Argotario corroboration is partial (one of two overlapping types shows the effect at 78.8%, the other 6.8%).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed benchmark-audit paper in NLP evaluation methodology, not core LLM/Japanese/agent methodology, so preference relevance is moderate despite LLM detectors being tested. The matched vs. wrong-scheme control design (identical pipeline, varying only scheme identity) is a genuinely clever controlled comparison that cleanly isolates the mechanism, though it builds on identified closest prior work (Ruiz-Dolz & Lawrence 2023) and the annotation-artifact tradition. Rigor is strong: multi-seed runs with reported SDs, bootstrap and permutation tests, Firth-penalized regression, cross-model judge with position-bias control, prompts frozen in advance, planted decoys in human validation, a register confound bounded via Touché, and an unusually candid Limitations section (constructed rates are not deployment magnitudes; 13-item naturally-occurring check is underpowered; wrong-scheme condition only 77.5% certified). Evidence for the dissociation is robust across two fine-tuned encoders and three zero-shot LLMs, with the honest report that the raw native-to-matched gap vanishes on Qwen3.6-27B while the dissociation survives. Generalizability is decent (four benchmarks plus a deliberately-built negative class), but bounded to eight fallacy types, two primary corpora, and one mid-size open-weights detector. Reproducibility is good: full prompts, training hyperparameters, annotation protocols, and released Scheme Foils with disclosed impurity rates. Weaknesses keep it below top tier: small validation samples (n=40, n=72, 13 natural items), partial Argotario corroboration, self-citation of closely related prior work, and the claim's scope limited to argumentation/fallacy benchmarks.

primary_link.title: Fallacy Benchmarks Measure Scheme Recognition, Not Fallacy Detection

This construction is misleading: a classifier can learn cues that do well on this class without learning to tell a fallacy from a correct argument. We show that the low false-positive rates benchmarks report are an artifact of how the class is built, not evidence of detection ability. The most informative negative for a fallacy is a correct arg
radar.summary_zh: 謬誤偵測基準普遍以單一「有效/無謬誤」類別收容所有非謬誤文本。本文證明此設計使基準測量的是論證型態辨識，而非謬誤偵測：有效類別多為離題言論、意見片段等殘餘資料，其中「型態匹配」的有效論證（與謬誤使用相同推理型態但正確回答批判性問題）在四個基準中僅占約3%。作者依 Walton 的論證型態理論，以 Gemini 2.5 Flash 為八種謬誤類型生成新寫的型態匹配負例，並配對僅改變推理型態的錯誤型態負例作為對照，經跨模型評審與人類標註驗證。結果顯示：微調 ModernBERT 在 CoCoLoFa 的偽陽性率由16.6%升至58.9%，Reddit 由5.7%升至62.0%；匹配負例被判為源謬誤類型的比率比錯誤型態負例高40.9個百分點，而後者有85.9%被歸為其實際型態、僅0.4%被歸為源類型，證明分類器學到的是「用了哪種型態」而非「用得對不對」。此分離現象在 Claude Sonnet 5、Haiku 4.5 與 Qwen3.6-27B 三個零樣本偵測器上同樣出現，且以跨語料訓練排除領域偏移的解釋；刻意建構負類別的 Touché 2026 則落差明顯較小，佐證問題源自基準的類別建構方式。限制包括：生成資料上的比率不宜外推至部署情境、標註樣本有限、匹配負例含6.9%不純度。作者釋出 Scheme Foils 挑戰集，主張在稽核有效類別的型態匹配覆蓋之前，不應信任任何報告的偽陽性率。

links.title: Linguistic Triggers of Gender and Racial Bias in Open-Weight LLMs Applied to Recruitment

evidence: Section 3.1: six open-weight models (Llama 3.2 3B, Mistral 7B v0.3, Gemma 3 4B, Qwen 3 8B, Phi 3 3.8B Mini, DeepSeek-R1 7B distill) queried at temperature 0 with structured JSON outputs via Ollama

Section 4.1/Table 2: female candidates scored 6.72 under agentic vs 7.53 under communal postings (r_rb=0.309, p_Bonf=7.2e-5); model-fixed-effects replication r_rb=0.448, p_Bonf=3.9e-9; male comparison non-significant

Section 4.2/Table 3: coded-exclusion language dropped recruiter scores for Black candidates by 2.20 points (r_rb=0.742) vs 1.00 for White (r_rb=0.324), and job-seeker interest fell 1.60 (Black) vs 0.68 (White), all p_Bonf<2e-6

Section 4.2/Table 4: label-ablation decomposes the gap into a language-only baseline of -0.73 (no demographic label) plus label increments of -0.35 (Asian), -0.52 (Hispanic), -0.87 (Black), attributing differential drops to the explicit persona label

Section 4.1: description-body ablation (r_rb=0.272, p_Bonf=5.4e-4) identifies posting text rather than job title as the primary mechanism; WEAT effect sizes d=1.01-1.45 across two embedding models with 2,000-permutation tests

Section 5.5 Limitations: results limited to 3B-8B models, 1-10 scale may compress variance, minimal profiles with explicit demographic fields likely amplify effect sizes, job-seeker results are stated LLM interest not observed human behavior

Appendices A-B: exact prompt templates for all four experiments and complete text of all 80 synthetic job postings reproduced; Section 3.2 discloses stimuli were drafted with Gemini 3 Flash then manually verified against Gaucher et al. (2011) word lists
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope empirical LLM safety/fairness audit: six open-weight LLMs (Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Phi 3, DeepSeek-R1) probed via persona prompting to measure how job-posting language triggers gender and racial bias, with statistical rigor (Mann-Whitney U + Bonferroni, rank-biserial effect sizes, model-fixed-effects replications, title/body/label ablations, WEAT corroboration). Novelty is moderate: prior audits manipulated candidate attributes (An et al. 2025; Wilson & Caliskan 2024), and the posting-language-as-variable design plus joint recruiter/job-seeker framing and label-ablation causal decomposition is a genuine but incremental contribution on well-trodden phenomena. Rigor is solid though constrained: minimal candidate profiles ('no other background provided', Appendix A) make the label-driven findings partly by construction, stimuli were LLM-drafted then author-reviewed (Section 3.2), and single deterministic runs at temperature 0 limit variance estimation. Evidence is internally consistent with complete tables (Tables 2-4) and honest per-model reporting, but external validity is weak: only 3B-8B models, synthetic stimuli, stated-interest personas rather than real job-seeker behavior, all acknowledged in Section 5.5. Reproducibility is strong: exact prompts (Appendix A) and all 80 stimuli (Appendix B) are reproduced, though no code release is stated. The four-stage audit protocol (Section 5.6) is a useful governance translation but untested in deployment. Weighted score: 0.66.

primary_link.title: Linguistic Triggers of Gender and Racial Bias in Open-Weight LLMs Applied to Recruitment

radar.summary: Open-weight large language models are rapidly entering hiring pipelines, yet their discriminatory failure modes -- and the regulatory exposure these create under the EU AI Act high-risk classification (Annex III) and U.S. EEOC adverse-impact analysis -- remain poorly understood. We present the first systematic, multi-model audit of open-weight LLMs that treats job-posting language as the primary experimental variable, evaluating six models (Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Phi 3, DeepSeek-R1
radar.summary_zh: 本論文是首個以職缺文案語言為主要實驗變數、針對開放權重大型語言模型（LLM）招募偏見的系統性多模型稽核。作者選用六個可部署於消費級硬體的模型（Llama 3.2、Mistral、Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Phi 3、DeepSeek-R1），設計四項對照實驗，同時模擬招募方與求職者兩種角色：招募方對候選人給出推薦強度評分，求職者 persona 則自評興趣分數。結果顯示，agentic（任務導向）用語會顯著壓低女性候選人的推薦分數（rank-biserial r=0.309，Bonferroni 校正後 p=7×10⁻⁵；模型固定效應分析達 0.448），communal（共融式）用語則可部分翻轉此懲罰；消融實驗證實職缺描述內文（而非職稱）才是主要驅動因素。種族方面，具文化編碼排他性的文案以大效應量（r=0.646–0.758）壓低非白人候選人分數，並選擇性抑制少數族群 persona 的求職興趣，具體操作化寒蟬效應機制；標籤消融（H1）證實明確的人口屬性標籤是組間差異的主因，H2 交叉分析顯示種族是主導軸、性別影響甚微。WEAT 詞嵌入關聯測試（d=1.01–1.45）在表徵層面佐證行為結果。限制包括僅涵蓋 3B–8B 開放權重模型、1–10 分量表可能壓縮變異、合成刺激與明確標籤可能放大效應、求職者模擬僅反映模型語言敏感度而非真人行為。研究價值在於將發現轉譯為四階段部署前稽核流程（詞彙評分、persona 條件探測、四分之五門檻的不利影響檢核、EU AI Act Annex III 文件化），並指出 inclusive 用語下的「親社會過度矯正」與排他用語下的「文化契合懲罰」兩種失敗模式並存，使模型選擇本身即為重要的公平性決策，協助企業與監管者落實高風險 AI 招募系統的治理義務。

llm_evaluation.rationale: This is a vision-language grounding paper (VLM-based panoptic grounded captioning) rather than pure computer vision, since language generation and the VLM language interface are central, so it is not capped at 0.20; however its alignment with the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents, safety, alignment) is weak, matching mainly Multimodal AI, CV, and Training/Data preferences. Research quality is high: rigorous ablations (Section 5.2, three seeds with t-tests at p<0.05), a validated evaluation metric (Appendix B.2, Spearman rho 0.72 vs 0.45 on BiRD), controlled data ablations with matched budgets (Table 5), efficiency reporting (Appendix D.3), and honest reporting of baselines winning some metrics (CAPTURE 68.0 vs 70.6 in Table 6). radar.summary_zh: 本論文探討視覺語言模型（VLM）雖能產生流暢影像描述，卻難以將文字精確對應到像素層級遮罩的問題，並以「全景接地描述」為研究目標：模型須同時描述前景物件與背景區域，且每個指涉詞組都要附上正確的像素級遮罩。作者首先建立 PanoCaps 基準，包含約 3.5 千張人工標註影像，像素涵蓋率近 99%，取材自 COCONut、ADE20K 與 VIPSeg，並提出詞組—遮罩匹配協定與廣義 Panoptic Quality（gPQ）指標，同時評估文字與遮罩的一致性。接著提出 PANORAMA，將接地任務視為從「以詞組條件化的候選遮罩池」中進行選擇：VLM 為每個詞組輸出 [SEG] 記號，其隱藏狀態經投影為概念向量，用以驅動預訓練的 SAM 3 產生候選遮罩，再由學習到的比對評分器挑選相符提案。此設計將指涉物辨識與邊界描繪分離，天然支援單一或多實例指涉。實驗顯示 PANORAMA-4B 在 PanoCaps 測試集取得最佳 gPQ（45.6），於 GCG、RefCOCO、GRES 與 GroundingSuite 等接地任務亦達到或超越專門模型；消融實驗證明提案選擇機制、詞組條件化與資料品質的關鍵貢獻，僅以 2 千餘張訓練影像即勝過規模大 57 倍的 COCONut-PanCap。限制在於尚未涵蓋影片接地與區域描述，且偶爾會遺漏可見區域或描述不夠精確。此研究展示語言表徵可作為銜接預訓練提案空間的介面，兼顧細緻描述與像素級場景理解，對具身智慧與機器人應用深具意義。

links.title: "If I Had to Buy Just ONE: Galaxy S26 Ultra": Auditing AI-Generated Product Recommendations

evidence: Abstract: 'ChatGPT expresses a first-person product preference in 79% of product-recommending responses, compared with 7% for Gemini and 2% for AI Overviews' and interface/API mean domain overlaps of 12.0% and 14.8%.

ConsumerQ dataset section: 2,528 confirmed commercial-advice queries from LMSYS-Chat-1M and WildChat-1M; screening precision 89.0% with alpha=0.65 among three annotators, and admitted inability to estimate filter recall.

Appendix A (Table 2): LLM-vs-gold agreements reported per task (alpha 1.000 for query type, 0.939 for advice type, 0.632-0.882 for RQ1 properties), with two presentation-format codes (alpha 0.439, 0.079) listed as not analysed.

RQ2 section: 'ChatGPT and Gemini shared, on average, only 5.4% of their displayed domains, and 76.7% of comparisons shared no domain at all'; source-type classification 'did not systematically evaluate them against human annotations; we therefore treat the source-type results as exploratory'.
RQ3 section: interface-API domain overlap 12.0% (ChatGPT) and 14.8% (Gemini), no shared domain in 60.9%/43.4% of pairs; ChatGPT API returned mean 37.38 pages via search vs 3.22 final citations.

Limitations section: only 117 physical-product queries, three repetitions, fixed Netherlands location, one time point, AI Overviews in 134 of 351 searches, and 'we cannot attribute the differences we observe to access method alone'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An audit study of deployed LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews) for commercial product advice, sitting squarely on LLM evaluation, AI-safety/bias, and RAG source-attribution preferences, though it is a measurement/audit paper rather than a language-methodology contribution. Novelty is moderate-to-good: it fills genuine gaps (commercial-advice queries, interface-vs-API auditability) relative to prior generative-search audits it cites. Rigor is strong for an audit: human-adjudicated gold standards with reported Krippendorff's alpha (Appendix A), LLM-as-judge validated before deployment, paired interface/API requests, repeated queries, bootstrap CIs, and honest scoping (e.g., 'we cannot attribute the differences we observe to access method alone' in Limitations). Evidence is quantitative and consistent (79% vs 7% vs 2% first-person preference; 5.4% cross-provider domain overlap; 12.0%/14.8% interface-API overlap), but observational, with acknowledged weak points: source-type classification not validated against humans ('treated as exploratory'), filter recall unestimable, and two codebook dimensions with alpha 0.439/0.079 left unanalysed. Generalizability is limited by 117 physical-product queries, one country, English-only, one time point, and AI Overviews recoverable in only 134/351 searches. Reproducibility is inherently constrained by closed, time-varying systems, scraping dependence, and no stated release of code or the ConsumerQ dataset, despite detailed codebooks. Overall a carefully executed, relevant audit contribution of moderate scientific weight.

Sec. 3.3: GRPO reward is the average per-token log-probability of the ground-truth answer under a frozen VideoLLM; DAAD (Eqs. 4-6) discounts advantages via a sigmoid of lambda minus the ratio of pairwise Jaccard memory-state diversity to reward standard deviation.

Sec. 4.2, Tables 4-7: Ablations show GRPO adds ~0.8% average over cold-start, temporal branch alone beats semantic alone, reward-model swap (Qwen3-VL-2B vs InternVL3.5-2B) changes results by only 0.1-0.3%, and DAAD improves average from 56.3 to 57.4 (InternVL3.5) and 62.9 to 63.4 (Qwen3-VL).

Sec. 4.3, Fig. 3c: Robustness analysis uses query novelty defined as mean Sentence-BERT cosine distance to the 10 nearest training queries; SVMemAgent outperforms baselines across the full novelty range.

Sec. 4, Implementation details: DINOv3-Base encoder with 8-layer/2-layer transformer branches (196M total params), K=16 memory budget, rollout group size 32, DAAD threshold lambda=40, InternVL3.5-2B reward model, data drawn from subsets of Video-R1 and LongVILA filtered to videos over 64 seconds; no code release is stated.

llm_evaluation.rationale: A streaming video memory agent trained with GRPO and a novel DAAD advantage-discounting scheme for query-agnostic online frame selection. In scope: it is not pure CV but a multimodal/agent/RL methodology paper using VideoLLMs (InternVL3.5, Qwen3-VL) as reward and downstream models, hitting Agents & Tool Use, Multimodal AI, RL, and Long Context & Memory preferences. The strict-online problem formulation (no query, unknown duration) is a genuine gap versus offline keyframe selection, and applying GRPO to an external lightweight memory policy rather than the LLM itself is reasonably novel. Rigor is strong: baselines are categorized by information access (Table 1), and ablations cover training stages, branches, reward-model choice, DAAD, memory budget, query arrival time, and query novelty. Evidence is solid but gains are modest (0.8-2.3% average, Table 2) with no variance or significance reporting, and training-set sizes are not disclosed. Generalization is demonstrated via cross-backbone transfer and reward-model insensitivity (Tables 2, 6). Reproducibility is moderate: detailed hyperparameters (K=16, G=32, lambda=40, 196M params) are given, but no code release, full dataset specification, or pseudo-label thresholds.
